account.unreachable: Error shown under an account form (sign in, feedback, saves) when the request did not get through.
account.answered: Error shown under an account form when the server gave an error with no message. status: the HTTP status, 500.
account.noServer: Error shown when sending feedback from a copy of the game with no account server.
account.feedbackNotYet: Error shown when sending feedback while the account server does not take feedback yet.
accountPanel.googleLoadFail: Error text under the sign-in form when Google's sign-in script cannot load.
accountPanel.unavailable: Paragraph in the account panel when the server has sign-in switched off.
accountPanel.devPlaceholder: Placeholder of a text box shown only on development servers, where any made-up id signs in.
accountPanel.devLabel: Screen-reader label of the development sign-in text box.
accountPanel.signIn: Button on the sign-in form, the title of the account panel when signed out, and the hover of the person icon.
accountPanel.linkSent: Message under the forgot-password form after the reset email is sent (used when the server gives no text).
accountPanel.recoveryEmail: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the email box, in the forgot-password form, the register form and the signed-in panel.
accountPanel.sendReset: Button in the forgot-password form that emails a password reset link.
accountPanel.back: Button that leaves the forgot-password form or the change-password form.
accountPanel.username: Placeholder and label of the username box.
accountPanel.password: Placeholder and label of the password box.
accountPanel.recoveryEmailOptional: Placeholder of the email box on the create-account form.
accountPanel.createAccount: Button on the sign-in form that opens the create-account form, and the submit button of that form.
accountPanel.signInInstead: Button on the create-account form that goes back to the sign-in form.
accountPanel.forgotPassword: Button on the sign-in form that opens the forgot-password form.
accountPanel.privacy: Link at the bottom of the sign-in form to the privacy page.
accountPanel.terms: Link at the bottom of the sign-in form to the terms page.
accountPanel.signedInAs: Line at the top of the signed-in account panel. name: the account's username, shown in bold, e.g. "anita".
accountPanel.signedInGoogle: Line at the top of the signed-in account panel for an account that signed in through Google.
accountPanel.signedIn: Line at the top of the signed-in account panel when there is no username to show.
accountPanel.passwordChanged: Message in the account panel after the password is changed.
accountPanel.currentPassword: Placeholder and label of the current-password box in the change-password form, the recovery email form and the delete-account question.
accountPanel.newPassword: Placeholder and label of the new-password box in the change-password form.
accountPanel.save: Submit button of the change-password form.
accountPanel.confirmEmail: Note under the recovery email box while the address is waiting for confirmation. email: the address, e.g. "a@b.com".
accountPanel.noRecoveryEmail: Warning under the recovery email box when the account has none.
accountPanel.saveEmail: Button that saves the recovery email.
accountPanel.remove: Button that removes the recovery email.
accountPanel.changePassword: Button in the signed-in account panel that opens the change-password form.
accountPanel.signOutTip: Hover of the Sign out button. trainsworld and noritetsu are the names of two map sites that share the account; keep them as they are.
accountPanel.signOut: Button in the signed-in account panel.
accountPanel.deleteAccount: Button in the signed-in account panel that opens the delete question, and the button that confirms it.
accountPanel.deleteQuestion: Question in the account panel before deleting the account. noritetsu is the name of a map site.
accountPanel.deleteConfirmGoogle: Line above Google's button in the delete-account question, for accounts that sign in with Google and have no password.
accountPanel.keepIt: Button in the delete-account question that cancels.
accountPanel.nameHidden: Line in the signed-in account panel under the display name, shown when a moderator has hidden the player's name (others see "player"). It goes once they pick a different name.
accountPanel.flag: Screen-reader name of the signed-in account panel's flag button (a small flag, or an empty outline, before the display name) and of the picker's search box; the player picks a flag to show after their display name (a country's, a city's, or a few others).
accountPanel.flagTip: Hover of the flag button in the account panel, under the flag's name when one is picked: what the flag is for.
accountPanel.noFlag: The flag picker's first choice while a flag is picked: show none.
accountPanel.flagSearch: Placeholder of the flag picker's box while the player types to find a flag.
flags.train: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: a train drawn on a flag, for this train game.
flags.earth: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the flag of planet Earth (blue with white rings).
flags.rainbow: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the rainbow pride flag (LGBT).
flags.trans: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the transgender pride flag.
flags.pirate: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the pirate flag (skull and crossbones).
flags.chequered: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the black and white chequered flag of motor racing.
flags.amsterdam: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the city flag of Amsterdam. The city's name.
flags.chicago: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the city flag of Chicago. The city's name.
flags.washington: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the flag of Washington, D.C. The city's name.
flags.nyc: Name of a flag a player can show beside their name: the city flag of New York City. The city's name.
accountPanel.gamesTip: Hover of the games count in the account panel. max: how many games the account may keep, e.g. 20.
accountPanel.gamesCount: Line in the signed-in account panel. count: games saved on the account, e.g. 3.
accountPanel.backupsTip: Hover of the storage figure in the account panel.
accountPanel.storageUsed: Storage used by the account's games. used and limit: sizes from accountPanel.megabytes, e.g. "1.2 MB" and "50 MB".
accountPanel.megabytes: A file size in megabytes. size: a number, e.g. "0.2" or "12".
accountPanel.mergeOne: Question after signing in when one game is stored in this browser only. name: the game's name, e.g. "My network".
accountPanel.mergeMany: Question after signing in when several games are stored in this browser only. count: e.g. 4.
accountPanel.add: Button that adds the browser's games to the account.
accountPanel.dontAdd: Button that declines adding the browser's games to the account.
accountPanel.mergeSure: Second question after declining to add games to the account.
accountPanel.keepHereOne: Button that confirms keeping one game in this browser only.
accountPanel.keepHereMany: Button that confirms keeping several games in this browser only.
accountPanel.addIt: Button that adds one game to the account, after the second question.
accountPanel.addThem: Button that adds several games to the account, after the second question.
accountPanel.account: Title of the account panel when signed in, hover of the person icon, and heading of the Account row in Settings.
accountPanel.accountSettings: Button in Settings that opens the account panel when signed in.
accountPanel.notLoggedIn: Text beside the account icon in Settings and the start menu when signed out.
accountPanel.loggedInAs: Text beside the account icon in Settings. name: the username, e.g. "anita".
accountPanel.loggedInGoogle: Text beside the account icon in Settings for a Google account.
accountPanel.loggedIn: Text beside the account icon in Settings when there is no username.
achievements.title: Hover and screen-reader label of the medal button at the top of the Cities tab that opens the achievements view.
achievements.more: Title of a toast at the map's bottom left when several achievements were earned at once. count: more than 3, e.g. 5.
achievements.nameCities: Achievement name in the Achievements panel and the earned notice: tiers by the number of cities with a station.
achievements.nameTrips: Achievement name: tiers by the trips per day in the whole world.
achievements.nameStation: Achievement name: tiers by the boardings per day at the busiest station.
achievements.nameLine: Achievement name: tiers by the riders per day on the busiest line.
achievements.citiesToast: A tier of Cities served, in the earned notice under the achievement name. n: 10.
achievements.citiesServed: A tier of Cities served, in a hover or the panel. n: 10.
achievements.tripsDay: A tier of Trips per day. n: "10M".
achievements.stationBoardings: A tier of Busiest station. n: "1M"; of: the station's name, "Canal St", or achievements.oneStation before it is earned.
achievements.lineRiders: A tier of Busiest line. n: "1M"; of: the line's name, "Line 4", or achievements.oneLine before it is earned.
achievements.oneStation: Stands in for the station's name in achievements.stationBoardings on a tier not yet earned.
achievements.oneLine: Stands in for the line's name in achievements.lineRiders on a tier not yet earned.
achievements.nameBorder: Achievement name (earned once): a line with stops in two countries.
achievements.ruleBorder: Hover of the Over the border achievement before it is earned: what it asks.
achievements.textBorder: Hover of the earned Over the border achievement. of: the line's name, "Line 4"; places: the countries as a list, "France and Belgium".
achievements.nameContinents: Achievement name (earned once): a line with stops on two continents.
achievements.ruleContinents: Hover of the Bicontinental achievement before it is earned: what it asks.
achievements.textContinents: Hover of the earned Bicontinental achievement. of: the line's name, "Line 4"; places: the continents as a list, "Europe and Asia".
achievements.nameLong: Achievement name (earned once): a very long line.
achievements.ruleLong: Hover of the Longest road achievement before it is earned. length: "5,000 km".
achievements.textLong: Hover of the earned Longest road achievement. of: the line's name; length: "5,120 km".
achievements.namePearls: Achievement name (earned once): a long line that makes a profit.
achievements.rulePearls: Hover of the String of pearls achievement before it is earned. length: "3,000 km".
achievements.textPearls: Hover of the earned String of pearls achievement. of: the line's name; length: "3,200 km".
achievements.nameMoney: Achievement name (earned once): a line with a very large profit in a day.
achievements.ruleMoney: Hover of the Money train achievement before it is earned. amount: "$200M".
achievements.textMoney: Hover of the earned Money train achievement. of: the line's name; amount: "$210M".
achievements.nameBullet: Achievement name (earned once): a very fast train.
achievements.ruleBullet: Hover of the Bullet train achievement before it is earned. speed: "300 km/h".
achievements.textBullet: Hover of the earned Bullet train achievement. of: the line's name; speed: "320 km/h".
achievements.nameCircle: Achievement name (earned once): a circle line with many stops.
achievements.ruleCircle: Hover of the City circles achievement before it is earned. n: 10.
achievements.textCircle: Hover of the earned City circles achievement. of: the line's name; n: 12.
achievements.nameChange: Achievement name (earned once): the average trip needs a transfer.
achievements.ruleChange: Hover of the Transfers world achievement before it is earned. trips: "100k".
achievements.textChange: Hover of the earned Transfers world achievement. n: "1.04".
achievements.nowChange: Extra line in the hover of Transfers world before it is earned: the current figure. n: "0.62".
achievements.nameCity: Achievement name (earned once): a city where many trips are by transit.
achievements.ruleCity: Hover of the Transit city achievement before it is earned. share: 20.
achievements.textCity: Hover of the earned Transit city achievement. share: "21%"; of: the city's name, "Paris".
achievements.nameIntercity: Achievement name (earned once): a city where many trips to other places are by train.
achievements.ruleIntercity: Hover of the Grounded achievement before it is earned. share: 20.
achievements.textIntercity: Hover of the earned Grounded achievement. share: "21%"; of: the city's name, "Paris".
achievements.nameSleeper: Achievement name (earned once): a rider spends many hours on one train.
achievements.ruleSleeper: Hover of the Sleeper achievement before it is earned. hours: 12.
achievements.textSleeper: Hover of the earned Sleeper achievement. hours: "12.4"; of: the line's name.
achievements.nameAllJapan: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from Hokkaido to Shikoku. Short.
achievements.nameOrient: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from Paris to Istanbul. Name of the historic train; keep it recognisable.
achievements.nameTranscon: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from New York to San Francisco.
achievements.nameSiberian: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from western Europe to eastern Russia. The Trans-Siberian Railway.
achievements.nameAndean: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from Santiago to Buenos Aires over the Andes.
achievements.nameCape: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from Cape Town to Cairo. Title of the famous Africa route.
achievements.nameGhan: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from Adelaide to Darwin. Name of the Australian train; a proper noun, may stay.
achievements.nameSilk: Achievement name (hidden until earned): a line from Istanbul to Xi'an.
achievements.nameEurope: Achievement name (hidden until earned): trains carry 5% of all trips in Europe. A grand tour of the continent.
achievements.nameNation: Achievement name (hidden until earned): trains carry a set share of trips in one country. cc: ISO code (JP, GB, DE, IT or another); country: the country's name. Japan, Britain, Germany and Italy use a nod to the country's historic railway; the rest are Rail plus the country.
achievements.textCorridor: Hover and toast line of an earned corridor achievement (hidden ones). from, to: station names.
achievements.textShare: Hover and toast line of an earned rail-share achievement (hidden ones). share: "10.3%"; place: a country or Europe.
achievements.when: When an achievement was earned, on the game clock. weekday: "Monday"; day: 406; time: "14:08".
achievementsView.day: Right-hand figure of a first-achievement row in the achievements view, the game day it was reached. day: the day number, "12".
achievementsView.firstReached: Hover on a reached first-achievement row. text: what was done, a sentence such as "Opened your first line"; when: the date reached, "Mar 4" style as the game words it.
achievementsView.players: Last line of the hover on an achievement, once the server has the counts. share: a percent such as "12%" or "0.03%".
achievementsView.tierReached: Hover on a medal of a tiered achievement that has been reached. text: the tier, such as "Connect 5 cities"; when: the date reached.
achievementsView.title: Title of the achievements view.
airportMarks.hover: Hover tag over an airport bubble on the map, above a mode bar. trips: a rounded count, "1.2M"; when: a day phrase, "on a weekday" or "per day".
allCitiesView.allCities: Lower-case phrase passed to the money hover of the Profit row in the all cities view, naming what the money covers.
allCitiesView.goTo: Hover and screen-reader label of the locate button in the all cities view title.
allCitiesView.tripsTip: Hover on the Transit trips row of the all cities view. count: trips per day, "12,430"; where: a trailing phrase starting with a space or empty, such as " in the cities you serve".
attractionMarks.visits: Hover tag over an attraction on the map, second row under its name. visits: a rounded count, "12k"; when: a day phrase, "on a weekday" or "per day".
attractionMarks.byTrain: Hover tag over an attraction, third row above a mode bar: the share of visits made by transit. share: a whole number, "23".
blueprint.kindTrack: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindStations: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindJunctions: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindFlyovers: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindFlatCrossings: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown. A flat crossing is where two tracks cross on the same level.
blueprint.kindTrains: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindTerrain: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindRoadCrossings: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindStationUpgrades: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindPassages: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown. A passage is a walkway linking two stations.
blueprint.kindBusRoutes: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindBuses: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindTramCars: Heading of the quote's rows for new tram cars, in the Build tab's blueprint cost list.
blueprint.newTramCars: A quote row for tram cars the blueprint's lines need beyond the ones owned. count: how many.
blueprint.count: A counted thing in the blueprint's cost list and hovers. noun: which thing (station, junction, flyover, flatCrossing, newCar, ground, roadCrossing, stationUpgrade, passage, newBus, port, newBoat, other); count: e.g. 3.
blueprint.ferryRoute: Row in the blueprint's cost list for a ferry route. distance: its length, e.g. "12 km".
blueprint.lengthLevel: Row in the blueprint's cost list for track. distance: e.g. "3.7 km"; level: the track's level, e.g. "viaduct (+2)".
blueprint.lengthLevelTram: A quote row for tram track: its length, then the elevation. distance: a length such as 3.7 km. level: the elevation, such as ground (0).
blueprint.lengthLevelStreetTram: A quote row for tram track laid along streets (the cheap kind): its length, then the elevation. distance: a length such as 3.7 km. level: the elevation, such as ground (0).
blueprint.withLevel: Row in the blueprint's cost list. what: a counted thing such as "2 stations"; level: e.g. "ground (0)".
blueprint.amountUnit: A distance in the price breakdown. value: a number, e.g. "3.7"; unit: "km" or "mi".
blueprint.overWater: Line in the price breakdown hover of a track or station row built over water.
blueprint.baseCostDist: First line of the price hover of a track row. price: e.g. "$75M"; unit: "km" or "mi".
blueprint.length: Line in the price breakdown hover; its amount is the length.
blueprint.roughGround: Line in the price breakdown hover for track over difficult terrain, when the terrain has no name.
blueprint.costFactor: Line in the price breakdown hover: the sum of the level's multiplier and the terrain and water additions.
blueprint.singleTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover for single-track pieces, which cost less.
blueprint.hsrTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover for high-speed track, which costs more.
blueprint.baseCostStation: First line of the price hover of a station row. price: e.g. "$90M"; level: lower case, e.g. "ground level".
blueprint.stationsFactor: Line in the price breakdown hover of a station row with several stations; its amount is how many.
blueprint.platformLength: Line in the price breakdown hover of a station row: the multiplier for platforms longer than the base.
blueprint.junctionTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover of a junction row; its amount is the track length.
blueprint.flyoverTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover of a flyover row; its amount is the track length.
blueprint.crossingTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover of a flat crossing row; its amount is the track length.
blueprint.crossoverTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover: an extra multiplier for crossovers.
blueprint.ferryFree: First line of the price hover of a ferry route row.
blueprint.baseCostPer: First line of the price hover for cars, buses, boats, ports, upgrades and passages. price: the average price of one, e.g. "$2M"; noun: which thing.
blueprint.factorName: Line in the price breakdown hover when more than one of a thing is bought; its amount is how many. noun: which thing; the name is in plural and starts with a capital.
blueprint.factorAdd: Line in the price breakdown hover: something added to the multiplier. name: e.g. "Mountains"; amount: e.g. "2.5".
blueprint.factorSet: Line in the price breakdown hover: the level's multiplier. name: e.g. "Ground level"; amount: e.g. "0.5".
blueprint.factorTimes: Line in the price breakdown hover: a multiplication. name: e.g. "Length" or "Single track"; amount: a number or distance, e.g. "3.7 km" or "0.6".
blueprint.sum: Last line of the price breakdown hover: the total. money: e.g. "$120M".
blueprint.title: Heading of the quote in the Build tab for what is planned but not yet built.
blueprint.totalTip: Hover of the total price in the Build tab.
blueprint.undoTip: Hover of the undo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.undo: Screen-reader label of the undo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.redoTip: Hover of the redo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.redo: Screen-reader label of the redo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.upkeepLead: Start of the hover on the blueprint's daily upkeep line; more text about the upkeep rates follows it, so it ends without a full stop.
blueprint.upkeepDay: Line in the Build tab: what the blueprint will cost each day once built. money: e.g. "$1.2M".
blueprint.constructTip: Hover of the Construct blueprints button. key: its keyboard shortcut, "C".
blueprint.construct: Button in the Build tab that builds everything in the blueprint.
blueprint.trackPieces: Part of a list of blueprint pieces, e.g. "5 track, 2 stations". count: a number of track pieces.
blueprint.offTip: Hover of the disabled-cost figure beside the Build tab's total. pieces: e.g. "5 track, 2 stations"; cost: e.g. "$12M".
blueprint.offCost: Small figure beside the Build tab's total: the price of switched-off blueprint pieces. money: e.g. "$12M".
blueprint.offPiecesTip: Hover of the disabled count in the Build tab. pieces: e.g. "5 track, 2 stations".
blueprint.offCount: Small note in the Build tab: how many blueprint pieces are switched off. count: e.g. "7".
blueprint.doubleUp: First line of the hover on the Double up button in the selection bar. runs: how many runs of double track are selected; price: e.g. "$20M".
blueprint.doubleUpRuns: Second line of the Double up hover.
blueprint.doubleUpSome: Third line of the Double up hover. why: the reasons some runs cannot be doubled.
blueprint.doubleUpLabel: Screen-reader label of the Double up button in the selection bar.
blueprint.piece: What the selection holds. built: true for built pieces; pieces: e.g. "5 track, 2 stations".
blueprint.levelTip: Hover of a level button in the selection bar. level: lower case, e.g. "viaduct"; label: e.g. "+2".
blueprint.selection: Screen-reader label of the selection bar at the top of the map.
blueprint.selectedTip: Hover of the count in the selection bar. piece: a blueprint.piece text.
blueprint.selected: The count of selected pieces in the selection bar, "5 selected"; short. count: a number, "5".
blueprint.lengthTip: Hover of the length figure in the selection bar.
blueprint.levelMixed: Hover of the level button in the selection bar when the selected track is at several levels.
blueprint.level: Screen-reader label of the level button in the selection bar.
blueprint.trackType: Screen-reader label of the Regular / High speed button pair in the selection bar.
blueprint.regular: Button in the selection bar: ordinary track.
blueprint.highSpeed: Button in the selection bar: high-speed track.
blueprint.hsrTip: Hover of the High speed button. factor: a number, e.g. 1.5.
blueprint.disableTip: Hover of the Disable button in the selection bar. keyed: true when it has a keyboard shortcut; key: e.g. "E".
blueprint.disable: Button in the selection bar that leaves the selected pieces out when constructing.
blueprint.enableTip: Hover of the Enable button in the selection bar. keyed: true when it has a keyboard shortcut; key: e.g. "E".
blueprint.enable: Button in the selection bar that puts the selected pieces back into construction.
blueprint.removeTip: Hover of the Remove button in the selection bar. keyed: true when the Delete key does the same. Delete is a key name.
blueprint.remove: Button in the selection bar that removes the selected pieces.
blueprint.rebuild: Button in the selection bar, shown when the selected pieces are built: rebuilds them in place at the level and track type chosen beside it. Same word as rebuild.yes.
blueprint.clearTip: Hover of the Clear button in the selection bar. Esc is a key name.
blueprint.clear: Button in the selection bar that clears the selection.
blueprint.levels: Hover line of a stretch row in the cost breakdown that spans several levels. from and to: level labels, e.g. "-1" and "+2".
blueprint.switchTip: Hover and screen-reader label of a checkbox in the cost breakdown. on: true when the piece is on, so the box would switch it off; what: joined (all the joined track of a part), stretch, or station.
blueprint.breakdown: Heading of the folded list below the Build tab's total.
blueprint.fold: Screen-reader label of a chevron that folds a part of the cost breakdown.
blueprint.unfold: Screen-reader label of a chevron that opens a part of the cost breakdown.
blueprint.crossingsTip: Hover line of a stretch row in the cost breakdown. count: e.g. 2; money: what they cost, e.g. "$3M".
blueprint.byKind: Heading of the folded list of the quote grouped by kind in the cost breakdown.
blueprintBox.cannotMove: Tag next to the cursor while dragging a blueprint box to a spot that is refused, when no more specific reason is known.
blueprintBox.cannotMoveThis: Notice after dropping a dragged blueprint box on a spot that is refused with no reason given.
blueprintPick.doubleNone: Notice when doubling up the picked blueprint track fails and no reason is given.
blueprintPick.doubleSome: Notice after doubling up the picked blueprint track when some runs failed. done: 3; total: 5; why: the reason the others failed, a sentence, "Not enough room." (may be empty).
blueprintPick.levelTo: Names the elevation in the blueprint notices (blueprintPick.cannotGo, setSome, setAll). level: "+1", "0" or "−2".
blueprintPick.toHsr: Names the track type in the blueprint notices (blueprintPick.setSome, setAll) after "set to".
blueprintPick.toRegular: Names the track type in the blueprint notices (blueprintPick.setSome, setAll) after "set to".
blueprintPick.toTram: Names the track type after "to" in the rebuild hover, question and notices (rebuild.tip, rebuild.question, rebuild.done), beside blueprintPick.toRegular and toHsr.
blueprintPick.cannotGo: Error notice when changing the elevation of the picked blueprint track fails. n: how many pieces were picked; to: blueprintPick.levelTo, "level +1".
blueprintPick.setSome: Notice after changing the picked blueprint track when some pieces could not change. done: 3; n: 5; to: "level +1" or "high-speed track"; skipped: 2.
blueprintPick.setAll: Notice after changing the picked blueprint track. n: 5; to: "level +1" or "high-speed track".
blueprintPick.trackOf: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done, the picked track. length: "1.2 km"; built: true when the picked pieces are constructed.
blueprintPick.stationsPicked: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done, the picked stations. n: 2; built: true when constructed.
blueprintStretches.endJunction: Names the end of a stretch of blueprint track in the Construct breakdown, after "from" or "to": a junction.
blueprintStretches.endTrack: Names the end of a stretch of blueprint track in the Construct breakdown: where the track stops.
blueprintStretches.endBuilt: Names the end of a stretch of blueprint track in the Construct breakdown: where it meets track already built.
blueprintStretches.station: A station with no name, in the Construct breakdown.
blueprintStretches.track: Label of a part of the blueprint that has no station, in the Construct breakdown.
blueprintStretches.fromTo: Label of a part of the blueprint between two stations. from: "Canal St"; to: "Spring St".
buildingDraw.construct: Touch confirm button hover while drawing a new station building outline.
buildingDraw.saveOutline: Touch confirm button hover while reshaping an existing station building.
buildingDraw.closeOutline: Touch confirm button hover while the outline is still open.
buildingDraw.cancel: Touch stop button hover while drawing a station building.
buildingDraw.closeFirst: Notice when confirming a station building outline that is not closed yet.
buildingDraw.built: Notice after a station building is constructed. name: the station, "Canal St"; cost: money, "$1.2M".
buildingDraw.changedFor: Notice after a station building is reshaped at a cost. name: "Canal St"; cost: money, "$40k".
buildingDraw.changed: Notice after a station building is reshaped at no cost. name: "Canal St".
buildingDraw.dragDelete: Hover tag over a corner of a station building outline with more than 3 corners.
buildingDraw.drag: Hover tag over a corner of a triangular station building outline (it cannot lose a corner).
buildingDraw.addCorner: Hover tag over the middle of an outline edge.
buildingDraw.clickClose: Hover tag over the first corner of an open outline.
buildingDraw.addedFloor: Hover tag row while reshaping a station building that adds floor area. cost: money, "$40k".

busDraw.tagFar: Tag next to the cursor in the bus line tool when the pointer is too far from any road.
busDraw.tagPath: Tag next to the cursor in the bus line tool when no road joins two points.
busDraw.tagLong: Tag next to the cursor in the bus line tool when two points are too far apart for one road leg.
busDraw.notLoaded: Notice in the bus line tool when road tiles have not loaded.
busDraw.sayFar: Notice after a click in the bus line tool too far from a road. distance: "100 m" or "330 ft".
busDraw.sayPath: Notice after a click in the bus line tool when no road path joins the points.
busDraw.sayLong: Notice after a click in the bus line tool when the new point is too far from the last.
busDraw.pathWithout: Notice when deleting a point of a bus route would leave its neighbours with no road between them.
busDraw.addPoint: Touch confirm button hover in the bus line tool while a point is waiting to be placed.
busDraw.makeLine: Touch confirm button hover in the bus line tool for a new route.
busDraw.saveRoute: Touch confirm button hover in the bus line tool when editing an existing route.
busDraw.cancel: Touch stop button hover in the bus line tool.
busDraw.twoPoints: Notice when confirming a bus route with fewer than two points.
busDraw.partNoPath: Notice when confirming a bus route that has a leg with no road path.
busDraw.minLength: Notice or hover row when a bus route is shorter than the minimum. length: "500 m" or "1,600 ft".
busDraw.cannotBus: Notice when the track model refuses a bus route for a reason other than length.
busDraw.addFailed: Notice when adding a new bus line fails.
busDraw.added: Notice after a bus line is drawn. distance: road length, "4.2 km"; cost: money, "$3.1M".
busDraw.changeFailed: Notice when changing an existing bus route fails.
busDraw.changed: Notice after a bus route is redrawn. distance: road length, "4.2 km".
busDraw.clickMake: Hover tag over the last handle of a new bus route.
busDraw.clickSave: Hover tag over the last handle of an edited bus route.
busDraw.clickDelete: Hover tag row over a clicked point of a bus route being drawn (not its active end): a click deletes the point and the route joins the points either side.
busDraw.rightClose: Hover tag row over the first point of a bus route being drawn, three points or more: a right click (or a held finger) joins the last point back to it, making the route a loop, and makes the line.
busDraw.rightLoopBack: Hover tag row over a point partway along a bus route being drawn: a right click (or a held finger) joins the route's end back to this point, so the bus runs out, round the loop and back the way it came. Makes the line.
busDraw.rightStopLooping: Hover tag row over any point of a bus route that runs out, round a loop and back: a right click (or a held finger) takes out the loop's closing leg, so the route ends where the loop ended.
busDraw.rightOpen: Hover tag row over any point of a closed bus loop: a right click (or a held finger) opens the loop there, the route then ending at this point.
busDraw.loopClosed: Shown when the player clicks the map to add a point to a bus route that is a loop, or that runs out, round a loop and back. A right click on any of its points opens it.
busDraw.dragMove: Hover tag row over a bus route handle.
busDraw.rightDelete: Hover tag row over a bus route handle.
busDraw.roadCost: Hover tag row in the bus line tool. distance: "4.2 km"; cost: money, "$3.1M"; more: true when redrawing a built route (the cost is the extra road only).
busDraw.stops: Hover tag row in the bus line tool: stops on the route. count: 6.

capacityKinds.fullAt: Alert title for a full resource tied to a station. title: capacityKinds.<kind>Title, "Platform"; place: the station's name, "Canal St", shown as a link.
capacityKinds.fullNear: Alert title for a full resource near a station. title: capacityKinds.<kind>Title, "Junction"; place: the station's name, "Canal St", shown as a link.
capacityKinds.fullNoPlace: Alert title for a full resource with no station to name. title: capacityKinds.<kind>Title, "Track".
capacityKinds.tip: Hover of a full resource, three lines. cause and help: the capacityKinds.<kind>Cause and Help sentences; ways: each, both or none; most: the trains an hour it takes, 12. vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
capacityKinds.held: Line alert: trains the line owns but cannot run. n: 2. vehicle: train or tram.
capacityKinds.heldTip: Hover on the held-trains alert, after its figure. vehicle: train or tram.
capacityMarkers.use: Hover tag over a capacity dot on the map, first row. kind: the bottleneck's short name, "Platform" or "Single track"; load: "85%" or ">100%".
capacityMarkers.tph: Hover tag over a capacity dot, second row. now: trains per hour running, "12"; max: the most the spot takes, "15". vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
capacityMarkers.slows: Hover tag over a capacity dot, third row. demand: the demand level in force, "high"; wait: each train's wait, "2 min". vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
capacityMarkers.slowsThis: Hover tag over a capacity dot, third row, when the demand level is not known. wait: "2 min". vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
cities.profitTip: First line of the hover on a profit figure in the Cities tab. yesterday: true when it is yesterday's ledger; name: a city name or "all cities"; money: e.g. "$1.2M".
cities.fares: Line of the profit hover. money: the day's fare income, e.g. "$3.4M".
cities.running: Line of the profit hover. money: what running trains cost that day, usually negative, e.g. "-$1.1M".
cities.upkeep: Line of the profit hover. money: upkeep cost that day, e.g. "-$0.3M".
cities.newTrains: Line of the profit hover, shown only when trains were bought. money: e.g. "-$2M".
cities.construction: Line of the profit hover, shown only when something was built. money: e.g. "-$5M".
cities.pointsPast: First line of the hover on a points figure. points: e.g. "1,200"; city: a city name.
cities.pointsRate: Second line of the hover on a points figure. points: e.g. "900"; day: a day-type phrase such as "on an average day" or "on weekdays".
cities.pointsRule: Third line of the hover on a points figure. trip and km: points per trip and per kilometre, e.g. 10 and 2.
cities.pointsPastAll: First line of the hover on the points figure of the All cities row. points: e.g. "1,200".
cities.starTip: Hover of the star beside a city that reached its star goal. when: e.g. "Monday, day 71, at 14:08"; city: a city name; share: e.g. "10".
cities.all: Name of the first row of the Cities tab, which sums every city the player has built in.
cities.allLower: The all-cities row's name in the middle of a sentence, in cities.profitTip.
cities.where: A phrase after "Trips per day" and "train trips per day" in hovers. city: a city name; dayed: true when a day type is chosen; day: a phrase such as "on weekdays".
cities.whereAll: The same phrase for the All cities row. dayed: true when a day type is chosen; day: a phrase such as "on weekdays".
cities.allTip: Hover of the All cities name. The first line is a title. name: "All cities"; cities and stations: counts, e.g. 3 and 41.
cities.rowTip: Hover of a city's name in the Cities tab. The first line is a title. name: a city name; stations: count, e.g. 12.
cities.tripsTip: Hover of the trips figure in the Cities tab. count: e.g. "1.2M"; where: a cities.where or cities.whereAll phrase, e.g. "in Osaka on weekdays".

cityInspector.calculating: Muted line in the city view while the trips are still being worked out.
cityInspector.car: Name of the car part of a trip mode bar in the city view (hover and legend).
cityInspector.destinationTip: Hover on a row of Top destinations in the city view. count: "12,430"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; city: "Boston"; place: another city's name.
cityInspector.goTo: Hover and screen-reader label of the locate button in a city view title. city: "Boston".
cityInspector.noInter: Muted note in the city view when the city has no trips to other places.
cityInspector.noRoute: Name of the grey part of the trips-within bar in the city view: trips with no way to make them.
cityInspector.notDrawn: Muted note in the city view when the map is filtered to one trip purpose and the bubbles are not drawn.
cityInspector.partTip: Hover on one part of a trip mode bar in the city view. name: the mode, "Train"; count: "12,430"; kind: within (trips inside the city) or inter (to and from other places); city: "Boston"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; share: "42%".
cityInspector.plane: Name of the plane part of the to-other-places bar in the city view.
cityInspector.toOther: Row label in the city view: trips between this city and other places.
cityInspector.toOtherTip: Hover on the To other places row of the city view.
cityInspector.topDestinations: Muted heading in the city view above the three biggest places trips go to.
cityInspector.totalTip: Hover on the figure of a trips row in the city view. count: "12,430"; kind: within or inter; city: "Boston"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays".
cityInspector.train: Name of the transit part of a trip mode bar in the city view.
cityInspector.tripsWithin: Row label in the city view: trips that stay inside the city. city: "Boston".
cityInspector.walk: Name of the walking part of the trips-within bar in the city view.
clockClient.notSave: Error shown when the file picked to open is not a game save.
clockClient.noStorage: Error shown when opening a file or backup fails because the browser gives no storage.
clockClient.cannotStart: Shown on the failure screen when the simulation's worker did not start. why: the browser's error text, in English.
clockClient.storageUnreadable: Shown on the failure screen, under the failure sentence, when the browser's storage kept failing to read the game being opened; the game was not opened, so its save is untouched. why: the browser's error text, in English ("UnknownError: Internal error").
clockClient.drawing: Status tag while a game's network is drawn after a load.
clockClient.updating: Status tag while the network is updated after an edit that takes long.
clockClient.loaded: Notice after a game file is opened. day: the game day, 406.
clockClient.newGame: Notice after a new game starts.
clockClient.saved: Notice after saving by hand. time: the clock time in the browser's style, "3:45 PM".
clockClient.leaveView: Question before a network the player is viewing from Community (never saved) gives way to another game or the main menu. name: the network's name, "Guangzhou - kanocifer".
clockClient.leaveViewYes: Button on that question: goes on to the other game, losing the viewed network.
clockClient.leaveViewNo: Button on that question: stays on the viewed network.
clockWorker.newer: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu when the game in hand was saved by a newer version of the game, so it is not written back.
clockWorker.noStorage: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu when autosave is off because the browser gives no storage.
clockWorker.otherDevice: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu when autosave is off because the signed-in account opened the game on another device.
clockWorker.testPage: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu on a developer test page, where autosave is off.
clockWorker.viewing: Reason autosave is off while the player views a network from Community, which is kept nowhere until they save it.
clockWorker.otherTabSaved: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu when another browser tab saved the same game.
clockWorker.otherTabOpened: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu when another browser tab has the same save slot open. The player can still save by hand from this tab, which takes the slot over and turns autosave off in the other tab.
clockWorker.noLocks: Reason shown in the saves list and save menu when the browser lacks the feature that stops two tabs overwriting a save.
clockWorker.modelRestored: Notice after the train simulation hit an internal error and was rebuilt from the last edit.
clockWorker.modelDown: Notice after the train simulation hit internal errors it could not recover from.
clockWorker.savePanic: Notice when opening a save stopped the train simulation with an internal error. The game carries on without that save. why: the simulation's error text, in English.
clockWorker.browserCouldNotSave: Error shown when the browser refused to write an autosave.
clockWorker.couldNotSave: Error shown when saving by hand failed and no reason is known.
closestStations.noWalk: Value of a Closest stations row when the station cannot be reached on foot (water in the way).
closestStations.onFoot: Hover on the walking time of a Closest stations row. length: the walking distance, "350 m" or "0.2 mi".
closestStations.title: Heading above the three nearest stations on foot in a station or demand-bubble view.
closestStations.water: Hover on a Closest stations row that has no walk.
cloud.offline: Why a game was not uploaded to the account: the browser has no connection.
cloud.unreachable: Why a game was not uploaded to the account: no answer from the server. No final period.
cloud.full: Why a game was not uploaded to the account: the account has no room left.
cloud.tooBig: Why a game was not uploaded to the account: the save is over the size limit.
cloud.deleteOwed: Grey text in the saves panel or on the start menu: a game was deleted in this browser, but the server did not answer, so its copy on the player's account is deleted the next time the page reaches it.
colourPicker.area: Screen-reader label of the colour picker's square area, where one axis is saturation and the other brightness.
colourPicker.hue: Screen-reader label of the colour picker's hue strip.
colourPicker.hex: Screen-reader label of the colour picker's text box holding a colour as a hex code such as #3366cc.
common.aboutGame: Link at the foot of the start menu and of Settings that opens the game's about page on Anita's site in a new tab (what the game is, who made it, its data sources).
commutersInspector.areas: Small line under the title of the commuters view: how many map areas were picked. count: 1, 3.
commutersInspector.driving: Row label in the commuters view: trips made by car.
commutersInspector.legs: Bold row label in the commuters view above the mode rows. phrase: when the figure is for, "per day" or "on Sundays".
commutersInspector.legsTip: Hover on the area count under the title of the commuters view.
commutersInspector.noRoute: Row label in the commuters view: trips with no way to make them.
commutersInspector.only: Muted note in the commuters view when the map is filtered to one trip purpose. purpose: the purpose word, capitalised, "Commute".
commutersInspector.title: Title of the commuters view, opened by clicking a place on the commuter map. end: home (trips starting from homes here), work (trips ending here) or both.
commutersInspector.train: Row label in the commuters view: trips made by transit.
commutersInspector.walking: Row label in the commuters view: trips made on foot.
commuterView.bubble: Hover tag over a commuter bubble, first row, above a mode bar. end: home (trips start here), work (trips end here) or both; count: "12k"; words: the kind of trips, "trips"; when: a day phrase, "on a weekday".
commuterView.exploreTrip: Hover tag row over a far-end bubble of a selected commuter bubble.
commuterView.exploreWith: Hover tag row over a bubble in another place while a city is selected. name: the city, "Boston".
complexMap.boardings: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map. count: "1.2k".
complexMap.changes: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map: riders changing from this line. count: "340"; list: up to three destinations with their counts, "Line 2 at Canal St (120), Line 5 (80)".
complexMap.label: Screen-reader label of the small map of a station complex's platforms.
complexMap.lineAt: A line reached at another station of the complex, in the changes list of a platform hover. line: "Line 2"; station: the station's short name.
complexMap.linked: Hover on a link the player drew between two stations of a complex. a, b: station names; length: the distance between them, "120 m".
complexMap.noLines: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map when no line stops at it.
complexMap.riders: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map. count: "1.2k". vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
complexMap.waiting: Last line of the hover on a platform in the complex map. count: people waiting, "14"; room: how many more fit, "80"; oneSide: true when the platform has one side only, otherwise the room is on each of two sides.
constructButton.plain: Button that builds a planned line, before its price is known.
constructButton.priced: Button that builds a planned line. price: the full cost, "$12.4M".
constructButton.tipBoth: Hover on the Construct button when the line also needs vehicles bought. kind: boat, bus or line (a train line); build: the cost of the route or track, "$10M"; trains: the cost of the vehicles, "$2.4M". Reads as two costs then a sentence.
constructButton.tipBuild: Hover on the Construct button when no vehicles need buying. kind: boat, bus or line (a train line); build: the cost, "$10M".
constructButton.tipNone: Hover on the Construct button before the price is known. kind: boat, bus or line (a train line).
continents.africa: A continent's name, in the Bicontinental achievement.
continents.asia: A continent's name, in the Bicontinental achievement.
continents.europe: A continent's name, in the Bicontinental achievement.
continents.northAmerica: A continent's name, in the Bicontinental achievement. Includes Central America and the Caribbean.
continents.southAmerica: A continent's name, in the Bicontinental achievement.
continents.oceania: A continent's name, in the Bicontinental achievement.
deleteHint.title: Title of a hint toast at the map's bottom left, shown once after several deletes in a row.
deleteHint.select: Body of that hint, on a keyboard device. key: the Select tool's number key, e.g. 4.
deleteHint.selectTouch: Body of that hint on a touch device, which has no number keys.
deleteHint.heightSelect: Body of a hint toast, shown once after several single-piece height changes in a row, on a mouse device. Names the Select tool's box-drag that picks many pieces.
deleteHint.heightSelectTouch: Body of that hint on a touch device, where a box is made by holding, then dragging.
days.kindWeekday: The name of a kind of day in the Day choice and hovers: Weekday.
days.perWeekday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "12,400 trip legs per weekday".
days.onWeekday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "points on a weekday".
days.kindSaturday: The name of a kind of day in the Day choice and hovers: Saturday.
days.perSaturday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "12,400 trip legs per Saturday".
days.onSaturday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "points on a Saturday".
days.kindSunday: The name of a kind of day in the Day choice and hovers: Sunday.
days.perSunday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "12,400 trip legs per Sunday".
days.onSunday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "points on a Sunday".
days.kindHoliday: The name of a kind of day in the Day choice and hovers: Holiday day.
days.perHoliday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "12,400 trip legs per holiday day".
days.onHoliday: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "points on a holiday day".
days.kindGoingOut: The name of a kind of day in the Day choice and hovers: Going-out day.
days.perGoingOut: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "12,400 trip legs per going-out day".
days.onGoingOut: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "points on a going-out day".
days.kindComingBack: The name of a kind of day in the Day choice and hovers: Coming-back day.
days.perComingBack: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "12,400 trip legs per coming-back day".
days.onComingBack: Ends a figure for one kind of day, as in "points on a coming-back day".
days.perDay: Ends a figure for the average day, as in "12,400 trip legs per day".
days.shortMonday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Mon.
days.shortTuesday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Tue.
days.shortWednesday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Wed.
days.shortThursday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Thu.
days.shortFriday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Fri.
days.shortSaturday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Sat.
days.shortSunday: The abbreviated weekday name in a date, Sun.
days.shortMonthJanuary: The abbreviated month name in a date, Jan.
days.shortMonthFebruary: The abbreviated month name in a date, Feb.
days.shortMonthMarch: The abbreviated month name in a date, Mar.
days.shortMonthApril: The abbreviated month name in a date, Apr.
days.shortMonthMay: The abbreviated month name in a date, May.
days.shortMonthJune: The abbreviated month name in a date, Jun.
days.shortMonthJuly: The abbreviated month name in a date, Jul.
days.shortMonthAugust: The abbreviated month name in a date, Aug.
days.shortMonthSeptember: The abbreviated month name in a date, Sep.
days.shortMonthOctober: The abbreviated month name in a date, Oct.
days.shortMonthNovember: The abbreviated month name in a date, Nov.
days.shortMonthDecember: The abbreviated month name in a date, Dec.
days.shortDate: A date. month: the abbreviated month, "Feb"; day: 24.
days.dateName: A date with its weekday. weekday: "Mon"; date: days.shortDate, "Feb 24".
days.withYear: A date or date range followed by the game year, shown from year 2 on the top bar's clock and in the Money tab's all-time history when it spans over a year. date: e.g. "Mon Feb 24" or "Feb 24-Mar 2"; year: the game year, e.g. 2.
days.rangeSameMonth: A run of days in one month. month: "May"; from: 3; to: 5.
days.rangeAcross: A run of days over two months. from: "Apr 30"; to: "May 2".
days.perSuper: Ends a figure on a holiday travel day (T-264). when: the holiday and its dates, "Golden Week, May 3-5".
days.onSuper: Ends a figure on a holiday travel day (T-264). when: the holiday and its dates, "Golden Week, May 3-5".
demand.otherPlaces: Name of the rest of a region's places when one place is selected, in the inter-city list. name: the region's name, "Kanto".
demandClient.zoneFailed: Status line for a zone whose data would not load. why: the cause in English, "city pack nyc: TypeError: Failed to fetch"; retry: true when the game will try again.
demandSelector.north: Hover and screen-reader label of the needle button that appears while the map is rotated.
demandSelector.tipNone: Hover of the None button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, one capital letter, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.tipHomes: Hover of the Homes button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.tipDestinations: Hover of the Destinations button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.tipTotal: Hover of the Total button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.nothing: Hover of the greyed demand buttons when the map is over a place with no modeled region.
demandSelector.loading: Hover of the greyed demand buttons while a city's data loads. city: the city's name, e.g. "Osaka"; percent: e.g. "42".
demandSelector.calculating: Hover of the greyed demand buttons while the demand model is working.
demandSelector.group: Screen-reader label of the row of demand buttons (None, Homes, Destinations, Total).
demandSelector.none: Button in the map's demand row and in the station ridership row that turns that display off.
demandSelector.homes: Button in the map's demand row that draws bubbles where people live.
demandSelector.destinations: Button in the map's demand row that draws bubbles where people travel to.
demandSelector.total: Button in the map's demand row, and in the station ridership row, that shows both ends of trips, or all riders.
demandSelector.trackLine: Button in the track display row that colours track by line.
demandSelector.trackLineTip: Hover of the Line button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackTraffic: Button in the track display row that colours track by line and draws it thicker with more traffic.
demandSelector.trackTrafficTip: Hover of the Traffic button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackLevel: Button in the track display row that colours track by its level (underground, ground, elevated).
demandSelector.trackLevelTip: Hover of the Level button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackSpeed: Button in the track display row that colours track by its speed.
demandSelector.trackSpeedTip: Hover of the Speed button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackProfit: Button in the track display row that colours track by what it earns.
demandSelector.trackProfitTip: Hover of the Profit button in the track display row.
demandSelector.foldBubbles: Hover of the small icon that folds or opens the demand buttons row. shut: true when the row is folded away.
demandSelector.foldStations: Hover of the small icon that folds or opens the station ridership row. shut: true when the row is folded away.
demandSelector.foldTrack: Hover of the small icon that folds or opens the track display row. shut: true when the row is folded away.
demandSelector.origins: Button in the station ridership row that sizes station circles by riders starting a trip there.
demandSelector.originsTip: Hover of the Origins button in the station ridership row.
demandSelector.transfers: Button in the station ridership row that sizes station circles by riders changing lines there.
demandSelector.transfersTip: Hover of the Transfers button in the station ridership row.
demandSelector.totalTip: Hover of the Total button in the station ridership row.
demandSelector.stationGroup: Screen-reader label of the station ridership row of buttons.
demandSelector.trackGroup: Screen-reader label of the track display row of buttons.
demandSelector.purpose: Screen-reader label of the drop-down that narrows the map's demand to one trip purpose.
demandSelector.allPurposes: First option of the trip purpose drop-down on the map.
demandStopped.note: Notice at the top centre of the map when the demand model (the part that works out where people travel) has stopped for good; the game is paused when it appears. memory: true when it ran out of memory, otherwise it stopped on an error. The Reload page button sits beside it.
demandStopped.graphics: Same notice at the top centre of the map, shown when the browser took away the map's graphics (usually memory short on a phone) and did not give them back. The game is paused when it appears. The Reload page button sits beside it.
noMarketNote.text: Short note at the bottom of the map on a phone, once each time a game loads, with a close button. Phones do not work out trips that go from one city to another unless the player turns that on in Settings, to save memory.
noMarketNote.memory: Short note at the bottom of the map, once each time a game loads, with a close button. Shown when the browser reports 4 GB of memory or less; on a phone it comes first in the same note as the intercity sentence (noMarketNote.text). RAM: the device's working memory.
demandStopped.reload: Button in the demand stopped notice. Reloads the web page; the game is saved first.
diagramButton.showMap: Hover and screen-reader label of buttons that return from the network diagram to the map.
diagramButton.showDiagram: Hover and screen-reader label of the button at the top of the Cities tab that replaces the map with a schematic diagram of the player's network.
diagramButton.showWater: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle that shows or hides water on the network diagram.
diagramButton.lineWidth: Hover and screen-reader label of the slider that makes the lines and station marks on the network diagram wider.
diagramButton.savePicture: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that saves the network diagram as an image.
diagramButton.calculating: Status text beside the loading bar while the network diagram is being laid out.
dock.build: Name of the Build tab in the dock, shown in its hover and screen-reader label (the tab itself is an icon).
dock.lines: Name of the Lines tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.stations: Name of the Stations tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.finances: Name of the money tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.cities: Name of the Cities tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.tabTip: Hover of a dock tab icon. name: the tab's name (dock.build and so on); key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "1".
dock.noStations: Paragraph in the Cities tab while the player has built no stations.
dock.saves: Hover and screen-reader label of the dock button that opens the saved games panel.
dock.settings: Hover and screen-reader label of the dock button that opens the Settings tab.
edgeEdit.dragCorner: Hover over a corner handle while reshaping a curve. num: 2.
edgeEdit.cannotMove: Tag next to the cursor while dragging a corner of a curve to a spot that is refused, when no more specific reason is known.
editNote.trips: The edit note, plain text at the map's upper left for a few seconds after an edit: the change in train trips a day. change: "+1,240" or "−85", signed.
editNote.profit: The edit note's second row: the change in the network's profit a day. estimating: true while it is a quick estimate made before demand is worked out again. change: "+$1.2k" or "−$300", signed.
editNote.tripsTip: Hover of the edit note's trips row, first line: train trips a day before and after the edit. day: "per weekday" (days.perWeekday and its kin); from, to: "12,400".
editNote.lineRidersTip: Hover of the edit note's trips row, second line when the edit was to one line: that line's riders (boardings) a day before and after. line: the line's name, "Red"; from, to: "3,100".
editNote.profitTip: Hover of the edit note's profit row, first line: the network's profit a day before and after the edit. day: "per weekday"; from, to: "$12k".
editNote.lineProfitTip: Hover of the edit note's profit row, second line when the edit was to one line: that line's profit a day before and after. line: the line's name, "Red"; from, to: "$1.2k".
editNote.runningTip: Hover of the edit note's estimated profit row, one line: the change in running costs a day (a + is more cost). change: "+$800"; day: "per weekday".
editNote.faresTip: Hover of the edit note's estimated profit row, one line: the rough change in fare income a day. change: "+$1.2k"; day: "per weekday".
editNote.lineChipTip: Hover of a line's bullet in the edit note, under the line's name: its riders (boardings) a day before and after the edit. from, to: "3,100"; day: "per weekday".
fareGraph.undoLabel: Screen-reader label of the undo button beside the fare graph's heading in the Finances tab.
fareGraph.undoTip: Hover of the undo button beside the fare graph's heading.
fareGraph.zoomOut: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that shows a longer distance on the fare graph.
fareGraph.zoomIn: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that shows a shorter distance on the fare graph.
fareGraph.baseFare: Label of the first row under the fare graph: the fare for the shortest trip.
fareGraph.baseFareLabel: Screen-reader label of the base fare's stepper.
fareGraph.baseFareTip: Hover of the base fare's typed value.
fareGraph.past: Label of the last fare row under the graph. from: where the last stretch starts, e.g. "120"; unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.stretchEnd: Label of a fare row under the graph: the stretch runs from a distance to an editable distance. from: the start, e.g. "50"; end: an editable box showing the end, e.g. "120"; unit: "km" or "mi". The pieces are set tight together on purpose.
fareGraph.endLabel: Screen-reader label of the editable distance where a fare stretch ends. n: the stretch's number, e.g. 2.
fareGraph.endTip: Hover of the editable distance where a fare stretch ends. unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.rateLabel: Screen-reader label of the stepper for a fare stretch's rate. n: the stretch's number, e.g. 2.
fareGraph.rateTip: Hover of the editable rate of a fare stretch. last: true for the final stretch, which has no end; rate: e.g. "$0.12"; unit: "km" or "mi"; from and to: distances, e.g. "50" and "120".
fareGraph.perUnit: Label after a fare stretch's rate. unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.hoverTip: Hover over the fare graph: the fare at the pointer's distance. distance: e.g. "85"; unit: "km"; fare: e.g. "$4.20".
fareGraph.tickUnit: Last distance label on the fare graph's horizontal axis. value: e.g. "200"; unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.baseNodeTip: Hover of the base fare's knob on the fare graph. The first line is a title. fare: e.g. "$2.00".
fareGraph.nodeTip: Hover of a knob on the fare graph. The first line is a title. distance: e.g. "85"; unit: "km"; fare: e.g. "$4.20".
fareGraph.offTip: Hover of an arrow at the fare graph's edge that stands for a knob outside the view. first: the knob's first hover line, e.g. "300 km: $9.00".
feedbackPanel.unreachable: Error under the feedback form when the server cannot be reached.
feedbackPanel.tooMany: Error under the feedback form when the server refuses because too many messages were sent.
feedbackPanel.wrong: Error under the feedback form for any other failure.
feedbackPanel.open: Button at the foot of Settings that opens the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.empty: Message under the feedback form when Send is pressed with an empty message.
feedbackPanel.thanks: Small note that appears on the map after feedback is sent.
feedbackPanel.failed: Error under the feedback form after a failed send. reason: a sentence such as "Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.".
feedbackPanel.title: Title of the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the name box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.nameLabel: Screen-reader label of the name box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.emailPlaceholder: Placeholder of the email box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.emailLabel: Screen-reader label of the email box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.messageLabel: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the message box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.sending: Label of the send button while the feedback is being sent.
feedbackPanel.send: Submit button of the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.tagsLabel: Screen-reader label of the three tag buttons under the feedback message box.
feedbackPanel.tagLanguage: Tag button under the feedback message box. Means the game's language in general: translation problems, or not liking the English text. Narrow button.
feedbackPanel.tagError: Tag button under the feedback message box, for a bug or a wrong figure. Narrow button.
feedbackPanel.tagFeature: Tag button under the feedback message box, for a request for something new. Narrow button.
feedbackPanel.earlier: Heading above the list of the player's earlier feedback, below the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.you: Label above a message in a feedback thread that the player wrote.
feedbackPanel.anita: Label above a message in a feedback thread that Anita (the game's maker) wrote. A name, kept as is.
feedbackPanel.newReply: Screen-reader label of the small dot that marks a reply not yet read, on the Submit feedback button, the Settings tab and a feedback row.
feedbackPanel.hasReply: Hover on the Submit feedback button and a second line on the Settings tab's hover, while a reply to the player's feedback is unread.
feedbackPanel.replyLabel: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the box for writing back in an open feedback thread.
feedbackPanel.sendReply: Button under the box for writing back in a feedback thread.
feedbackPanel.delete: Button in an open feedback thread that deletes it; pressed again, it confirms the delete.
feedbackPanel.deleteConfirm: Question under an open feedback thread after Delete feedback is pressed.
feedbackPanel.keep: Button beside the delete confirmation that cancels the delete.
feedbackPanel.browserOnly: Note above the earlier feedback list when the player is signed out: the list lives in this browser only.
feedbackPanel.loadFailed: Error under the feedback form when the list of earlier feedback could not be loaded.
feedbackPanel.tooManyThreads: Error after a failed send: the player has the most feedback threads the server allows.
feedbackPanel.threadLong: Error after a failed reply: the thread has the most messages the server allows.
feedbackPanel.full: Error after a failed send or reply: the server's feedback store is full.
ferryDraw.tagFar: Tag next to the cursor in the ferry line tool when the pointer is too far from water.
ferryDraw.tagOnWater: Tag next to the cursor in the ferry line tool when the pointer is on open water.
ferryDraw.tagPath: Tag next to the cursor in the ferry line tool when no water route joins two ports.
ferryDraw.notLoaded: Notice in the ferry line tool when the water data has not loaded.
ferryDraw.sayOnWater: Notice after a click on open water in the ferry line tool.
ferryDraw.sayFar: Notice after a click too far from water in the ferry line tool.
ferryDraw.sayPath: Notice in the ferry line tool when no water route joins the ports.
ferryDraw.pathBetween: Notice in the ferry line tool when no water route joins two neighbouring ports. a, b: port names, "Pier 9" and "Harbour Quay".
ferryDraw.port: The name a new port gets if the name lookup fails.
ferryDraw.makeLine: Touch confirm button hover in the ferry line tool for a new route.
ferryDraw.saveRoute: Touch confirm button hover in the ferry line tool when editing an existing route.
ferryDraw.cancel: Touch stop button hover in the ferry line tool.
ferryDraw.twoPorts: Notice when confirming a ferry route with fewer than two ports.
ferryDraw.addFailed: Notice when adding a new ferry line fails.
ferryDraw.added: Notice after a ferry line is drawn. distance: route length, "12 km"; cost: money, "$8.4M".
ferryDraw.changeFailed: Notice when changing an existing ferry route fails.
ferryDraw.changed: Notice after a ferry route is redrawn. distance: "12 km".
ferryDraw.needTwoPorts: Notice when removing ports from a ferry line in the line panel would leave fewer than two.
ferryDraw.clickMake: Hover tag over the last handle of a new ferry route.
ferryDraw.clickSave: Hover tag over the last handle of an edited ferry route.
ferryDraw.clickDelete: Hover tag row over a placed port of a ferry route being drawn (not its active end): a click takes the port out of the line.
ferryDraw.rightClose: Hover tag row over the first port of a ferry route being drawn, three ports or more: a right click joins the last port back to it, making the line a loop, and makes the line.
ferryDraw.rightLoopBack: Hover tag row over a port partway along a ferry route being drawn: a right click joins the route's end back to this port, so the boats run out, round the loop and back the way they came. Makes the line.
ferryDraw.rightStopLooping: Hover tag row over any port of a ferry line that runs out, round a loop and back: a right click takes out the loop's closing leg, so the line ends where the loop ended.
ferryDraw.rightOpen: Hover tag row over any port of a closed ferry loop: a right click opens the loop there, the line then ending at this port.
ferryDraw.loopClosed: Shown when the player clicks the map to add a port to a ferry line that is a loop, or that runs out, round a loop and back. A right click on any of its ports opens it.
ferryDraw.rightDelete: Hover tag row over the active end of a ferry route being drawn: a right click takes that port out.
ferryDraw.stopAt: Hover tag over an existing port the ferry route does not use yet. name: "Pier 9".
ferryDraw.placePort: Hover tag over a shore spot where a port can go.
ferryDraw.ports: Hover tag row in the ferry line tool: ports on the route. count: 3.
format.perSqFt: A land price per area, US customary units. amount: "$186".
format.perM2: A land price per area, metric. amount: "$2,000".
format.distanceOf: A train's place along its line in the train view, "1.2 of 5.4 km". part: the distance run so far, "1.2"; whole: the line's length with its unit, "5.4 km".
format.distUnit: The long distance unit written out inside price rules ("$9 per train-km"). us: true when the player uses US units.
format.runCostRule: Hover on the train running cost. train: "$9"; car: "$2"; unit: "km" or "mile" (format.distUnit).
format.upkeepRule: The track upkeep prices, one phrase, read inside format.upkeepText (T-2676: a viaduct's price, the other levels as multiples of it). viaduct, station, under: prices such as "$50k" (under: per underground station, station: per other station); ground, cut, bored: multiples of the viaduct's price such as "0.7x"; unit: "km" or "mile".
format.upkeepLines: Hover on the Upkeep row of the money panel: seven lines, one per line break (T-2676: a viaduct's price, then each other level as a multiple of it; the sixth is the underground station price). viaduct, station, under: prices such as "$50k" (under: an underground station, station: any other); ground, cut, bored: multiples of the viaduct's price such as "0.7x"; unit: "km" or "mile"; hsr: the high-speed multiplier, "1.5".
format.levelUpkeepLine: A line in the hover of an elevation level, under the construction cost multiple (trackPrice.cost). mult: the level's track upkeep as a multiple of a viaduct's, e.g. "0.7x" (T-2676).
format.runCostLine: Hover on the Running trains row. train: "$4"; car: "$2"; unit: "km" or "mile".
format.runCostHere: A line under the Running trains row's hover, for the country the Money tab shows when its running costs are not the base prices (T-2669). name: a country name ("Mexico"); factor: "0.39x", that country's running costs as a multiple of the prices above.
format.runCostLineFactor: A line in the line panel's train length hover when the line's running costs are not the base prices (T-2669: priced by the countries it runs through). factor: "0.39x", a multiple of the per-km prices on the line above.
format.trainCostLine: Hover on the train length control. train: "$4"; car: "$2"; unit: "km" or "mile".
format.upkeepText: A hover explaining track upkeep. lead: the start of the sentence, "Upkeep" or "Once constructed, upkeep"; rule: format.upkeepRule; hsr: "1.5"; single: "0.5".
format.boats: A count of ferry boats. n: 3.
format.busRunRule: The bus running cost. amount: "$3"; unit: "km" or "mile".
format.busRouteRule: The price of a bus route in the Construct list. amount: "$1M"; unit: "km" or "mile".
format.boatRunRule: The ferry boat running cost. amount: "$40"; unit: "km" or "mile".
format.headwayNone: The gap between trains when a line has no trains in that period.
format.levelHighViaduct: Name of elevation level +3 (track on a tall bridge).
format.levelViaduct: Name of elevation levels +1 and +2 (track on a bridge).
format.levelCutCover: Name of elevation level -1 (a tunnel dug from the surface).
goalTicks.when: A moment in the game: weekday name, game day number, clock time. weekday: "Monday"; day: "71"; time: "14:08".
goalTicks.tip: Hover of a goal tick over a city's mode split bar. star: true for the star goal; reached: true when the player has reached it; share: the goal's transit share, e.g. "20"; city: the city's name; when: goalTicks.when text such as "Monday, day 71, at 14:08" (empty when not reached).
goalTicks.real: Hover of the real-world marker on a city's mode split bar. share: e.g. "12.3"; city: the city's name; dayed: true when a day type is shown; day: a phrase such as "on weekdays".
gradeMarks.rampUp: Hover tag title over a ramp mark on the map. level: "Level 2".
gradeMarks.rampDown: Hover tag title over a portal mark on the map. level: "Ground level".
gradeMarks.badCross: Hover tag over a red crossing mark where two tracks cross on a ramp.
gradeMarks.junction: Hover tag title over a junction mark.
gradeMarks.crossing: Hover tag title over a crossing mark.
gradeMarks.tramYields: Hover tag line on a flat crossing where a tram track crosses rail track: the tram is the one that waits.
gradeMarks.converging: Hover tag over a red mark where pieces of one-way single track point into each other, so no train can run on them.
gradeMarks.diverging: Hover tag over a red mark where pieces of one-way single track point away from each other, so no train can get onto them.
gradeMarks.blueprint: Hover tag row under a mark on blueprint track.

groupInspector.fewer: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a group view that lists only the main stops.

groupInspector.none: Shown in the group view when the group no longer exists.
groupInspector.passes: Line of the hover on a row of the group diagram: the lines that pass without stopping. list: line names joined by commas.

groupInspector.removeStop: Hover on a stop in the group diagram while the group's stops are edited. line: the line's coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
groupInspector.shiftEnd: Second line of the remove-stop hover in the group diagram. line: the line's coloured bullet.
groupInspector.stops: Line of the hover on a row of the group diagram: the lines that stop there. list: line names joined by commas.
groupInspector.stopsAt: Hover on a stop in the group diagram. line: the line's name or coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
groupInspector.stopsHeading: Heading of the stops diagram in a group view.
groupInspector.turnsBack: Hover on the end stop of a line in the group diagram. line: the line's coloured bullet; station: the station's name.

junctionInspector.remove: Button in a junction view that removes a blueprint flyover.
junctionInspector.route: A route through a junction, named by the two ports it joins. from, to: port names, such as a station name or a compass direction.
junctionInspector.routes: Heading in a junction view above the list of routes.
junctionInspector.routesCols: Small right-aligned caption on the Routes heading of a junction view: what the two figure columns are.
junctionInspector.saves: Row label in a junction view: the waiting a flyover would save per train.
junctionInspector.savesFigure: Value of the Waiting it saves row in a junction view. time: "12 s"; demand: inspector.demand.
junctionInspector.sub: Line under the title of a junction view. level: "1"; ports: how many tracks meet, "4"; flying: true when it has a flyover.
junctionInspector.title: Title of the junction view.
junctionInspector.wait: Note in a junction view when routes through it cross on the level.
keepDot.behindTip: Hover of the dot beside the search button when the playing game's latest change has not reached the account. The first line is a title. why: the reason, a sentence such as "You are offline."; retry: true when clicking the dot can help.
keepDot.tipAccount: Hover of the dot beside the search button when the game exists only in this browser and accounts are available. The first line is a title.
keepDot.tipDownload: Hover of the dot beside the search button when the game exists only in this browser and there is no account server. The first line is a title.
keepDot.label: Screen-reader label of the dot beside the search button.
leaderboard.value: A score in a leaderboard row. points: a short number, e.g. "1.2k".
leaderboard.pointsRule: Second line of the hover on a score in a leaderboard row. trip and km: points per trip and per kilometre, e.g. 10 and 2.
leaderboard.valueTip: Hover of a score in a leaderboard row. points: a number, e.g. "1,200"; world: true on the world board; city: the city's name on a city board, e.g. "Osaka".
leaderboard.sandbox: Note at the foot of the leaderboards while a sandbox game is being played.
leaderboard.signIn: Button at the foot of the leaderboards, for a signed-out player, that opens the account panel.
leaderboard.leave: Button at the foot of the leaderboards that removes the player's name from them.
leaderboard.name: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the box where the player types the name shown on the leaderboards.
leaderboard.join: Button that puts the player on the leaderboards under the typed name.
leaderboard.pick: Screen-reader label of the search box that picks which leaderboard to show.
leaderboard.world: Option of the leaderboard drop-down for the worldwide board.
leaderboard.thisGame: Group heading in the leaderboard drop-down for the cities the current game has points in.
leaderboard.otherCities: Group heading in the leaderboard drop-down for all other cities with a board.
leaderboard.loading: Shown in the leaderboards while the rows load.
leaderboard.nobody: Shown in the leaderboards when a board has no rows.
leaderboard.title: Title of the leaderboards panel, and hover and screen-reader label of the trophy button that opens it.
lineActions.defaultName: The name a new line starts with, saved with the line. n: 3.
lineFigures.pendingNew: Small muted label beside a line's riders figure (Lines tab, line view) while its riders are worked out: a line that has just started running, or one whose stops or service the player changed. Any figure beside it is the line's last one. Anita's chosen word for both.
lineGroup.leave: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that takes a line out of its group.
lineGroup.open: Hover on a group's bullet in a line view.
lineGroup.openNamed: Hover on a group's bullet in a line view when the bullet shows the name shortened: the full name, then the action. name: the group's name.
lineGroup.partOf: Row in a line view when the line is in a group. group: the group's bullet (a coloured pill, clickable), so the sentence reads "Part of [A] group".
lineInspector.add: Button in a line view while its stops are edited that adds the passed stations as stops. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
