lineInspector.addTip: Hover on the button that adds the passed stations between two stops. names: the station names as a list, "A and B".
lineInspector.andMore: A shortened list of names. list: the first names joined by commas, "A, B, C"; count: how many more there are, 2.
lineInspector.behindLine: Name of a place where a line loses time, in the round trip rows of a line view: it follows slower trains of another line. line: the other line's name. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.behindSlower: Row label and place name in the round trip rows of a line view: time spent following slower trains. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.broken: Alert in a line view when a track it used has been removed.
lineInspector.busyTrack: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time lost waiting for track in use.
lineInspector.cancel: Button in a line view that drops the stations picked to add as stops.
lineInspector.carry: Hover on the train length figure of a line view. cars: a count with its noun, "8 cars"; rated: riders at the normal load, "1,280"; crush: riders at the most, "1,920".
lineInspector.constructed: Notice after constructing a rail line. name: the line's name; price: "$12M". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.copySchedule: Screen-reader label of the button in a line view that copies the line's schedule.
lineInspector.copyScheduleTip: Hover on the button that copies the line's schedule. text: a short description of the schedule.
lineInspector.dwell: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time standing at stops.
lineInspector.editStops: Button label in a line view that starts editing the line's stops.
lineInspector.editTip: Hover on the Edit stops button. S is the keyboard shortcut.
lineInspector.expand: Button under a train length the platforms cannot fit, that lengthens the platforms. one: true when one station needs it; priced: true when it costs money; price: "$1.2M".
lineInspector.expandTip: Hover on the Expand button. count: stations to lengthen; names: their names as a list; length: the new platform length, "200 m"; cars: the new train length, "10 cars". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.extraCars: Line of the Expand hover: the cars the longer trains need. price: "$1.2M".
lineInspector.fastTip: Hover on the High speed choice of a line view.
lineInspector.fasterTrains: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time standing at passing tracks. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.finishTip: Hover on the Edit stops button while stops are being edited. S is the keyboard shortcut.
lineInspector.fits: Hover on the Train length label: the shortest platform limits the train. length: "200 m"; name: the station's name; cars: "10 cars". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.flatCrossing: Hover on a mark in a line view's stops list where the route crosses other track on the level. hasNear: true when a station is near; near: its name; hasOthers: true when other lines use the crossing; list: their names joined by commas.
lineInspector.flatJunction: Hover on a mark in a line view's stops list where the route joins other track on the level. hasNear: true when a station is near; near: its name; hasOthers: true when other lines use it; list: their names joined by commas.
lineInspector.free: Line of the Expand hover: platforms in the blueprint cost nothing.
lineInspector.heldLevel: Detail line under a capacity alert in a line view. level: High, Medium or Low; text: how long trains are held, from the capacity wording.
lineInspector.improvements: Section heading at the foot of a line view, above the buttons that add passing tracks and parking lots.
lineInspector.hideRelated: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a line view that stops drawing the lines related to this one.
lineInspector.highSpeed: Choice in a line view for the line's kind of train.
lineInspector.bothWays: Segmented choice in a line view, for a loop line: its trains, buses or boats go round in both directions, half each way.
lineInspector.direction: Label of a row in a line view, for a loop line, beside the choice of One way or Both ways.
lineInspector.oneWay: Segmented choice in a line view, for a loop line: every vehicle goes round in one direction only.
lineInspector.topSpeed: Label of a row in a rail line view, under the round trip rows: the fastest the line's trains get on its route. The value is a speed such as 160 km/h.
lineInspector.limit: Short toggle button beside the Top speed row of a rail line view. Pressed, the line's trains are held to a speed limit the player sets in the row below; a verb, as the button's label.
lineInspector.speedLimit: Label of the row with the speed limit stepper in a rail line view (shown while the Limit button is on). The value is a speed such as 120 km/h.
lineInspector.oneWayTip: Hover on the One way choice of a loop line: the direction it goes round is the one the player drew it in.
lineInspector.lap: Bold row label in the round trip rows of a loop line: the time of one lap.
lineInspector.lineNum: Name for a line that has none, in a flat crossing hover. num: the line's number.
lineInspector.normal: Choice in a line view for the line's kind of train.
lineInspector.normalTip: Hover on the Normal choice of a line view.
lineInspector.openLoop: Hover on the button that removes the last stop of a loop line, opening the loop.
lineInspector.passed: Button in a line view while its stops are edited, for stations the line passes without stopping. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
lineInspector.passingAdded: Notice after adding passing tracks to the blueprint. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
lineInspector.passingBuilt: Notice after building passing tracks. stations: a count with its noun; price: "$1.2M"; extra: true when the change also bought trains; trains: their cost. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.passingButton: Button under the Line improvements heading at the foot of a line view; the price shows small on a line under it, so the label has no price.
lineInspector.passingTip: Hover on the Add passing tracks button. names: the station names as a list.
lineInspector.parkingAdded: Notice after adding parking lots to the blueprint at the line's stations. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
lineInspector.parkingAllButton: Button under the Line improvements heading: builds a parking lot at every station of the line that lacks one. The price shows small under it.
lineInspector.parkingAllDone: Hover on the disabled Add parking at all stations button.
lineInspector.parkingBuilt: Notice after building parking lots. stations: a count with its noun; price: "$1.2M".
lineInspector.parkingEndsButton: Button under the Line improvements heading: builds a parking lot at the line's end stations (one for a loop line) that lack one. The price shows small under it.
lineInspector.parkingEndsDone: Hover on the disabled Add parking at end stations button.
lineInspector.parkingTip: Hover on the Add parking buttons. names: the station names that would get a parking lot, as a list.
lineInspector.pasteCut: Second line of the Paste the schedule hover. name: the station's name; cars: the copied train length, "10 cars"; cap: what fits, "8 cars". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.pasteNone: Hover on the disabled Paste the schedule button.
lineInspector.pasteSchedule: Screen-reader label of the button in a line view that pastes a copied schedule.
lineInspector.pasteScheduleTip: Hover on the Paste the schedule button. from: the line copied; text: a short description of the schedule.
lineInspector.reach: First line of the hover on a stop's time in a line view. speed: "120 km/h". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.removeStop: Screen-reader label of the button that removes a stop while stops are edited. name: the station's name.
lineInspector.reverseTip: Hover on the U-turn mark of a stop where trains reverse. time: "2m00s". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.reversing: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time reversing at stops in the middle.
lineInspector.ridersUnit: Unit text after the percents in the purpose split of a line view, as in purposeSplit.words: "Commute: 42% of riders".
lineInspector.roundTrip: Bold row label in the round trip rows of a line view: the time of a round trip.
lineInspector.running: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time spent moving.
lineInspector.shiftEnd: Second line of the remove-stop hover in a line view.
lineInspector.sortStops: Button in a line view's Stops heading while its stops are edited, on a line whose stop order the player set by dragging. It gives the order back to the game.
lineInspector.sortStopsTip: Hover on the Sort stops button in a line view.
lineInspector.orderNoTrack: Refusal when the player drags a stop to a new place in a line's stop list. a, b: station names, "Canal St".
lineInspector.orderJunction: Refusal when the player drags a stop to a new place in a line's stop list and the trains could not run in that order. a, b: station names, "Canal St". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.showRelated: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a line view that draws the lines related to this one.
lineInspector.spotAt: Name of a place where a line loses time, in the round trip rows. name: the station's name.
lineInspector.spotPlace: Name of a place where a line loses time, in the round trip rows. kind: junction, crossing, merge or track; hasNear: true when a station is near; near: its name.
lineInspector.stopEditing: Button label in a line view while its stops are being edited.
lineInspector.stops: Heading of the stops list in a rail line view.
lineInspector.stretch: Hover on a stretch of the stops diagram in the Traffic view. from, to: stop names; count: riders, "12,400"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; filtered: true when the map shows one trip purpose; purpose: its name.
lineInspector.sub: Line under the title of a rail line view. fast: true for a high-speed line; count: stops; distance: route length, "12.4 km".
lineInspector.takeOut: Hover on the button that removes a stop while stops are edited.
lineInspector.tooClose: Last line of the hover on a stop's time: the train never reaches the top speed between the stops.
lineInspector.tooShort: Muted line under the train length when platforms are too short. count: stations; to: the train length wanted, 10. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.trainLength: Row label in a line view: how many cars a train has. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.trainLengthLabel: Screen-reader label of the train length stepper. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.trains: Row label in a line view beside the Normal and High speed choice. vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.turnEnd: Row label in the round trip rows of a loop line: time turning round at the one end.
lineInspector.turnEnds: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time turning round at the two ends.
lineInspector.waitSpot: Name of a place where a line waits for faster trains, in the round trip rows. name: the station's name; faster: true when faster lines are known; list: their names as a list, "Express and Local". vehicle: train or tram.
lineInspector.why: Second line of the hover on a stop's time in a line view: what limits the speed. why: top, track, street (tram track laid along streets), tram (tram track off the streets), curve or crossover; speed: "120 km/h". vehicle: train or tram.
lineProfile.along: Close-up hover over a rail line's cross section (a side view of the line on the ground's height): how far along the line the middle of the close-up is. {distance} like "2.4 km", {stop} the line's first stop's name.
lineProfile.crosses: Close-up hover over a line's cross section: another line's track crosses this line's here. {lines} is one or more small line bullets (nodes), {count} how many lines, {height} like "10 m"; dir up: the other track is above this line's track, down: below, other: at the same height.
lineProfile.ground: Close-up hover over a line's cross section: the ground's height at the middle of the close-up. {height} like "23 m".
lineProfile.groundUnknown: Close-up hover over a line's cross section, when the ground heights could not be downloaded.
lineProfile.heading: Section heading at the foot of a rail line's view, over a side view of the whole line drawn on the ground's real height.
lineProfile.track: Close-up hover over a line's cross section: the track's level at the middle of the close-up. {level} like "−1" or "+2", {height} like "5 m"; dir up: viaduct, down: below ground, over: a bridge over water, under: a tunnel under water, other: at ground level.
lineProfile.water: Close-up hover over a line's cross section, where the line is over water (sea, river or lake): the water surface's height. sea true when it is at sea level; {height} like "12 m".
lineRunning.idle: Extra hover line on a line's bullet when the line has no trains.
linesTab.planned: Word in a line's row in the Lines tab when the line is drawn but has no trains yet.
linesTab.broken: Word in a line's row in the Lines tab when the line cannot run, for example because its route is cut.
linesTab.pendingTip: Hover of the riders figure of a line while its riders are worked out again.
linesTab.ridersTip: Hover of a line's riders figure in the Lines tab. count: e.g. "12.3k".
linesTab.vehiclesTip: Hover of a bus or ferry line's vehicles figure. period: the time of day, e.g. "Morning peak"; vehicles: e.g. "3 buses".
linesTab.groupRidersTip: Hover of a group's riders figure. count: e.g. "45k"; lines: one row per line, each "Name: figure", separated by line breaks.
linesTab.groupProfitTip: Hover of a group's money figure. money: e.g. "$1.2M"; lines: one row per line, each "Name: amount", separated by line breaks.
linesTab.groupTrainsTip: Hover of a group's vehicles figure (trains, trams, buses and boats together). period: the time of day, e.g. "Morning peak"; count: e.g. 8; lines: one row per line, each "Name: count", separated by line breaks.
linesTab.ridersToday: Small note at the foot of the Lines tab. count: riders on all lines in the past 24 hours, e.g. "120k".
linesTab.cityTip: Hover of the city column of a line in the Lines tab. city: a city name.
linesTab.closeGroup: Hover and screen-reader label of the chevron on an open group of lines.
linesTab.openGroup: Hover and screen-reader label of the chevron on a closed group of lines.
linesTab.groupName: Screen-reader label of the box where a group of lines is renamed.
linesTab.lineName: Screen reader name of the box for renaming a line in the Lines list.
linesTab.newLineTip: Hover of the New line button in the Lines tab. key: its keyboard shortcut, "N".
linesTab.newLine: Button in the Lines tab that starts a new train line.
linesTab.newBusTip: Hover of the new bus line button in the Lines tab. key: its keyboard shortcut, "U".
linesTab.newBus: Screen-reader label of the new bus line button in the Lines tab.
linesTab.newFerryTip: Hover of the new ferry line button in the Lines tab. key: its keyboard shortcut, "O".
linesTab.newFerry: Screen-reader label of the new ferry line button in the Lines tab.
linesTab.none: Shown in the Lines tab when the game has no lines at all.
linesTab.noneHere: Shown in the Lines tab when there are lines but none in the viewed place.
linesTab.colName: Column heading of the line name column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortName: Hover of the Name column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colCity: Column heading of the city column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortCity: Hover of the City column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colRiders: Column heading of the riders column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortRiders: Hover of the Riders column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colMoney: Column heading of the profit column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortMoney: Hover of the Money column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colTrains: Column heading of the vehicles column in the Lines tab (trains, trams, buses and boats): the number of vehicles the line needs. Keep it short, the column is narrow.
linesTab.sortTrains: Hover of the Vehicles column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colNear: Column heading of the distance column in the Lines tab, shown while sorting by distance.
linesTab.sortNear: Hover of the Near column heading in the Lines tab.
lineTitle.edit: Hover and screen-reader label of the line badge button in a line view title; it opens the editor.
lineTitle.show: Hover and screen-reader label of the locate button in a line view title.
lineTitle.symbol: Label of the symbol input in the line editor: the letter or sign shown in the line's badge.
lineTitle.symbolLabel: Screen-reader label of the symbol input in the line editor.
links.pickStation: Notice while linking stations with a passage, when the pick is not a station.
links.pickAnother: Notice while linking stations with a passage, when the same station was picked twice.
links.alreadyComplex: Notice while linking stations with a passage. name: the station's name, "Canal St".
links.tooFar: Notice while linking stations with a passage. name: the station's name; away: "2.3 km"; reach: "1 km".
links.built: Notice after a passage between two stations is built. a, b: station names; cost: "$15M".
links.added: Notice after a passage between two blueprint stations is added. a, b: station names.
links.removed: Notice after a passage between two stations is removed. a, b: station names.
listParts.near: Hover on the distance column of the Lines and Stations lists. distance: a short distance, e.g. "1.2 km".
listParts.noLines: Hover on the place button above the Lines and Stations lists when the viewed place has no lines. name: a city or region, e.g. "Osaka".
listParts.nothingHere: Hover on the disabled place button above the Lines and Stations lists when the map is over a place the game has no data for.
listParts.only: Hover on the place button above the Lines and Stations lists: the list is limited to the viewed place. name: a city or region, e.g. "Osaka".
listParts.world: Globe button above the Lines and Stations lists: shows every place, not only the one in view. Hover and screen reader name.
loadBar.game: Loading card and status tag: the stage while the game itself loads.
loadBar.data: Loading card and status tag: the stage while a city's data loads.
loadBar.demand: Loading card and status tag: the stage while the demand model runs.
loadBar.fewSeconds: Loading card: the time left, under 5 seconds.
loadBar.seconds: Loading card: the time left in seconds, rounded to 10. n: 30.
loadBar.oneMinute: Loading card: the time left, between 55 and 90 seconds.
loadBar.minutes: Loading card: the time left in minutes. n: 3.
loading.stalledSeconds: Loading card, shown when nothing has arrived for a while. n: seconds, rounded down to 10, 30.
loading.stalledMinutes: Loading card, shown when nothing has arrived for a while. n: minutes, 2.
loadingScreen.backToStart: Button on the screen shown when loading fails, beside Try again. Opens the start menu (the page without its game choice). Shown only when the address names a game to load.
loadingScreen.demandTimeout: Message on the loading failure screen when nothing has moved for a long while and the game had started. time: loadingScreen.minutes, e.g. "3 minutes".
loadingScreen.loaded: Hover on the loading bar: two lines. pct: percent done, e.g. 42; step: the stage being loaded, e.g. "Loading demand".
loadingScreen.minutes: A length of time, used inside loadingScreen.demandTimeout and loadingScreen.simTimeout. count: 3.
loadingScreen.pageStopped: Message on the loading failure screen after an error while the game was starting. reason: the browser's error text, e.g. "Script error." (stays in English).
loadingScreen.playWithoutDemand: Button on the screen shown when the demand figures fail to load. Starts the game with no passenger demand.
loadingScreen.playWithoutIntercity: Button on the out of memory screen, and in the notice at the top of the map when demand runs out of memory. Reloads the same game with trips between cities turned off, which takes less memory. Button: keep it short.
loadingScreen.seconds: A length of time, used inside loadingScreen.demandTimeout and loadingScreen.simTimeout. count: 30.
loadingScreen.simTimeout: Message on the loading failure screen when the train simulation never started. time: loadingScreen.minutes, e.g. "3 minutes".
loadingScreen.tryAgain: Button on the screen shown when loading fails. Reloads the page.
loadText.outOfMemory: Shown on the loading screen when the browser ran out of memory, on a phone or tablet.
loadText.outOfMemoryDesktop: Shown on the loading screen when the browser ran out of memory, on a computer.
loadText.outOfMemory32: Shown on the loading screen when the browser ran out of memory and the browser is a 32-bit program, which can use far less memory than a 64-bit one.
loadText.failed: Shown on the loading screen when loading failed for any reason except memory.
mareyChart.close: Hover on the cross button of the timetable chart.
mareyChart.closeLabel: Screen-reader label of the cross button of the timetable chart.
mareyChart.hide: Hover and screen-reader label of the schedule heading button while the timetable chart is open.
mareyChart.hideOthers: Hover and screen-reader label of the timetable chart's toggle while other lines' trains are drawn on it.
mareyChart.label: Screen-reader label of the timetable chart panel. line: the line's name, "Line 4".
mareyChart.otherTip: Hover on another line's train where it shares track with the charted line, in the timetable chart. line: that line's name, "Line 4"; from, to: that line's end stations; leave, arrive: clock times, "7:42 AM".
mareyChart.passTip: Hover on a dot where another line's train crosses the charted line's path at a flat junction or flat crossing, in the timetable chart. line: that line's name, "Line 4"; time: a clock time, "7:42 AM".
mareyChart.show: Hover and screen-reader label of the schedule heading button while the timetable chart is closed.
mareyChart.showOthers: Hover and screen-reader label of the timetable chart's toggle while other lines' trains are hidden.
mareyChart.tip: Hover on one train's path in the timetable chart. from, to: the end stations' names; leave, arrive: clock times, "7:42 AM".
marketTrip.accessTip: Hover of the first row of an inter-city train route (getting to the first station). min: 12 min.
marketTrip.airDollarWeight: Last line of the plane's effective time hover. amount: what one US dollar is in the shown currency, e.g. "$1", "¥150" (T-2798); w: 1.5.
marketTrip.pricePer: A price per distance in a hover of the inter-city trip panel, in a currency other than US dollars (marketTrip.centsPer is the dollar's). amount: e.g. "¥22", "£0.12"; unit: km or mile.
marketTrip.airFareTip: Hover of the plane trip's fare row. fare: $50. rate: 12 cents per km.
marketTrip.airportDrives: Row label in the plane section of the inter-city panel: minutes driving to and from the airports.
marketTrip.airportDrivesTip: Hover of the plane trip's airport drives row. from, to: 25 min.
marketTrip.andOthers: Name of a group of far ends in the inter-city panel. place: Philadelphia. count: 2. whole: true when the ends are whole places, false when they are 6 km areas.
marketTrip.atAirports: Row label in the plane section: minutes at the airports.
marketTrip.atAirportsTip: Hover of the plane trip's time-at-airports row.
marketTrip.betweenPlaces: Heading of the trips by mode between two places in the inter-city panel.
marketTrip.bothWays: Ends a trips phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers, for trips between two places in both directions.
marketTrip.byPlane: Heading of the plane section of the inter-city panel.
marketTrip.centsPer: A price per distance in a hover of the inter-city trip panel. cents: 12. unit: km or mile.
marketTrip.commuteOf: Phrase ending 'of' in the mode hovers under Commutes. amount: 12k. who: a phrase such as 'between the two ends, both ways'.
marketTrip.commuteTip: Hover of the legs count in the Commutes heading. amount: 12,400. day: on weekdays. who: a phrase such as 'between the two ends, both ways'.
marketTrip.commutes: Heading of the commutes by mode between two zones.
marketTrip.count: Summary line of the inter-city panel. kind: total (all kinds of trips), inter (inter-city trips only), under (less than one trip). amount: 312k.
marketTrip.crossingLabel: Row label for a crossing on a car trip in the inter-city panel. kind: channel (the English Channel by Le Shuttle or ferry), tsugaru (Aomori to Hakodate), or any other car ferry.
marketTrip.crossingTip: Hover of a crossing row on a car trip. kind: channel, tsugaru or ferry. usd: $150. people: 2. min: 60. hours: 4. distance: 35 km. wait: 90 min.
marketTrip.dollarWeight: Last line of the car's effective time hover in the inter-city panel. amount: what one US dollar is in the shown currency, e.g. "$1", "¥150" (T-2798); w: 1.5.
marketTrip.driveRouted: Hover of the Drive row of a car trip between places. road: 320 km.
marketTrip.driveRule: Hover of the Drive row of a car trip when the road is estimated. road: 320 km. speed: 80 km/h. detour: 1.3. fixed: 10.
marketTrip.egressTip: Hover of the last row of an inter-city train route (leaving the last station). min: 12 min.
marketTrip.everyUser: Note under the transit section when the main route carries all the transit riders. cities: true when the ends are whole cities.
marketTrip.everyday: Heading of the everyday trips (errands, visits, school, medical) by mode between two neighbouring areas.
marketTrip.everydayOf: Phrase ending 'of' in the mode hovers under Everyday trips. amount: 12k.
marketTrip.everydayTip: Hover of the legs count in the Everyday trips heading. amount: 12,400. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
marketTrip.flight: Row label in the plane section: minutes in the air.
marketTrip.flightTip: Hover of the plane trip's flight row. distance: 900 km. speed: 800 km/h. fixed: 30. direct: true when a direct flight exists. oneHour: true when a change adds exactly an hour. minutes: 90.
marketTrip.from: Last row of an inter-city train route. station: the last station's name (clickable).
marketTrip.interCity: Heading of the inter-city trips by mode when commutes or everyday trips are shown too.
marketTrip.interCityPeriod: Caption at the right of the train heading. period: morning peak.
marketTrip.kindCount: One entry of the hover's list of what the trips are. amount: 9k.
marketTrip.legsCount: Caption at the right of a heading: how many trip legs (one way of a round trip). amount: 312k.
marketTrip.longerTip: Hover of the summary line and the Inter-city trips heading. amount: 12,400. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'. where: 'between the two ends, both ways'.
marketTrip.noRail: Shown in the inter-city panel under the transit heading when transit is not offered. why: farClosed (the far end is closed), unmatched (no homes there), or noRail.
marketTrip.noRoad: Shown in the car section of the inter-city panel when no road links the places.
marketTrip.noStation: Shown in the inter-city panel under the train heading when some ends have no station. kind: one (a single end has none), either (both ends have none), many. place: a place name. count: how many more ends have none.
marketTrip.of: Phrase ending 'of' in the inter-city mode hovers ('Train: 45% of ...'). counted: true when at least half a trip is counted. amount: 9k. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
marketTrip.pairOf: Phrase ending 'of' in the mode hovers under 'Between the two places' ('Train: 45% of ...'). amount: 12k.
marketTrip.pairTip: Hover of the trips count in the heading 'Between the two places'. amount: 12,400. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'. a, b: place names.
marketTrip.pairsTip: Hover of the note on the main route's share. n: 12.
marketTrip.parkingTip: Hover of the Parking row of a car trip. people: 2.
marketTrip.partOf: Name of one 6 km area of a place in the inter-city panel. place: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.partsOf: Name of a group of 6 km areas of one place in the inter-city panel. count: 3. place: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.periodTip: Hover of a row in the transit share by period list of the inter-city panel. period: Morning peak. amount: 12,400. share: 45%.
marketTrip.possible: Row label: the share of trips transit can serve.
marketTrip.repTip: Hover of the caption at the right of the train heading. period: morning peak. picked: true when the player picked the period.
marketTrip.rivalRow: Row label: the effective time by car or plane on the trips the train can serve.
marketTrip.rivalTip: Hover of the row comparing transit with the car or plane.
marketTrip.routeTip: Hover of a route row in the list of other routes of the inter-city panel. names: Red Line then Blue Line. from, to: station names. share: 12.3%. counted: a clause such as ', 12% of the 312k counted here' or empty. time: 95 min.
marketTrip.running: Row label in the car section of the inter-city panel: fuel and tolls in dollars.
marketTrip.runningTip: Hover of the Running costs row. rate: 12 cents per km. people: 2.
marketTrip.shareUsers: Note under the transit section. share: 78%. cities: true when the ends are whole cities.
marketTrip.stationTip: Hover of the Time row of an inter-city train route. terms: 'wait 12 + ride 80 + walk between stations 3'. total: 95 min.
marketTrip.straightCenters: Hover of the distance line when the far end is closed.
marketTrip.to: First row of an inter-city train route. station: the first station's name (clickable).
marketTrip.totalTip: Hover of the summary line when commutes or everyday trips are counted too. amount: 12,400. day: on weekdays. where: 'between the two ends, both ways'. parts: '9k inter-city trips, 3k commute legs'.
marketTrip.trainOthersTip: Hover of the caption at the right of the transit heading. period: morning peak. picked: true when the player picked the period.
marketTrip.tripsCount: Caption at the right of a heading: how many trips. amount: 312k.
marketTrip.untilFlight: Row label in the plane section: minutes waiting for a flight.
marketTrip.untilFlightTip: Hover of the plane trip's wait row.
marketTrip.whereAveraged: Last line of the car's effective time hover: what the figure is averaged over.
marketTrip.whereCenters: Last line of the car's effective time hover: what the figure is measured between.
marketTrip.whereFrom: Ends a trips phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.whereTo: Ends a trips phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.whoHome: Ends a commutes phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.whoWork: Ends a commutes phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
memoryCheck.zones: Shown when a save is too big for the browser's memory. zones: how many zones the save covers, 40; gb: the memory one calculation needs, "5.2".
memoryCheck.device: Grey text on the start menu, with a Load anyway button beside it, when a save may be too big for the device. The browser only guesses the device's memory, so this is a warning. need: "3.5".
modal.close: Screen reader name of the X button on every centred panel (saved games, account, leaderboards).
modal.closeTip: Hover on the X button of every centred panel. Esc is the Escape key.
modeBar.purposeErrands: A row in the hover on a demand bubble coloured by trip purpose, after a red dot: the share of its trips for leisure or errands. share: "65%".
modeBar.purposeOther: A row in the hover on a demand bubble coloured by trip purpose, after a green dot: the share of its trips for anything but work, school, leisure and errands. share: "2%".
modeBar.purposeWork: A row in the hover on a demand bubble coloured by trip purpose, after a blue dot: the share of its trips for work or school. share: "35%".
moneyHistory.allCities: In moneyHistory.title and moneyHistory.ridesTitle, where the scope is the whole network rather than one city: "Revenue and expenses in all cities".
moneyHistory.construction: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the one-off costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$6,000".
moneyHistory.expenses: The coloured word inside moneyHistory.title: the red bars. Starts lowercase in English because it follows "and".
moneyHistory.fares: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart. amount: money, e.g. "$3,400", with "/day" when the column is an average.
moneyHistory.history: Heading of the history section of the Money tab.
moneyHistory.loan: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart: loan repayments. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$500".
moneyHistory.newTrains: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the one-off costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$2,000".
moneyHistory.oneOff: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart: new trains plus construction. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$8,000".
moneyHistory.year: A label under the Money tab's all-time history charts, at the column where a game year starts, shown when the history spans over a year. year: the game year, e.g. 2.
moneyHistory.perDay: Appended to a money figure or count in the Money tab's history charts when a column covers several days and shows a daily average. Example: "$1,200/day".
moneyHistory.revenue: The coloured word inside moneyHistory.title: the blue bars.
moneyHistory.rides: Line in the hover on a bar of the transit rides chart. count: a number of rides, e.g. "12,400", with "/day" when the column is an average.
moneyHistory.ridesTitle: Title above the second history chart. where: a city name, or moneyHistory.allCities.
moneyHistory.running: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart: running plus upkeep. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$1,200".
moneyHistory.runningTrains: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the running costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$900".
moneyHistory.soFar: Heading line of a history chart hover for the day or hour still in progress. when: a date, a date range or a date and hour, e.g. "Mon Apr 14".
moneyHistory.span1d: Button in the Money tab history's span switch: the past 24 hours, by hour. d is day.
moneyHistory.span30d: Button in the Money tab history's span switch: the past 30 days, by day.
moneyHistory.spanAll: Button in the Money tab history's span switch: every day kept.
moneyHistory.title: Title above the first history chart. revenue: moneyHistory.revenue and expenses: moneyHistory.expenses, each coloured to match its bars; where: a city name, or moneyHistory.allCities.
moneyHistory.upkeep: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the running costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$300".
moneyTab.backTo: Hover on the undo button beside a fare multiple. value: the multiple it returns to, e.g. "1.00x".
moneyTab.backToDefault: Screen reader name of the undo button beside a country's fare multiple.
moneyTab.backToUsual: Screen reader name of the undo button beside the high speed or ferry fare multiple.
moneyTab.boatTip: Hover on the Boats owned row. price: money, e.g. "$3M"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$60 per boat-km"; port: money, e.g. "$20M".
moneyTab.boatsBought: Hover on the number of boats owned. boats: a count with its noun, e.g. "3 boats"; price: money, e.g. "$3M"; total: money, e.g. "$9M".
moneyTab.boatsCost: Last line of the hover on the Running trains row, when the network has boats. rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$60 per boat-km".
moneyTab.boatsNeeded: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.boatsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.boatsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.tramCarsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list. Its value is how many tram cars the player has bought.
moneyTab.tramCarsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list: owned tram cars that no running line needs.
moneyTab.tramCarTip: Hover on the Tram cars owned row. price: money, such as $2M. rule: the running cost rule, such as $4 per train-km plus $2 per car-km.
moneyTab.borrow: Row label in the Money tab's loan section, beside three amount buttons.
moneyTab.borrowTip: Hover on a Borrow amount button. amount: money, e.g. "$1B"; payment: money, e.g. "$40M"; days: 30.
moneyTab.borrowed: Row label in the Money tab's loan section: the amount of the loan taken.
moneyTab.boughtAll: Hover on the New trains row of the Money tab when the network has buses and boats.
moneyTab.boughtBoats: Hover on the New trains row of the Money tab when the network has boats.
moneyTab.boughtBuses: Hover on the New trains row of the Money tab when the network has buses.
moneyTab.built: Row label in the Money tab: the value of what the player has constructed.
moneyTab.busFare: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the bus fare multiple.
moneyTab.busFareRow: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for bus lines.
moneyTab.busFareTip: Hover on the Bus fare row and its number field.
moneyTab.busTip: Hover on the Buses owned row. price: money, e.g. "$500k"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$40 per bus-km"; route: a cost rule for building a bus route, e.g. "$1M per km".
moneyTab.busesBought: Hover on the number of buses owned. buses: a count with its noun, e.g. "12 buses"; price: money, e.g. "$500k"; total: money, e.g. "$6M".
moneyTab.busesCost: Second line of the hover on the Running trains row, when the network has buses. rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$40 per bus-km".
moneyTab.busesNeeded: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.busesOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.busesSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.carTip: Hover on the Cars owned row. price: money, e.g. "$2M"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$300 per car-km".
moneyTab.carsBought: Hover on the number of cars owned. count: 120; price: money, e.g. "$2M"; total: money, e.g. "$240M".
moneyTab.carsNeeded: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list: the cars the running lines call for.
moneyTab.carsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list. A car is one rail vehicle of a train.
moneyTab.carsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list: cars owned beyond what the lines need.
moneyTab.cash: Row label at the top of the Money tab: the money on hand.
moneyTab.construction: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: the cost of building track and stations.
moneyTab.countryFares: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for one country. name: a country name, e.g. "Japan".
moneyTab.countryFaresTip: Hover on the country fare multiple's number field: what the number is. name: the country the row is for, e.g. "Mexico"; ref: the reference country, whose fares the number is a multiple of, e.g. "United States". Both are bare country names with no article.
moneyTab.daysLeft: Row label in the Money tab's loan section: days until the loan is paid off.
moneyTab.fare: Heading of the fare graph section in the Money tab.
moneyTab.fareImpact: Hover on the figures of the Riders per day and Fares per day rows under the fare graph.
moneyTab.fareScale: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets a country's fare multiple.
moneyTab.fares: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: income from fares.
moneyTab.faresPerDay: Row label under the fare graph: the estimated change in fare income from the fare being edited.
moneyTab.ferry: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for ferry lines.
moneyTab.ferryFare: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the ferry fare multiple.
moneyTab.ferryTip: Hover on the Ferry fare row and its number field.
moneyTab.hsCarTip: Hover on the High-speed cars owned row. price: money, e.g. "$4M"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$500 per car-km".
moneyTab.hsCarsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.hsCarsRunning: Hover on the number of high-speed cars owned. count: how many the lines need, e.g. "48".
moneyTab.hsCarsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.hsr: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for high speed lines.
moneyTab.hsrFare: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the high speed fare multiple.
moneyTab.hsrTip: Hover on the High speed fare row and its number field.
moneyTab.interest: Hover on the loan's payment per day. rate: a percentage without the sign, e.g. "0.5".
moneyTab.ledgerLoan: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: loan repayments.
moneyTab.loan: Heading of the loan section at the bottom of the Money tab.
moneyTab.loanFirst: Hover on a disabled Borrow button, before the game has a full day of fares. amount: the smallest loan, written with its unit in the shown currency, e.g. "$1B".
moneyTab.loanRefused: Hover on a disabled Borrow button when the loan is too big for the profits. payment: money, e.g. "$80k"; yesterday: true when only one day is known; days: how many days were averaged, e.g. 5; profit: money, e.g. "$20k".
moneyTab.loanTerm: Hover on the Loan row of the Money tab's ledger. days: the loan's length, e.g. 30.
moneyTab.makeRef: Screen reader name, and first line of the hover, of the icon button beside a country's fare multiple that makes that country the reference country (the one every other country's fare multiple is measured against).
moneyTab.makeRefSame: Second line of the make-reference button's hover: switching the reference country changes no fare actually charged, only what 1.00x means.
moneyTab.net: Last row of the Money tab's ledger: the day's total.
moneyTab.newTrains: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: the cost of vehicles bought.
moneyTab.paymentPerDay: Row label in the Money tab's loan section.
moneyTab.referenceTip: Hover on the reference country's fixed 1.00x in the Money tab's fare rows: a heading line, then a sentence. name: the reference country, a bare country name with no article, e.g. "United States".
moneyTab.regionSplit: Hover on the place button above the Money tab's ledger: how a region's money is counted.
moneyTab.repay: Button in the Money tab's loan section: pays off the whole loan.
moneyTab.repayNeeds: Hover on the disabled Repay button. amount: money, e.g. "$800M".
moneyTab.repayTip: Hover on the Repay button when there is enough cash. amount: money, e.g. "$800M".
moneyTab.ridersPerDay: Row label under the fare graph: the estimated change in riders from the fare being edited.
moneyTab.runningTrains: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: the cost of running vehicles.
moneyTab.sinceDay1: Row label at the top of the Money tab in sandbox games: money made since the start (there is no cash figure).
moneyTab.sinceDay1Tip: Hover on the Since day 1 row of the Money tab.
moneyTab.today: Column heading of the Money tab's ledger.
moneyTab.trains: Heading of the fleet section in the Money tab.
moneyTab.transferFare: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the extra fare when a trip changes lines.
moneyTab.transferFareLabel: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the transfer fare.
moneyTab.transferTip: Hover on the transfer fare's number field.
moneyTab.upkeep: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: the upkeep of track and stations.
moneyTab.yesterday: Column heading of the Money tab's ledger.
moneyText.fares: Second line of the hover on a line's money figure. amount: money, e.g. "$3,400".
moneyText.profit: First line of the hover on a line's money figure (Lines tab, line and bus panels). amount: money, e.g. "$1,200".
moneyText.running: Third line of the hover on a line's money figure: the cost of running the vehicles. kind: boats, buses or trains; amount: money, usually negative, e.g. "-$900".
moneyText.upkeep: Fourth line of the hover on a line's money figure: the upkeep of the track and stations. amount: money, usually negative, e.g. "-$300".
nameEdit.done: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that closes a line's name editor.
nameEdit.name: Screen-reader label of the text box where a station or line name is edited.
nameEdit.rename: Screen-reader label of the pencil button beside a station or line name.
nameEdit.renameTip: Hover on the pencil button beside a station or line name.
networkTips.riders: Hover tag over a station's ridership circle in Total mode, first row. n: "12k"; when: a day phrase, "on a weekday".
networkTips.entries: Hover tag over a ridership circle in Total mode: riders who start their trip here. n: "9k".
networkTips.transfers: Hover tag over a ridership circle in Total mode: riders changing trains here. n: "3k".
networkTips.use: Hover tag over a ridership circle when only entries or only transfers are drawn. mode: origins or transfers; n: "9k"; when: a day phrase.
networkTips.allPurposes: Hover tag row under a ridership circle's figures: the circles count every purpose even when a purpose filter is on.
networkTips.train: Hover tag title over a train, tram, bus or boat on the map. name: the line's name without its own mode's word ("53" for "Bus 53"), "Line 4". vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
networkTips.calculating: Hover tag row while the demand figures for a train, station or circle are not ready.
networkTips.onBoard: Hover tag row over a train: riders on board against the most it carries. n: "85"; cap: "120"; full: true when at its limit; est: true while the line's figures are still an estimate.
networkTips.nobody: Hover tag over a station when no one is waiting. tram: true for a tram stop or tram track, otherwise a train's.
networkTips.fullestFull: Hover tag row over a station dot: its fullest platform is full. tram: true for a tram stop or tram track, otherwise a train's.
networkTips.fullestPct: Hover tag row over a station dot. share: a whole number, "60". tram: true for a tram stop or tram track, otherwise a train's.
networkTips.waiting: Hover tag over a station: riders waiting. n: "45".
networkTips.toStation: Label of a waiting-riders row in a station hover: the direction of the platform. name: the terminus, "Canal St".
networkTips.toEnd: Label of a waiting-riders row in a station hover when the terminus has no name.
networkTips.blueprint: Hover tag row for a station that is planned but not built.
networkTips.shared: Hover tag row over a station upgrade: how many stations of the complex share it. count: 3.
newGame.back: Button on the new game sheet that goes back to the previous screen.
newGame.chooseOnMap: Button on the new game sheet: start with the world map and pick the place there.
newGame.currentLocation: Button on the new game sheet: start in the zone around the player's location.
newGame.downloadFailed: Error under the new game sheet when the real rail network of the chosen start city fails to download. city: a city name, e.g. "Tokyo".
newGame.findCity: Placeholder and screen reader name of the city search box on the new game sheet.
newGame.locating: The Current location button while the browser is working out where the player is.
newGame.locationUnavailable: The Current location button after the browser refused or did not answer.
newGame.matched: Small grey text after a city name in the search results, when the text typed matched an alternative name instead. alias: the other name, e.g. "The Hague". Starts with a comma.
newGame.normal: Button on the new game sheet: the game mode with limited money.
newGame.or: Small word between the start city buttons, the search box and the Choose on map button.
newGame.realNetwork: Label of a drop-down list on the new game sheet (sandbox only) of the cities whose real rail lines a game can start with already built.
newGame.realTip: Hover on the Real world network list once a city is picked. city: a city name, e.g. "Tokyo".
newGame.sandbox: Button on the new game sheet: the game mode with unlimited money.
newGame.sandboxTip: Hover on the Sandbox button of the new game sheet.
newGame.start: Button that starts the new game on the world map, when no city is chosen.
newGame.startIn: Label before the row of start city buttons on the new game sheet.
newGame.startInCity: Button that starts the new game. city: a city name, e.g. "Tokyo".
newGame.tier: Short light word after a city's name in the new game sheet's search results: how hard a game started there is. Lowercase in English. tier: easy, medium or hard. Use the words games use for difficulty levels; short.
newGame.title: Heading of the new game sheet.
newVersion.note: Notice at the top centre of the map when part of the page could not be loaded because the game was updated while this tab was open. The Reload button sits beside it.
newVersion.reload: Button in the new version notice. Reloads the web page; the game is saved first. Short, one word if the language has one.
nodeDrag.builtFixed: Notice when pressing on a built node to drag it.
nodeDrag.cannotMoveThis: Notice after dropping a dragged node on a spot that is refused with no reason given.
nodeDrag.cannotMove: Tag next to the cursor while dragging a node to a spot that is refused, when no more specific reason is known.
oneRider.aStation: Stands in for a station with no name in a random rider's From and To rows.
oneRider.another: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that draws another random rider.
oneRider.car: Row label in the random rider section: the time the same trip takes by car.
oneRider.carTip: Hover on the By car row of the random rider section; the share of people choosing each mode may follow on a second line.
oneRider.chances: Second line of the By train and By car hovers. period: the time-of-day period in lower case, "morning"; train, drive: whole percents, "42%".
oneRider.drawnFrom: First line of the hover on the Purpose row of the random rider section; the purposes with their shares follow, one per line. count: riders, "1,240"; period: the time-of-day period in lower case, "morning".
oneRider.from: Row label in the random rider section: where the trip starts.
oneRider.fromTip: Hover on the From row of the random rider section. name: the station's name.
oneRider.noCar: Hover on the none shown for By car when the car time could not be worked out.
oneRider.noSplit: Hover on the Purpose row of the random rider section before the split exists.
oneRider.noTrain: Hover on the none shown for By train when no transit route exists.
oneRider.none: Value of the By train or By car row in the random rider section when there is no time.
oneRider.open: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that opens the random rider's trip in the trip view.
oneRider.purpose: Row label in the random rider section: why the rider travels.
oneRider.tip: Hover on the Random rider heading of a train view. vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
oneRider.title: Heading of the section in a train view that shows one randomly drawn rider.
oneRider.to: Row label in the random rider section: where the trip ends.
oneRider.toTip: Hover on the To row of the random rider section. name: the station's name.
oneRider.train: Row label in the random rider section: the time the trip takes by transit.
oneRider.trainTip: Hover on the By transit row of the random rider section; the share of people choosing each mode may follow on a second line.
periods.morningPeak: Name of a time of day (06:00 to 10:00) in the line schedule and demand views.
periods.midday: Name of a time of day (10:00 to 16:00) in the line schedule and demand views.
periods.eveningPeak: Name of a time of day (16:00 to 20:00) in the line schedule and demand views.
periods.evening: Name of a time of day (20:00 to 24:00) in the line schedule and demand views.
periods.night: Name of a time of day (00:00 to 06:00) in the line schedule and demand views.
purposeBreakdown.allModes: Button in the Trip purposes section: count trip legs by every mode.
purposeBreakdown.barsTip: Hover on the trip legs figure in the Trip purposes section, explaining the mirrored bars of each purpose.
purposeBreakdown.coverAirport: Hover on the Airport purpose name in the Trip purposes section.
purposeBreakdown.coverAttraction: Hover on the Attraction purpose name in the Trip purposes section.
purposeBreakdown.coverMedical: Hover on the Medical purpose name in the Trip purposes section.
purposeBreakdown.coverSchool: Hover on the School or University purpose name in the Trip purposes section.
purposeBreakdown.legs: Muted line at the top of the Trip purposes section. count: "12.4k"; rail: true when only transit legs are counted; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays".
purposeBreakdown.noAirport: Item in the list of purposes missing from this city (purposeBreakdown.notModeled).
purposeBreakdown.noMedical: Item in the list of purposes missing from this city (purposeBreakdown.notModeled).
purposeBreakdown.noSchool: Item in the list of purposes missing from this city (purposeBreakdown.notModeled).
purposeBreakdown.noTrips: Screen-reader label of the empty purpose pie.
purposeBreakdown.noUniversity: Item in the list of purposes missing from this city (purposeBreakdown.notModeled).
purposeBreakdown.notModeled: Hover on the Trip purposes heading, naming trip purposes the game has no data for here; the first letter is capitalised in code. list: "school attendance and airport passengers"; count: how many items the list has.
purposeBreakdown.outward: Direction name in the hover on the bars above the line of a purpose's hourly chart: trips from home to the destination.
purposeBreakdown.returning: Direction name in the hover on the bars below the line of a purpose's hourly chart: trips back home.
purposeBreakdown.shares: Screen-reader label of the purpose pie. parts: the purposes with their shares joined by commas, "Commute 42%, Shopping 18%".
purposeBreakdown.slotTip: Hover on one bar of a purpose's hourly chart. dir: purposeBreakdown.outward or returning; span: the time span of the bar, "7-9 AM"; count: legs in that span, "1.2k"; rail: true when only transit legs are counted; perHour: legs per hour, "600"; share: whole percent of the day's legs, "12%".
purposeBreakdown.title: Heading of the section that splits trips by purpose, in the line, station and city views.
purposeBreakdown.trainOnly: Button in the Trip purposes section: count train trip legs only.
purposeBreakdown.words: Hover on the purpose pie and its legend. name: the purpose, "Commute"; count: "12.4k"; rail: true when only transit legs are counted; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; share: whole percent, "42%".
purposeBreakdown.working: Hover on the spinner shown in the Trip purposes section while demand is still being calculated.
purposes.work: Name of a trip purpose: commuting to work, in the purpose filter and breakdowns.
purposes.school: Name of a trip purpose: school and university trips, shown together.
purposes.university: Name of a trip purpose in the model; the game shows it as School, so it rarely appears.
purposes.errands: Name of a trip purpose: shopping and other errands.
purposes.leisure: Name of a trip purpose: social and leisure trips.
purposes.medical: Name of a trip purpose: trips to hospitals and clinics.
purposes.airports: Name of a trip purpose: trips to airports.
purposes.attractions: Name of a trip purpose: trips to tourist attractions.
purposes.intercity: Name of the purpose that holds the longer trips between cities.
purposes.all: The purpose filter's choice that shows every purpose.
purposes.airportWord: The airport purpose written lowercase inside a sentence, before "trips": "airport trips".
purposeSplit.label: Screen-reader label of the thin bar splitting riders by trip purpose. parts: the purpose lines joined with semicolons, each from purposeSplit.words.
purposeSplit.words: Hover on one segment of the riders-by-purpose bar, and one item of its screen-reader label. name: the purpose, "Commute"; share: "42%"; unit: what is counted, "riders" or "boardings in Boston".
realmOverlay.clickLoad: Hover tag row under a region's name on the map, for a region not loaded yet.
realmOverlay.show: Accessible label of the button over a shaded region. name: the region, "Korea".
realmOverlay.tip: Hover on the button over a shaded region, under the region's name.
realSnap.noTrack: Tag next to the cursor when drawing track along the real network and no real track joins the clicked points.
relatedLayout.stops: Hover on a stop pill in the diagram of the lines related to one line. n: how many lines stop; lines: their names as a list, "A, C and E"; station: "Canal St".
relatedLayout.passes: Second line of the same hover: the lines that pass through without stopping. n: how many; lines: their names as a list.
relatedStops.add: Hover on a row for a station a line passes while its stops are being edited; a click makes it a stop. name: the station's name.
rebuild.pickTip: Hover of the disabled Rebuild button in the selection bar, when no level or track type is chosen that differs from what the selected built track has. Imperative.
rebuild.tip: First line of the Rebuild button hover; the price is the next line. length: e.g. "3.1 km"; to: what the track becomes after "to", e.g. "level +1", "high-speed track" or "level +1 and high-speed track".
rebuild.cantChange: Last line of the Rebuild button hover. Some of the selected pieces would be refused, and are outlined in red on the map. all: true when none can change, else false; one: true when only one piece is selected; n: pieces that cannot change, e.g. 3; total: pieces selected, e.g. 12.
rebuild.question: The question before rebuilding built track (game/rebuild.ts). Rebuilding changes the same track and stations to a new level or track type and charges the full price of them new, with nothing back for the old. what: e.g. "3.1 km of built track and 2 built stations"; to: e.g. "level +1 and high-speed track"; price: e.g. "$412M"; some: true when some selected pieces cannot change; n: those pieces, e.g. 3; total: pieces selected, e.g. 12.
rebuild.yes: The confirm button of the rebuild question. Same word as blueprint.rebuild.
rebuild.no: The cancel button of the rebuild question: leave the track as it is. Same meaning as remove.no.
rebuild.done: Notice after built track was rebuilt. n: pieces, e.g. 12; to: e.g. "level +1 and high-speed track".
rebuild.doneSome: Notice after built track was rebuilt when some pieces could not change. done: 9; n: 12; to: e.g. "level +1"; skipped: 3.
rebuild.none: Notice when a rebuild changed nothing.
remove.question: The question before removing something constructed or something that changes a line (game/remove.ts). what: a remove.* phrase such as "the built station Canal St" or "1.2 km of track"; built: true when constructed.
remove.questionBig: The question before deleting a lot of track at once. what: "48.0 km of track" (remove.track); built: true when constructed.
remove.no: Button in the remove question that cancels.
remove.yesBig: Button in the big delete question.
remove.noBig: Button in the big delete question that cancels.
remove.crossover: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done. built: true when constructed.
remove.track: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done. length: "1.2 km" or "0.75 mi"; built: true when constructed.
remove.building: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done. name: the station building's name, "Canal St".
remove.station: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done. name: the station's name, "Canal St"; built: true when constructed.
remove.flyover: A noun phrase for remove.question and remove.done. built: true when constructed.
remove.someStation: Stands in for a station with no name in remove.lineEffect's list.
remove.lineEffect: A row under the remove question, one per line affected. effect: lose (loses stops), stop (its route breaks) or both; line: the line's name, "Line 4"; count: how many stops it loses; stations: their names as a list, "Canal St and Spring St".
remove.done: The notice after a removal. what: a remove.* phrase such as "the flyover".
remove.failed: The notice when a removal failed with no reason given.
reversalMarks.reverses: Hover tag row over a reversal mark: a line that turns round here. name: "Line 4".
reversalMarks.limit: Hover tag row over a reversal mark. n: 12; end: true when the mark is at the end of a track (one side only).
routeParts.aLine: Stands in, in lower case, for a line with no name inside a route's name row of a trip view.
routeParts.aLineCap: Stands in, capitalised, for a line with no name at the start of a ride row of a trip view.
routeParts.byPeriod: Heading above the transit share of each time-of-day period in a trip view.
routeParts.clickToShow: Small right-aligned caption on the Train by period heading: a click on a period shows it on the map.
routeParts.namesTo: Name of a route in a trip view. names: the lines ridden joined by routeParts.then, "Line 2 then Line 5"; to: the last station.
routeParts.onFoot: Hover on a walking change row in a trip view. min: minutes with one decimal, "2.5".
routeParts.rideTo: A ride row in a trip view: the line ridden and where it goes. change: true when the rider changes from another ride; line: the line's name, "Line 2"; bus: true when the line is a bus (the word bus follows its name); station: the station where the ride ends (a clickable name).
routeParts.then: Joins the lines of a route in its name, "Line 2 then Line 5". It starts and ends with a space.
routeParts.walkTo: A walking change row in a trip view. station: the station walked to (a clickable name).
savesPanel.account: Screen reader name of the cloud button in the head of the saved games panel when signed in: opens the account panel.
savesPanel.accountCopy: Hover on the cloud beside an other-version row that is a game on the player's account.
savesPanel.addLabel: Screen reader name of the crossed cloud button beside a game. name: the game's name, e.g. "New York".
savesPanel.addTip: Hover on the crossed cloud button beside a game that is not on the player's account.
savesPanel.backupAccount: Hover on an other-version row that is a backup on the player's account, and on its cloud.
savesPanel.backupDownloadFailed: Red text under a saved game card when downloading a backup from the player's account fails.
savesPanel.backupHere: Hover on an other-version row that is a backup kept in this browser.
savesPanel.backupPulled: Hover on an other-version row: the copy this browser had before the account's newer one replaced it.
savesPanel.browserOnly: Hover on the crossed cloud beside a game that is not on the player's account.
playtime.min: A short length of time in whole minutes, inside playtime.played. n: 25.
playtime.hours: A short length of time in whole hours. h: 3.
playtime.hoursMin: A short length of time in hours and minutes. h: 3; m: 20.
playtime.played: Quiet line on a saved game card and in the account panel: how long it has been played. time: playtime.min, playtime.hours or playtime.hoursMin, e.g. "3 h 20 min".
savesPanel.cash: Hover on the cash figure of a saved game card. amount: money, e.g. "$40M".
savesPanel.citiesMore: The cities a saved game has built in, when there are more than three. first, second: city names, e.g. "New York", "Philadelphia"; count: how many others, e.g. 2.
savesPanel.copy: Screen reader name of the copy button; also the hover of the copy button above the list when the game has no card.
savesPanel.copyName: The name given to a copy of a saved game. name: the game's name, e.g. "New York".
savesPanel.copyTip: Hover on the copy button of the game being played.
savesPanel.dateAt: A date and a clock time, in the account sync hover when it was not today. date: e.g. "Oct 24"; time: e.g. "3:31 PM".
savesPanel.day: The in-game day number on a saved game card and on its other-version rows. day: e.g. 120.
savesPanel.delete: Hover and screen reader name of the bin button on a saved game card and on an other-version row.
savesPanel.deleteFailed: Red text under a saved game card when deleting it from the player's account fails.
savesPanel.deleteGame: Button that confirms deleting a saved game with all its copies.
savesPanel.deleteGameQuestion: Question before a game is deleted with all its copies (saves panel and start menu). playing: true when it is the game being played; what: savesPanel.deleteWhat or savesPanel.deleteWhatMore; where: account, both or browser.
savesPanel.deleteVersion: Button that confirms deleting one version.
savesPanel.deleteVersionLabel: Screen reader name of the bin button on an other-version row.
savesPanel.deleteVersionQuestion: Question under an other-version row. where: account, both or browser (where the copy is kept).
savesPanel.deleteWhat: A game's name in quotes, inside savesPanel.deleteGameQuestion. name: the game's name, e.g. "New York".
savesPanel.deleteWhatMore: A game and its older copies, inside savesPanel.deleteGameQuestion. name: the game's name; versions: savesPanel.otherVersions, e.g. "3 other versions".
savesPanel.download: Hover and screen reader name of the download button on a saved game card.
savesPanel.downloadFailed: Red text under a saved game card when downloading it from the player's account fails.
savesPanel.downloadNewer: Hover on the download button of the game being played when a newer game version saved it.
savesPanel.elsewhere: Line on a saved game card: the game was opened or saved on another device in the last ten minutes.
savesPanel.elsewhereTip: Hover on the Open on another device line. date: a weekday, date and time.
savesPanel.gameDay: Hover on the day line of a saved game card. day: the in-game day number, e.g. 120.
savesPanel.keepIt: Button that cancels deleting a version or a game.
savesPanel.lastSaved: Hover on the saved-when line of a saved game card. date: a weekday, date and time, e.g. "Sat, Oct 24, 03:31 PM".
savesPanel.lines: A number of train lines, on a saved game card. count: 4.
savesPanel.loading: In the empty picture box of a saved game card while its picture loads.
savesPanel.mayBeLost: Hover on the crossed cloud in the head of the saved games panel when the browser may drop saved games.
savesPanel.nameLabel: Screen reader name of the box where a saved game is renamed.
savesPanel.newGame: Button above the list of saved games, and the title of the panel while the new game sheet is shown.
savesPanel.noPicture: In the picture box of a saved game card when it has no picture.
savesPanel.notSynced: Hover on the crossed cloud beside the game being played before its first save reached the account.
savesPanel.notSyncedWhy: Hover on the crossed cloud after the game being played failed to reach the player's account. why: the reason, a sentence from the server, e.g. "The server is busy." (stays in English).
savesPanel.nothingBuilt: In the picture box of a saved game card when the game has no lines yet.
savesPanel.onAccount: Hover on the cloud beside a game that is on the player's account (start menu).
savesPanel.onlineOnly: Hover on the cloud beside a game that is on the player's account but not in this browser.
savesPanel.open: Button on a saved game card and on its other-version rows: plays that game.
savesPanel.openFile: Button above the list of saved games: picks a .save file from the computer.
savesPanel.openFileTip: Hover on the Open a file button.
savesPanel.openTip: Hover on the Open button of a saved game card.
savesPanel.otherVersions: Button under a saved game card that lists its older copies and backups. count: 11.
savesPanel.panelTip: Hover on a city's label in a saved game's picture. name: a city name; stations: savesPanel.stations, e.g. "12 stations".
savesPanel.playing: Mark on the card of the game being played.
savesPanel.readFailed: Red text on a saved game card when downloading it fails.
savesPanel.rename: Hover and screen reader name of the pencil beside the name of the game being played.
savesPanel.sandbox: Small mark beside the name of a saved sandbox game (the mode with unlimited money).
savesPanel.sandboxTip: Hover on the small Sandbox mark beside a saved game's name.
savesPanel.copyMark: Small mark beside a saved game's name: the game is a copy of a network another player shared
savesPanel.copyMarkTip: Hover on the small Copy mark: a copied game's points are never listed on the leaderboards
savesPanel.save: Button on the card of the game being played: saves it now.
savesPanel.saveNewer: Hover on the disabled Save button when a newer version of the game saved this game.
savesPanel.saveOtherDevice: Hover on the Save button when the same game is open on another device.
savesPanel.saveOtherTab: Hover on the Save button when the same game is open in another browser tab.
savesPanel.saveTip: Hover on the Save button of the game being played.
savesPanel.notSaved: On the card of a network viewed from Community, where other cards say when they were saved.
savesPanel.viewingMark: Mark after the name of a network viewed from Community, where the game being played says Playing.
savesPanel.viewSaveTip: Hover on Save on the card of a network viewed from Community: saving makes it one of the player's saved games.
savesPanel.savedMinutes: Line on a saved game card saying when it was saved. auto: true for the game being played; count: minutes, 1 to 59 (min is short for minutes).
savesPanel.savedNow: Line on a saved game card (and on its other-version rows) saying when it was saved. auto: true for the game being played, whose saves are automatic.
savesPanel.savedOn: Line on a saved game card saying when it was saved, on an earlier day. auto: true for the game being played; date: a short date, e.g. "Oct 12"; time: a clock time, e.g. "02:05 PM".
savesPanel.savedToday: Line on a saved game card saying when it was saved, earlier today. auto: true for the game being played; time: a clock time, e.g. "02:05 PM".
savesPanel.signIn: Screen reader name of the crossed cloud button in the head of the saved games panel when signed out: opens the sign in panel.
savesPanel.signedIn: Hover on the cloud in the head of the saved games panel for a signed in account.
savesPanel.signedInAs: Hover on the cloud in the head of the saved games panel. name: the account's username.
savesPanel.signedInGoogle: Hover on the cloud in the head of the saved games panel for an account that signed in with Google.
savesPanel.signedOutTip: Hover on the crossed cloud in the head of the saved games panel when not signed in.
savesPanel.stations: A number of stations, on a saved game card, its picture and its other-version rows. count: 12.
savesPanel.typeToDelete: Label of the box to type a big game's station count in before it can be deleted. count: 240.
savesPanel.syncedAt: Hover on the cloud beside the game being played. time: a clock time, or a date and time when not today, e.g. "3:31 PM" or "Oct 24 at 3:31 PM".
savesPanel.thumbTip: Hover on the picture of a saved game card. name: the name the player gave the game, e.g. "New York".
savesPanel.title: Title of the saved games panel.
savesPanel.mainMenu: Hover on the button under the Saved games panel's close button: saves the game, then goes to the start page. Shown only while a game is open.
savesPanel.wholeNetwork: Label on the last panel of a saved game's picture when it was built in many cities: the picture of all of it.
schedule.averageLoad: Row label in a line view's past-24-hours rows: how full the vehicles ran on average.
schedule.averageSpeed: Row label in a line view: the line's average speed end to end.
schedule.buys: Line of a schedule stepper hover: the vehicles the change buys. unit: a count with its noun, "2 cars"; price: "$1.2M".
schedule.calculating: Value of the Profit row of a line view while the profit is being worked out.
schedule.demand: Column heading of the schedule table in a line view: the demand level.
schedule.demandName: A demand level's name on its own, in the schedule table and hovers. demand: high, medium or low.
schedule.departedFull: Hover on the vehicles-leaving-full figure of a line view. full, all: counts, "3" and "40"; vehicle: train, bus or boat.
schedule.frees: Line of a schedule stepper hover: the vehicles the change frees (they stay owned). unit: a count with its noun, "2 cars".
schedule.headway: Column heading of the schedule table and name of its switch in a line view: the time between vehicles.
schedule.headwayLabel: Screen-reader label of the headway stepper in a line view's schedule table, in lower case.
schedule.lapTip: Hover on a vehicle count of a loop line in the schedule table. vehicles: a count with its noun, "6 trains"; half: how many go each way, "3"; lap: the lap time, "24 min".
schedule.lapOneWayTip: Hover on a vehicle count of a loop line run one way in the schedule table. vehicles: a count with its noun, "6 buses"; lap: the lap time, "24 min".
schedule.leavingFull: Row label in a line view's past-24-hours rows. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
schedule.leftBehind: Row label in a train line view's past-24-hours rows: riders who could not board. vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
schedule.leftBehindTip: Hover on the left-at-platform figure of a train line view. left: riders left, "120"; all: riders who wanted to board, "4,800".
schedule.levelTimes: Hover on a demand level's name in the schedule table. demand: high, medium or low; hours: the hours it runs, "06:00-20:00".
schedule.limit: Says what limits a line's headway, in hovers of the schedule table. what: the place, "Terminus at West"; full: true when no more trains fit; time: the shortest headway, "4m00s". vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
schedule.limitWait: Hover on a headway that the track cannot carry. text: schedule.limit. vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
schedule.loadTip: Hover on the Average load row of a line view. day: the kind of day in lower case, "weekday" or "holiday".
schedule.many: The plural noun of a line's vehicle, in lower case. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
schedule.manyCap: The plural noun of a line's vehicle, capitalised, as a column heading or button. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
schedule.minUnit: The unit shown beside the headway box when it is typed in minutes.
schedule.noHeadway: Headway shown for a demand level with no vehicles.
schedule.profit: Row label in a line view's past-24-hours rows: today's expected profit.
schedule.recalculating: Hover on the note shown over a line view's figures while riders are worked out again after an edit.
schedule.riders: Row label in a line view's past-24-hours rows: riders in the past 24 hours.
schedule.roundTip: Hover on a vehicle count in the schedule table. vehicles: a count with its noun, "6 trains"; trip: the round trip time, "48 min".
schedule.stepperLabel: Screen-reader label of the vehicle count stepper in the schedule table. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
schedule.title: Heading of the schedule section in a line view.
schedule.uses: Line of a schedule stepper hover: the change needs no purchase. unit: a count with its noun, "2 cars".
schedule.vehicles: A count of a line's vehicles with their noun. vehicle: train, bus or boat; count: 1, 6.
schedule.waitingDemand: Hover on the spinner beside a demand level while demand is still loading.
scheduleCopy.copied: Notice after copying a line's schedule. line: the line's name, "Line 4".
scheduleCopy.countsOnly: Hover text of the schedule copy and paste buttons on or from a bus or ferry line: the vehicles per demand level. list: three counts, e.g. "4, 3 and 2"; vehicle: train, bus or boat.
scheduleCopy.headwaysOnly: Hover text of the schedule copy and paste buttons on or from a bus or ferry line: the headway per demand level. list: three headways, e.g. "8 min, 15 min and 30 min".
scheduleCopy.minutes: A time between trains. n: 5 or 2.5.
scheduleCopy.withHeadways: Hover on the paste-schedule button for a copied schedule given as gaps between trains. list: the gaps at high, medium and low demand, "3 min, 5 min and 10 min"; cars: 6; fast: true for high-speed trains.
scheduleCopy.withTrains: Hover on the paste-schedule button for a copied schedule given as train counts (the trains on the whole line, not an hourly rate). list: the counts at high, medium and low demand, "6, 4 and 2"; cars: 6; fast: true for high-speed trains. vehicle: train or tram.
scheduleCopy.tooShort: Notice after pasting a schedule onto a line whose shortest platform is too short. station: "Canal St"; wanted: 8; line: "Line 4"; kept: 6. vehicle: train or tram.
search.city: Grey word at the right of a city in the search results.
search.find: Placeholder and screen reader name of the map search box, and the screen reader name of the magnifying glass button that opens it.
search.findTip: Hover on the magnifying glass button at the map's upper left. / is the slash key.
search.line: Grey word at the right of a train line in the search results.
search.matched: Small grey line under a city in the search results when the text typed matched an alternative name. name: the other name, e.g. "The Hague".
search.none: Grey line in the search results when nothing matches.
search.placeKind: Grey word at the right of a town, neighbourhood or similar place in the search results. kind: city, town, borough, neighborhood, village or other.
search.station: Grey word at the right of a station with no lines in the search results.
search.lineListMore: The end of a list of line names in the search results, when there are more than three. names: the first three, "A, C, E"; n: 7.
settingsTab.average: Settings, Day choice (which day demand figures are for): the average day of the week. One of Average, Weekday, Sat, Sun in a narrow segmented button; keep short.
settingsTab.basemap: Settings, Map section: label of the slider that fades the base map (roads, parks, buildings) toward plain land. Narrow label beside a slider.
settingsTab.basemapTip: Hover on the Base map slider: what it sets.
settingsTab.blue: Settings, Theme: the blue colour theme, a segmented button beside Pink and Green.
settingsTab.bubbleSize: Settings, Demand bubbles section: label of the slider for the demand bubbles' size on the map. Narrow label beside a slider.
settingsTab.bubbles: Settings: section heading for how the demand bubbles (circles on the map showing trips people want to make) are drawn.
settingsTab.capacity: Settings, Show: checkbox for marks on the map where track or stations can't handle the trains scheduled.
settingsTab.capacityTip: Hover on the Track at capacity checkbox.
settingsTab.circleSize: Settings, Station circles section: label of the slider for the station ridership circles' size. Narrow label beside a slider.
settingsTab.colors: Settings, Demand bubbles: label of the choice of colour scheme for the bubbles (3-color or 2-color). Narrow label.
settingsTab.controls: Settings: hover and accessible name of the "?" icon button that opens the list of mouse and keyboard controls.
settingsTab.crowded: Settings, Show: checkbox for red marks on stretches where trains are fuller than their rated load.
settingsTab.crowdedTip: Hover on the Crowded trains checkbox. "rated load": the number of riders a train is built to carry.
settingsTab.dark: Settings, Theme: the dark shade (dark map and panels), a segmented button beside Light.
settingsTab.day: Settings, Demand bubbles: label of the Day choice. Narrow label.
settingsTab.dayOf: Hover on an icon in the Day choice for a day of a long holiday (getting away, away, coming back). holiday: the holiday's name from data, in English, "Golden Week" or "Christmas".
settingsTab.dayTip: Hover on the Day choice: it sets the day every demand figure in the game is for, not only the bubbles.
settingsTab.detail: Settings, Demand bubbles: label of the slider for how finely the bubbles are split (more and smaller, or fewer and bigger). Narrow label.
settingsTab.discord: Settings: hover and accessible name of the Discord logo icon in the top row; it opens the game's Discord server in a new tab. Keep "trainsworld" (the game's name) and "discord" as in English.
settingsTab.faces: Settings, Stations up close: checkbox for drawing the little faces of riders waiting at stations when zoomed in.
settingsTab.flat: Settings, Map: the flat map projection, a segmented button beside Globe.
settingsTab.flatMarks: Settings, Show: checkbox for marks where tracks cross or join on the same level (no flyover), which slow trains.
