settingsTab.rampMarks: Settings, Show: checkbox for the triangle and semicircle marks where track ramps up or down to another level. One word, a plural noun like the other items.
settingsTab.game: Settings: section heading for the game's mode (normal or sandbox) and the tutorial.
settingsTab.globe: Settings, Map: the globe projection, a segmented button beside Flat.
settingsTab.mapDrawn: Settings, Map: the drawn base map, a segmented button beside Satellite. One short word.
settingsTab.satellite: Settings, Map: satellite imagery under the game instead of the drawn base map, a segmented button beside Map. One short word.
settingsTab.satelliteTip: Hover on the Satellite button: the imagery is blurry in most of the world, sharp only in Japan and the US.
settingsTab.green: Settings, Theme: the green colour theme.
settingsTab.high: Settings, Map detail choice: the full base map. Short.
settingsTab.language: Settings: the language picker's name, first line of the hover on its globe icon and the select's accessible name.
settingsTab.languageAi: Settings: second line of the hover on the language picker's globe icon, so players know the translations are machine-made.
settingsTab.light: Settings, Theme: the light shade, a segmented button beside Dark.
settingsTab.lineBands: Settings, Show: checkbox for drawing lines that share track as coloured bands beside each other.
settingsTab.lineWidth: Settings, Map: label of the slider for how wide lines and track are drawn. Narrow label.
settingsTab.low: Settings, Map detail choice: a lighter base map with fewer roads. Short.
settingsTab.map: Settings: section heading for the map's projection, widths and base map.
settingsTab.mapDetail: Settings, Units and performance: label of the Auto / Low / High choice of base map detail. Narrow label.
settingsTab.mapDetailTip: Hover on the Map detail choice: what Low does.
settingsTab.mapLabels: Settings, Show: checkbox for the base map's own place and road names.
settingsTab.moreCores: Settings, Units and performance: checkbox to let the game use more CPU cores for its demand model.
settingsTab.moreCoresTip: Hover on Use more cores. "demand workers": background threads that work out demand; "Reload": reload the web page.
settingsTab.mobileIntercity: Settings, Units and performance: checkbox, shown only on phones and tablets, to calculate trips between cities (off by default).
settingsTab.mobileIntercityTip: Hover on Calculate intercity trips: a warning.
settingsTab.normal: Settings, Game: the game's mode when money counts (not a sandbox). A plain label.
settingsTab.opacity: Settings, Demand bubbles: label of the slider for the bubbles' opacity. Narrow label.
settingsTab.pink: Settings, Theme: the pink colour theme.
settingsTab.platformLoad: Settings, Riders on trains and platforms: checkbox for a patch showing how many riders wait on each platform.
settingsTab.purpose: Settings, Demand bubbles: label of the trip purpose select (work, school and the rest). Narrow label.
settingsTab.ramp0: Settings, 2-color scheme: label beside the colour picker for bubbles where 0% of trips go by transit.
settingsTab.ramp100: Settings, 2-color scheme: label beside the colour picker for bubbles where all trips go by transit.
settingsTab.realAll: Settings, Real world network: segmented button, draw every kind of track the map data has, beside None and Passenger.
settingsTab.realAllTip: Hover on the All button of the real world network setting: what All adds to passenger rail.
settingsTab.realNetwork: Settings: section heading over the choice of which real rail network is drawn faintly under the player's own (None, Passenger, All).
settingsTab.realNone: Settings, Real world network: segmented button, draw no real track, beside Passenger and All.
settingsTab.realPassenger: Settings, Real world network: segmented button, draw passenger and light rail track, beside None and All.
settingsTab.riders: Settings: section heading for how riders on trains and platforms are shown.
settingsTab.rotate: Settings, Map: checkbox; dragging with the right mouse button turns the map.
settingsTab.zoomButtons: Settings, Map: checkbox; shows the plus and minus buttons at the map's right edge.
mapZoom.in: Screen-reader label of the plus button on the map that zooms in one step (no hover).
mapZoom.out: Screen-reader label of the minus button on the map that zooms out one step (no hover).
settingsTab.runInBackground: Settings, Units and performance: checkbox; the game clock keeps running while the browser tab is hidden.
settingsTab.sandbox: Settings, Game: the sandbox mode's name (unlimited money, no leaderboard). A plain label.
settingsTab.sandboxQuestion: Confirm dialog after Switch to sandbox mode: the switch can never be undone in this game.
settingsTab.sandboxStay: Confirm dialog's cancel button: keep the normal mode.
settingsTab.sandboxSwitch: Settings, Game: button that asks to switch to sandbox mode, and the confirm dialog's button that does it.
settingsTab.sat: Settings, Day choice: Saturday, short as on a calendar. Narrow segmented button.
settingsTab.scheme2: Settings, Colors choice: bubbles shaded between two colours the player picks, by the share of trips by train. Short segmented button.
settingsTab.scheme3: Settings, Colors choice: bubbles in three colours by how people travel (train, car, walk). Short segmented button.
settingsTab.schemeColorblind: Settings, Colors choice: bubbles in two colours, blue and yellow, picked to be told apart with colour blindness. Short segmented button.
settingsTab.schemePurpose: Settings, Colors choice: bubbles in three colours by what the trips are for (work, errands and leisure, everything else). Short segmented button; the same word as the Purpose filter.
settingsTab.show: Settings: section heading over checkboxes of things drawn on the map (trains, station names, marks).
settingsTab.sound: Settings, Stations up close: checkbox for the game's sounds.
settingsTab.startAgain: Settings, Game: button beside Tutorial that restarts the tutorial.
settingsTab.stationCircles: Settings: section heading for the circles sized by each station's riders.
settingsTab.stationNames: Settings, Show: checkbox for station names on the map.
settingsTab.sun: Settings, Day choice: Sunday, short as on a calendar. Narrow segmented button.
settingsTab.terrain: Settings, Show: checkbox for hill shading on the map.
settingsTab.theme: Settings: section heading for light or dark, and the colour theme.
settingsTab.trainLoad: Settings, Riders on trains and platforms: checkbox for showing how full each train is on the map.
settingsTab.trains: Settings, Show: checkbox for the trains drawn moving on the map.
settingsTab.tutorial: Settings, Game: label of the tutorial row (a Start again button beside it).
settingsTab.uiScale: Settings: section heading over the stepper for the size of panels and their text.
settingsTab.uiScaleLabel: Settings: the panel size stepper's accessible name, read inside "Less ..." and "More ..." (in lower case in English).
settingsTab.currency: Settings, Units and performance: label of the select for the currency money is shown in (US dollar, pound, euro, RMB, yen, won). Also its accessible name (T-2798).
settingsTab.currencyTip: Hover on the Currency row once a currency other than USD is picked. rate: how many of it one US dollar buys, e.g. "0.8", "1,300"; code: "GBP", "EUR", "RMB", "JPY" or "KRW".
settingsTab.unitsPerf: Settings: section heading for units (km or miles) and performance options.
settingsTab.upClose: Settings: section heading for what is drawn at stations when zoomed right in (faces, sound).
settingsTab.usUnits: Settings, Units and performance: checkbox for miles, mph and feet instead of km, km/h and metres.
settingsTab.volume: Settings, Stations up close: label of the sound volume slider. Narrow label.
settingsTab.weekday: Settings, Day choice: a working day, Monday to Friday. Narrow segmented button.
spinner.loading: Screen reader name of the loading spinner and the little train.
splitTip.line: Hover on a mode split bar. where: the place and kind of day, " in New York on a weekday" (may be empty); body: splitTip.rides or splitTip.shares; note: " (an early estimate)" (may be empty).
splitTip.rides: The body of the mode split hover with trip counts. train, walk, drive: shares, "18.5%"; trainN, walkN, driveN, all: counts, "8.81M".
splitTip.ridesNone: The body of the mode split hover with trip counts, when some trips have no route. Placeholders as splitTip.rides, and none/noneN for the trips with no route.
splitTip.shares: The body of the mode split hover with shares only. train, walk, drive: "18.5%" or "–".
splitTip.sharesNone: The body of the mode split hover with shares only, when some trips have no route.
splitTip.perDay: First line of the mode split table hover. where: " in New York"; note: " (an early estimate)" (may be empty).
splitTip.noSplit: Mode split table hover before any trips are known. head: splitTip.perDay.
splitTip.train: A mode of travel in the mode split table.
splitTip.walking: A mode of travel in the mode split table.
splitTip.driving: A mode of travel in the mode split table.
splitTip.noRoute: A mode in the mode split table: trips that have no way to be made.
splitTip.tripCount: A row heading in the mode split table: the number of trips.
splitTip.distance: A row heading in the mode split table: the total straight-line distance of the trips.
startMenu.backupDownloadFailed: Grey text on the start menu when downloading a backup from the player's account fails.
startMenu.build: Small grey text at the top of the start menu. version: the build number, e.g. "2631", or "dev".
startMenu.changelog: Button on the start menu's small update row, and the heading of the list of what changed that it opens. Narrow button.
startMenu.delete: Hover on the bin button of a saved game on the start menu.
startMenu.deleteFailed: Grey text on the start menu when deleting a saved game fails.
startMenu.savesUnreadable: Grey text on the start menu, under New game and Load from file, when the browser's storage kept failing to list the saved games (they are not shown, but were not changed). Not shown when there are simply no saved games.
startMenu.deleteGame: Screen reader name of the bin button of a saved game on the start menu. name: the game's name, e.g. "New York".
startMenu.deleteSave: Button that confirms deleting a saved game on the start menu.
startMenu.downloadFailed: Grey text on the start menu when downloading a game from the player's account fails.
startMenu.hideUpdate: Hover and screen reader name of the x button that hides the start menu's small update row for good in this browser.
startMenu.keepIt: Button that cancels deleting a saved game on the start menu.
startMenu.loadAnyway: Button on the start menu beside the memory warning: loads the save although the device may not have the memory for it.
startMenu.loadFile: Button on the start menu: picks a .save file from the computer.
startMenu.loadWithoutIntercity: Button on the start menu beside Load anyway, shown with the memory warning: loads the save without trips between cities, which takes less memory. The save itself is not changed.
startMenu.newGame: Button on the start menu, and the heading of the new game sheet on it.
startMenu.openElsewhere: Grey text on the start menu when the player deletes a game that another browser tab has open.
startMenu.savedGames: Heading above the list of saved games on the start menu.
startMenu.welcome: Heading of the start menu when the logo is turned off (a debug switch).
stationCircles.station: Name of a ridership circle when its station has no name.
stationInspector.and: Small word between the two stations of a passage row in a complex view, "Canal St and Spring St".
stationInspector.area: Row label in the station building section: its floor area.
stationInspector.arriving: Small line under a Waiting now row of a station view. count: riders arriving, "12"; time: "4m10s".
stationInspector.behind: Small red line under a Waiting now row of a station view. count: riders the last train left, "12"; time: "4m10s".
stationInspector.boardings24: Hover on the Today figure of a row in a complex view's line list. count: "1.2k".
stationInspector.boardingsToday: Bold row label in a station or complex view: boardings in the past 24 hours.
stationInspector.boardingsUnit: Unit text after the percents in the purpose split of a station view, as in purposeSplit.words: "Commute: 42% of boardings".
stationInspector.complexOfN: Line under the title of a complex view. count: how many stations, 3.
stationInspector.partOfComplex: Button under the title of a single station that opens its whole complex. count: how many stations, 3.
stationInspector.constructPort: Button in a view of a planned port that builds it.
stationInspector.constructStation: Button in a view of a planned station that builds it.
stationInspector.constructed: Notice after constructing a station or port. name: its name; price: "$1.2M".
stationInspector.editOutline: Button in the station building section that redraws the building's outline.
stationInspector.leftBehind: Second line of the hover on the Waiting figure of a complex view's line list. vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
stationInspector.lineBoardings: Hover on a line row's figure in a station view. count: "1.2k"; name: the line's name.
stationInspector.lines: Column heading and section heading for the lines serving a station or complex.
stationInspector.linkTip: Hover on the length of a passage row. distance: "120 m"; price: "$2.4M"; built: true when both stations are built.
stationInspector.linking: Muted line in a station view while the player picks the other end of a passage. distance: "500 m".
stationInspector.linkingTouch: Muted line in a station view while the player picks the other end of a passage, on a phone or tablet. distance: "500 m".
stationInspector.nextName: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that gives a station the next name suggested from where it stands.
stationInspector.noName: Notice after pressing Next suggested name when the station has no other candidate.
stationInspector.noRefund: Hover on the Remove button of a built passage.
stationInspector.noTrain: Hover on the Waiting figure of a complex view's line list when no train stops now. vehicle: train, tram, bus or boat.
stationInspector.nobody: Small line under a Waiting now row of a station view when no train is due.
stationInspector.passages: Heading of the list of passages in a station view.
stationInspector.platformLength: Screen-reader label of the platform length stepper in a station view.
stationInspector.platforms: Row label in a station view: how long the platforms are.
stationInspector.port: Line under the title of a port's view, instead of its level.
stationInspector.portUpkeep: Hover on the Upkeep figure of a port view. price: "$1.2k".
stationInspector.removeBuilding: Button in the station building section that removes the building.
stationInspector.removeLink: Button on a passage row that removes the passage.
stationInspector.removePort: Button in a port view that removes it.
stationInspector.removeStation: Button in a station view that removes it.
stationInspector.room: Row label in the station building section: how many riders fit in its hall.
stationInspector.roomFigure: Value of the Room row. figure: the room, "1,200", or riders waiting over room, "40/1,200".
stationInspector.roomTip: Hover on the Room figure of the station building section.
stationInspector.stations: Header of the first column in a complex view's list: one row per station of the complex, with its line chips, riders waiting, boardings today and Terminal build button.
stationInspector.stationUpkeep: Hover on the Upkeep figure of a station view, naming both prices because the figure shows this station's own. under: the daily upkeep of an underground station, "$200k"; other: of any other station, "$50k".
stationInspector.to: Name of a row in a station view's Waiting now list: the direction, named by the last station. name: the station's name.
stationInspector.today: Column heading in a complex view's line list: boardings in the past 24 hours.
stationInspector.waiting: Column heading in a complex view's line list: riders waiting now.
stationInspector.waitingNow: Heading of the list of riders waiting on the platforms in a station view.
stationInspector.wholeComplex: Hover on the Complex of n stations button.
stationsTab.apart: Toggle above the Stations tab list. On: each station of a complex gets its own row; off: one row per complex. Label starts with a verb.
stationsTab.footer: Line under the Stations tab list. scoped: true when the list is limited to the viewed place; shown and count: stations listed, e.g. 12 (the same number); total: stations in the game, e.g. 340; what: stationsTab.ridersWhat.
stationsTab.name: Column heading of the Stations tab: the station name.
stationsTab.stationName: Screen reader name of the box for renaming a station or complex in the Stations list.
stationsTab.near: Column heading of the Stations tab: distance from the centre of the screen.
stationsTab.none: Line in the Stations tab when the game has no stations at all.
stationsTab.noneHere: Line in the Stations tab when the viewed place has no stations.
stationsTab.plan: In the Riders column of the Stations tab for a station that is only planned, not built.
stationsTab.riders: Column heading of the Stations tab: how many riders use the station.
stationsTab.ridersTip: Hover on a station's riders figure in the Stations tab. mode: origins, transfers or other (the map's station circle setting); count: a number of riders, e.g. "12,400"; when: a phrase for the day shown, e.g. "per weekday" or "per day" (may be empty).
stationsTab.ridersWhat: What the Riders column of the Stations tab counts, used inside stationsTab.sortRiders and stationsTab.footer. mode: origins, transfers or other; when: a phrase for the day shown, e.g. "per weekday" or "per day" (may be empty).
stationsTab.sortName: Hover on the Name column heading of the Stations tab.
stationsTab.sortNear: Hover on the Near column heading of the Stations tab.
stationsTab.sortRiders: Hover on the Riders column heading of the Stations tab. what: stationsTab.ridersWhat, e.g. "boardings in past 24h".
stationUpgrades.actAdd: Last line of an upgrade button hover in a station view, for an upgrade not yet in place on a station that is only a blueprint.
stationUpgrades.actBuild: Last line of an upgrade button hover in a station view, for an upgrade not yet in place on a built station.
stationUpgrades.actBuilt: Last line of an upgrade button hover in a station view, for an upgrade that is built.
stationUpgrades.actPlanned: Last line of an upgrade button hover in a station view, for an upgrade that is only in the blueprint.
stationUpgrades.added: Notice after adding an upgrade to the blueprint. name: the upgrade, "Park and ride".
stationUpgrades.allBuilt: Last line of an upgrade button hover in a complex view, for an upgrade built at every station. count: stations in the complex.
stationUpgrades.building: Screen-reader label of the station building button in a station view.
stationUpgrades.buildingTip: Hover on the station building button in a station view: several lines. price: the cost per area, "$300/m2"; act: stop (drawing now), built (already has a building) or new.
stationUpgrades.built: Notice after building an upgrade. name: the upgrade, "Park and ride"; station: the station's name; price: "$1.2M".
stationUpgrades.complexGroup: Screen-reader label of the row of upgrade buttons in a complex view.
stationUpgrades.costs: A line of an upgrade button hover. price: "$1.2M".
stationUpgrades.group: Screen-reader label of the row of upgrade buttons in a station view.
stationUpgrades.housed: Last line of the waiting room button hover when a station building makes it unnecessary.
stationUpgrades.passage: Screen-reader label of the passage button in a station view.
stationUpgrades.passageTip: Hover on the passage button in a station view: several lines. distance: the longest passage, "500 m"; range: the price range, "$2-6M"; picking: true while the player is choosing the other station.
stationUpgrades.removed: Notice after removing an upgrade from a built station. name: the upgrade; station: the station's name.
stationUpgrades.someAct: Last line of an upgrade button hover in a complex view, for an upgrade built at only some stations or none. some: true when some stations have it already; have: how many do; count: stations in the complex; missing: stations that lack it; blueprint: true when nothing in the complex is built yet.
statusTag.behind: Small tag on the map's top row when the trip figures are older than the player's last changes. count: whole game days, e.g. 2.
statusTag.calculatingAfterChange: Small tag on the map's top row while the trips are recalculated after the player built something.
statusTag.calculatingCities: Small tag on the map's top row while the trips of several cities are worked out. count: 3 or more.
statusTag.calculatingPlace: Small tag on the map's top row while a city's trips are worked out. name: a city or zone name, e.g. "Osaka".
statusTag.capped: Last line of the hover on the small tag when the game speed is held down while demand updates. cap: a speed multiple, e.g. 4.
statusTag.demandFailed: Small tag on the map's top row when the demand figures failed to load.
statusTag.loadingData: Small tag on the map's top row, beside a thin loading bar, while the game's data loads.
statusTag.loadingDataDots: Small tag on the map's top row while data for the place in view downloads.
statusTag.loadingMap: Small tag on the map's top row when the background map's tiles have taken more than 3 seconds to arrive.
statusTag.loadingPlace: Small tag on the map's top row while a clicked city's data downloads. name: a city or zone name, e.g. "Osaka".
statusTag.loadingTip: Hover on the small tag while data loads. cities: a list of city names, e.g. "Osaka and Kyoto"; pct: percent done, e.g. 40; step: the stage, e.g. "Loading demand".
statusTag.placeFailed: Small tag on the map's top row when the place in view failed to load. name: a city or zone name, e.g. "Osaka".
statusTag.recomputingCities: Small tag on the map's top row while the trips of several cities are being recalculated. count: 3 or more.
statusTag.recomputingHere: Small tag on the map's top row while the trips of the place in view are being recalculated.
statusTag.freedMemory: A line in the hover of the small status tag on the map's top row: the game restarted its background calculators to give back memory, so it is calculating the trips of the whole game again before it can answer anything.
statusTag.slowConnection: A line in the hover of the small loading tag on the map's top row, added when its downloads (city data or terrain) are taking much longer than they do on a fast connection.
statusTag.terrainDownloading: Small tag on the map's top row while the terrain data downloads.
statusTag.terrainFailTip: Hover on the small tag when the terrain data failed to download. s is seconds.
statusTag.terrainFailed: Small tag on the map's top row when the terrain data failed to download.
stopMarkers.station: Hover tag title over a stop marker when the station has no name.
stopMarkers.oneWay: Hover tag row over a manually placed bus stop that the line serves in one direction only (a half-filled marker), above the row that offers its removal.
stopMarkers.remove: Hover tag row over a marker of a station that is on the line being edited.
stopMarkers.rightClose: Hover tag row over the line's first stop, under the click's row, when the line can close into a loop there. A right click (or holding a finger on it) runs the line on from its last stop back to this one, round and round.
stopMarkers.rightOpen: Hover tag row over a stop of a loop line, under the click's row. A right click (or holding a finger on it) makes the loop an ordinary line that turns back at its ends again; a circle then ends at this stop.
stopMarkers.rightLoopBack: Hover tag row over the stop just before the place a loop of track leaves the line near its end, under the click's row. A right click (or holding a finger on it) makes the line run out past this stop, round the loop one way, and back over the stops it came by.
stopMarkers.rightStopLooping: Hover tag row over that stop on a line that loops back there, under the click's row. A right click (or holding a finger on it) makes the line end there again, turning back instead of going round the loop.
stopMarkers.noLoop: Shown for a few seconds under a station's name after a right click (or a finger held) on a station where the line has no loop to close, open or turn round.
stopMarkers.add: Hover tag row over a station the line can add as a stop.
stopMarkers.addReroute: Hover tag row over a station the line can reach only by a different route.
stopMarkers.reverseEnd: Hover tag row over a station that adds a stop where trains would turn round at the end of the track. tram: true for a tram stop or tram track, otherwise a train's.
stopMarkers.reverseAt: Hover tag row over a station that adds a stop where trains would turn round at another station. name: "Canal St". tram: true for a tram stop or tram track, otherwise a train's.
stopMarkers.reverseSome: Hover tag row, as stopMarkers.reverseAt when that station's name is not known. tram: true for a tram stop or tram track, otherwise a train's.
stopMarkers.noTrack: Hover tag row over a station the line cannot reach.
stopMarkers.thatStation: Stands for a station with no name in stopMarkers.cutOff.
stopMarkers.cutOff: Notice tag after clicking a station the line cannot reach. name: "Canal St".
stopMarkers.drawFirst: Second row of the notice tag after clicking a station the line cannot reach.
terrain.flat: Terrain class 0, in the track price hovers.
terrain.hills: Terrain classes 1 and 2 (the surcharge beside it tells them apart), in the track price hovers.
terrain.mountains: Terrain class 3, in the track price hovers.
today.peakAt: Hover line on a crowded stretch. load: "132%"; time: "08:00".
today.periodLoad: Hover line on a line's crowding, one per time of day. span: "06:00-10:00"; load: "132%".
today.peak: First line of a line's crowding hover. load: "132%".
today.shortStretch: Tutorial line in a line's crowding hover. vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
today.weekend: Line in the profit hover when the line's day is a Saturday or Sunday.
today.holiday: Line in the profit hover when the line's day is a public holiday. named: true when the holiday has a name; name: "Labor Day".
today.travelDay: Line in the profit hover when the line's day is a going-out or coming-back day of a long holiday.
toolBar.advanced: Button at the bottom right of the track tool's bar that opens or closes a row of advanced settings (the two target speeds).
toolBar.cost: The price multiple inside toolBar.price. mult: e.g. "1.5x".
toolBar.flyoverSpeed: Label of the setting in the track tool's Advanced row that sets the speed new automatic flyovers are laid out for: a faster one is bigger. Worded like toolBar.targetSpeed.
toolBar.flyoverSpeedLabel: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the flyover target max speed.
toolBar.flyoverSpeedTip: Hover on the Flyover target max speed setting of the track tool's bar.
toolBar.highSpeed: Button choosing high-speed track, in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.keepPlacing: Screen reader name of the keep placing switch in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.keepPlacingTip: Hover on the keep placing switch in the track tool's bar. Caps Lock and Esc are key names.
toolBar.keepPlacingTipTouch: Hover on the keep placing switch in the track tool's bar, on a phone or tablet.
toolBar.level: Label and screen reader name for the track level (tunnel, ground, viaduct...) in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.platformLength: Label of the platform length setting in the station tool's bar.
toolBar.platformLengthLabel: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the platform length.
toolBar.price: Track price in the track tool's bar. price: written with its unit in the shown currency, e.g. "$112.5M", "¥16.9B"; unit: "km" or "mi"; cost: toolBar.cost, shown with a coloured background.
toolBar.priceTip: First line of the hover on the track price in the track tool's bar. level: a level name, e.g. "Viaduct"; hsr: true for high-speed track.
toolBar.ramp: Screen reader name of the auto ramp switch in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.rampTip: Hover on the auto ramp switch in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.regular: Button choosing the ordinary kind of track, in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.snapBeside: Screen reader name of the switch that draws new track parallel to existing track.
toolBar.snapBesideTip: Hover on the snap beside track switch: a title line, then an explanation.
toolBar.snapReal: Hover and screen reader name of the switch that snaps new track to the real rail lines.
toolBar.snapRoads: Hover and screen reader name of the switch that makes new rail track follow the main roads.
toolBar.snapRoadsCtrl: Second line of that switch's hover: holding the Ctrl key while drawing draws without following the roads.
toolBar.snapStreets: Hover and screen reader name of the switch that makes new tram track follow the streets.
toolBar.snapStreetsCtrl: Second line of that switch's hover: holding the Ctrl key while drawing does the opposite of the switch. on: true while the switch is on.
toolBar.speedTip: Hover on the Target max speed setting of the track tool's bar.
toolBar.station: Screen reader name of the station tool's bar.
toolBar.targetSpeed: Label of the design speed setting in the track tool's bar; also the title line of its phone button's hover and its screen reader name.
toolBar.targetSpeedLabel: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the design speed.
toolBar.track: Screen reader name of the track tool's bar.
toolBar.trackType: Screen reader name of the button that opens the track type choices on a phone.
toolBar.trackCount: Screen reader name of the pair of buttons that choose double or quad track, in the track tool's bar.
toolBar.doubleTrack: Button and hover choosing double track (two tracks), in the track tool's bar. It shows two lines.
toolBar.tram: Choice of track type in the track tool's bar, beside Regular and High speed: tram track.
toolBar.priceTipTram: Hover on the track tool's price, naming the elevation and that the track is tram track. level: the elevation's name, such as Ground level. street: true while the tool lays tram track along streets (the cheap kind).
toolBar.quadTrackTip: Hover on the quad track button, in the track tool's bar: names it and says what it is.
toolBar.quadTrack: Button and hover choosing quad track (four tracks), in the track tool's bar. It shows four lines.
toolBar.singleTrack: Button and hover choosing single track (one track), in the track tool's bar. It shows one line.
toolBar.singleHsr: Notice at the map's bottom left, in red, when the player presses Single track while High speed is the track type picked: the game keeps High speed and double track. Regular is the name of the other track type button.
toolKeys.delete: Name of the delete tool in the Build tab.
toolKeys.deleteTip: Hover on the delete tool in the Build tab.
toolKeys.select: Name of the tool that selects track and stations by dragging a box, in the Build tab.
toolKeys.selectTip: Hover on the Select tool in the Build tab: three lines. Shift is a key name.
toolKeys.selectTipTouch: Hover on the Select tool in the Build tab, on a phone or tablet.
toolKeys.station: Name of the station tool in the Build tab.
toolKeys.stationTip: Hover on the station tool in the Build tab.
toolKeys.track: Name of the track tool in the Build tab.
toolKeys.trackTip: Hover on the track tool in the Build tab.
toolNotes.aStation: Stands in for a station's name in toolNotes.passage when it is not known.
toolNotes.buildingHead: Heading at the map's bottom left while the station building tool is on. isNew: true for a new building, otherwise an existing outline is being edited; corners: how many corners the outline has.
toolNotes.busHead: Heading at the map's bottom left while the bus line tool is on. route: true when redrawing an existing line's route; name: that line's name, e.g. "B12"; points: how many points the route has so far.
toolNotes.cancel: Button in the bus, ferry and station building headings at the map's bottom left: leaves the tool. Its hover is the key name Esc.
toolNotes.confirm: Heading of the yes or no question dialog.
toolNotes.construct: Button at the map's bottom left that builds the station building outline drawn. Its hover is the key name Enter.
toolNotes.done: Button at the map's bottom left that ends editing a line's stops.
toolNotes.loop: Button on phones and tablets in the bar at the map's bottom left while a line's stops are edited or a bus or ferry route is drawn. Pressed, the next tap on a stop, point or port closes, opens or loops back the line there, as a right click does with a mouse.
toolNotes.loopTap: Hint at the map's bottom left while the Loop button is pressed: what the next tap does. point: a bus route's clicked point; port: a ferry port; other: a station of a train or tram line.
toolNotes.editing: Heading at the map's bottom left while a line's stops are edited. name: the line's name, e.g. "Red"; stops: how many it has.
toolNotes.ferryHead: Heading at the map's bottom left while the ferry line tool is on. route: true when redrawing an existing line's route; name: that line's name; ports: how many ports the route has so far.
toolNotes.lineHint: Grey hint at the map's bottom left while the line tool is on. touch: true on a touch screen (no Enter key there).
toolNotes.busHandHint: Note at the bottom of the map while the stops of a bus line are placed by hand: the route is the line drawn on the map, a stop is a disc on it.
toolNotes.lineNext: Grey hint at the map's bottom left after the first stop of a new line is placed. touch: true on a touch screen.
toolNotes.makeLine: Button at the map's bottom left that makes the new bus or ferry line from the route drawn. Its hover is the key name Enter.
toolNotes.moreLines: Last row of the list of lines a removal would break, when there are more than five. count: 7.
toolNotes.passage: What the map click does now while the player links two stations by a passage. name: the first station's name, or toolNotes.aStation.
toolNotes.saveOutline: Button at the map's bottom left that saves the edited station building outline. Its hover is the key name Enter.
toolNotes.saveRoute: Button at the map's bottom left while redrawing a bus or ferry line's route. Its hover is the key name Enter.
toolNotes.simple: What the map click does now, shown at the map's bottom left beside a coloured square and a cross, while one of these tools is on. mode: the tool.
toolNotes.stop: Screen reader name of the cross beside the tool description at the map's bottom left.
toolNotes.stopTip: Hover on the cross beside the tool description at the map's bottom left. Esc is the Escape key.
toolNotes.tripEnd: Grey hint at the map's bottom left after a trip's start is chosen. touch: true on a touch screen.
toolNotes.tripHint: Grey hint at the map's bottom left while the trip tool is on. touch: true on a touch screen.
tools.notOnTrack: Notice and tag when a click for a station is not on track.
tools.tooFar: Notice and tag in the track tool when the next point is too far. max: "500 km".
tools.tooFarTouch: Notice and tag in the track tool when the next point is too far, on a phone or tablet. max: "500 km".
tools.placeTrack: Touch confirm button hover in the track tool.
tools.stopDrawing: Touch stop button hover in the track tool.
tools.placeStation: Touch confirm button hover in the station tool.
tools.cancelStation: Touch stop button hover in the station tool.
tools.remove: Touch confirm button hover in the remove tool.
tools.cancelRemove: Touch stop button hover in the remove tool.
tools.noRealTrack: Notice when drawing track along the real network and no real track joins the clicked points.
tools.roadsTight: Notice and tag when rail track drawn along roads cannot be laid there: the roads turn too sharply for the curves. The player should click a point part of the way along.
tools.streetsTight: Notice and tag when tram track drawn along streets cannot be laid there: the streets turn too sharply for tram curves. The player should click a point part of the way along.
tools.blueprintCost: Notice after placing blueprint track. distance: "1.2 km"; cost: money, "$12M".
tools.blueprint: Notice after placing blueprint track when no figures are known.
tools.blueprintStation: Notice after placing a blueprint station. name: "Canal St".
tools.near: Row in the station tool's hover tag: trips starting or ending within 1 km (or mile) of the spot. n: "12,000"; unit: "km" or "mi".
tools.nearUnder: Row in the station tool's hover tag when fewer than 50 trips are near. unit: "km" or "mi".
tools.lineHelp: Notice when the line tool starts editing a line's stops.
tools.stopFailed: Notice when adding or removing a stop on a line failed.
tools.cannotPlace: Tag next to the cursor in a build tool when a spot is refused with no reason given.
tools.removeWhat: Tag next to the cursor in the remove tool. what: a phrase for the thing under the cursor, "the built station Canal St".
topBar.autosaveOff: Notice under the top bar when the game cannot be saved automatically and no more specific reason is known.
topBar.cashTip: Hover on the cash figure in the top bar. fares: money, e.g. "$3,400"; running and upkeep: negative money, e.g. "-$900".
topBar.cities: A number of cities, inside topBar.tripsInCities and topBar.inCitiesWithStations. count: 12.
topBar.clockHeld: Hover on the clock while the game waits for the demand figures.
topBar.clockSpeed: Screen reader name of the slider that picks the game speed.
topBar.comingBack: A kind of day, inside topBar.showOn: the days when people return from a long holiday. dates: a date range, e.g. "May 4-5".
topBar.dateTip: Hover on the clock's date. weekday: a day name, e.g. "Monday"; month: a month name, e.g. "April"; date: the day of the month, e.g. 14; year: the game year, 1 from the start, e.g. 2; day: the in-game day number, e.g. 120.
topBar.dayOf: A kind of day, inside topBar.showOn. what: a phrase for a day away, such as "Golden Week".
topBar.dayOn: A kind of day, inside topBar.showAgain. day: average, weekday, saturday or sunday.
topBar.demandUntil: Hover on the demand band of the sky picture at the map's top right. level: high, medium or low; time: a 24-hour clock time, e.g. "06:00".
topBar.goingOut: A kind of day, inside topBar.showOn: the days when people leave for a long holiday. dates: a date range, e.g. "Apr 29-30".
topBar.holidayAt: A holiday and the countries that keep it, inside topBar.today. name: e.g. "Labor Day"; places: a list of country names, e.g. "Belgium, China and 4 others".
topBar.inCitiesWithStations: Phrase that ends the title of the trip split table in the world view's hover. cities: topBar.cities.
topBar.inCity: Phrase that ends the title of the trip split hover. Follows "Trips per day". name: a city or zone name.
topBar.inDays: When a long holiday starts, inside topBar.runLine. count: 2 or more.
topBar.inWorld: Phrase that ends the title of the trip split hover when the map is zoomed far out. Follows "Trips per day".
topBar.placeDay: The place and the day shown together, after "Trips per day" in the trip split hover. place: topBar.inCity, topBar.inWorld or topBar.inCitiesWithStations, e.g. "in Osaka"; day: e.g. "on a weekday" (days.onWeekday).
topBar.infiniteMoney: First line of the hover on the Sandbox mark in the top bar.
topBar.longHolidays: Screen reader name of the pink or yellow dot by the date.
topBar.normalSpeed: Hover and screen reader name of the first speed button.
topBar.others: The last item when a holiday's countries are listed and there are many. count: e.g. 4 (in "Labor Day, Belgium, China and 4 others").
topBar.pause: Screen reader name of the pause button.
topBar.pauseTip: Hover on the pause button. Space is the space bar.
topBar.pointsNow: Line in the hover on the city name in the top bar. count: e.g. "1,240"; day: a phrase such as "on a weekday" or "on the average day".
topBar.pointsPast: Line in the hover on the city name in the top bar. count: e.g. "1,240". h is hours.
topBar.recomputing: Added to the end of the trip split hover while the trips are being recalculated.
topBar.runLine: One line in the hover on the pink or yellow dot by the date: a long holiday. name: e.g. "Golden Week"; dates: e.g. "Apr 29-May 5"; country: a country name; timing: topBar.inDays, topBar.timingTomorrow or topBar.timingNow.
topBar.rushAt: A long holiday's busy days and the countries that keep them, inside topBar.today. name: e.g. "Golden Week"; dates: e.g. "Apr 29-30"; places: a list of country names, e.g. "China".
topBar.sandbox: In the top bar of a sandbox game, where the cash figure would be.
topBar.saves: Button in the autosave notice under the top bar: opens the saved games panel.
topBar.viewing: Notice under the top bar while the player views a network from Community. name: the network's name, "Guangzhou - kanocifer".
topBar.viewSave: Button in that notice: saves the viewed network as one of the player's games.
topBar.showAgain: Last line of the hover on the holiday dot while demand is shown for a day away. day: topBar.dayOn, e.g. "a weekday".
topBar.showOn: Last line of the hover on the holiday dot. what: a kind of day, e.g. "a going-out day, Apr 29-30".
topBar.sinceDay1: Second line of the hover on the Sandbox mark in the top bar. amount: money, e.g. "$1.2M".
topBar.speed: Hover and screen reader name of the second speed button. speed: e.g. "4x".
topBar.speedCapped: Hover on the chosen speed button while demand updates and the game runs slower than chosen. speed: e.g. "16x"; cap: e.g. "4x".
topBar.speedPick: Hover on the third speed button: a title line, then a tip. speed: e.g. "16x".
topBar.timingNow: When a long holiday starts, inside topBar.runLine: it is under way.
topBar.timingTomorrow: When a long holiday starts, inside topBar.runLine.
topBar.today: Line in the holiday hovers: a holiday going on today. what: topBar.holidayAt or topBar.rushAt.
topBar.todayFrom: Line in the holiday hovers: a holiday starting later today, where its country keeps another local time. time: a 24-hour clock time, e.g. "14:00"; what: topBar.holidayAt or topBar.rushAt.
topBar.tomorrow: Line in the holiday hovers: a holiday starting tomorrow. what: topBar.holidayAt or topBar.rushAt.
topBar.tomorrowFrom: Line in the holiday hovers: a holiday starting at an hour tomorrow, where its country keeps another local time. time: a 24-hour clock time, e.g. "14:00"; what: topBar.holidayAt or topBar.rushAt.
topBar.trainShare: Hover on the transit share bar when the map is zoomed far out and the cities have no figures yet. world: topBar.worldTrips; note: topBar.recomputing with a space in front, or empty.
topBar.trainsCarry: Second line of the hover on the world view's transit share. share: a percentage, e.g. "0.4%"; world: topBar.worldTrips.
topBar.tripsInCities: First line of the hover on the world view's train share. count: e.g. "1,200,000"; cities: topBar.cities; note: topBar.recomputing with a space in front, or empty.
topBar.tripsPerDay: The train figure in the top bar when the map is zoomed far out. count: a short number, e.g. "1.2M".
topBar.weekday: A day of the week, in the game's calendar.
topBar.world: Name shown in the top bar, in place of a city, when the map is zoomed far out.
topBar.worldTip: Hover on the word World in the top bar when the map is zoomed far out: a title line, then the counts. cities: 12; stations: 340.
topBar.worldTrips: Inside the hover on the world view's train share. rides: the world's trips a day, a whole number written short, e.g. "25 billion"; people: e.g. "8.2 billion"; each: e.g. 3.
touchBar.undo: Button on the touch control bar while placing track or a line on a touch screen. Hover and screen reader name.
trackHover.line: Hover tag title for a line with no name found. num: 4.
trackHover.notRunningYet: Hover tag row over a line that is planned but not built.
trackHover.notRunning: Hover tag row over a line whose route is broken.
trackHover.calculating: Hover tag row while the demand figures are not ready.
trackHover.riders: Hover tag row over a line or track: the riders on that stretch. n: "12k"; when: a day phrase, "on a weekday" or "per day".
trackHover.tripsOnly: Hover tag row under the riders figure when a purpose filter is on. purpose: "Leisure".
trackHover.avgLoad: Hover tag row over a line in the Traffic view: its average load on that stretch. share: a whole number, "85".
trackHover.atCapacity: Hover tag row, in red, over a line on track that is full. demand: the demand level in force, "high".
trackHover.peakLoad: Hover tag row, over crowded track: its busiest hour. load: a coloured chip with the load, "130%"; time: "8:15 am".
trackHover.noVehicles: Hover tag row over a stretch of a bus or ferry route that nothing runs on. vehicles: boats, buses or trains.
trackHover.changing: Hover tag over a bubble of riders changing trains. n: "1.2k"; line: the line they change to, "Line 4".
trackHover.lineRuns: Hover tag row over track in the network diagram where a line runs but the save has no details.
trackHover.upkeepDay: Hover tag row over bare track in the Profit view. amount: money, in red when negative, "-$1.2k".
trackHover.profit: Hover tag row in the Profit view over a stretch. amount: money, "$4.1k"; when: a day phrase, "per day".
trackHover.perKm: Hover tag row in the Profit view: the stretch's profit per km, or per mile in a game with US units. amount: money, "$310"; unit: "km" or "mile" (format.distUnit).
trackHover.fares: Hover tag row in the Profit view: fare income. amount: money, "$9.8k".
trackHover.running: Hover tag row in the Profit view: the cost of running vehicles on the stretch. vehicles: boats, buses or trains; amount: money, "-$3k".
trackHover.upkeep: Hover tag row in the Profit view: the track's upkeep. amount: money, "-$1.2k".
trackHover.faresCover: Hover tag first row in the Profit view over a stretch. share: a coloured chip with a percentage, "140%".
trackHover.building: Hover tag row over a station building's floor.
trackHover.noStation: Hover tag row over a station building with no station inside it.
trackHover.hall: Hover tag row over a station building's floor. n: "1,200".
trackInspector.addPoint: Screen-reader label of the icon button in a blueprint track view that puts a new draggable point on the track (a node the player then drags to bend the track).
trackInspector.addPointTip: Hover on the Add point button. It adds a point in the middle of this piece of track, which the player then drags to bend it.
trackInspector.construct: Button in a track view that builds the blueprint track. price: "$3.2M".
trackInspector.constructed: Notice after constructing track. crossover: true for a crossover (two diagonals built together); price: "$3.2M".
trackInspector.cost: Row label in a track view: the price of building it.
trackInspector.disabled: Muted line in a track view for a blueprint piece that is switched off.
trackInspector.disabledTip: Hover on the Disabled line of a track view.
trackInspector.doubleUp: Screen-reader label of the button that adds an express pair of tracks beside a double track.
trackInspector.doubleUpTip: Hover on the Double up button: a title line, then what it does. price: "$3.2M".
trackInspector.level: Level of a track piece in a track view. level: the level's name or number, "1" or "-1".
trackInspector.levels: Levels of a track piece that spans several, in a track view. from, to: level names, "-1" and "1".
trackInspector.linesHere: Heading in a track view above the lines that use this track.
trackInspector.name: Title of a track view. kind: crossover, hsr (high-speed), double or single.
trackInspector.nameTram: Title of the track inspector when the picked track is tram track.
trackInspector.nameStreetTram: Title of the track inspector when the picked track is tram track laid along a street (cheaper than tram track off the streets).
trackInspector.newLine: Screen-reader label of the plus button in a track view that starts a new line.
trackInspector.newLineTip: Hover on the plus button in a track view. N is the keyboard shortcut.
trackInspector.remove: Button in a track view that removes it. kind: crossover; track (constructed track); blueprint (planned track).
trackInspector.slowest: Row label in a track view: the speed the tightest curve allows.
trackInspector.speedHsr: Hover on the Speed limit row of a high-speed track view.
trackInspector.speedLimit: Row label in a track view: the top speed on this track.
trackInspector.speedNormal: Hover on the Speed limit row of a normal track view.
trackInspector.upkeep: Row label in a track view: the yearly cost of keeping the track, shown per day.
trackInspector.upkeepLead: First word of the upkeep hover of constructed track; a sentence about the upkeep rates follows it in code (game/format.ts upkeepText).
trackInspector.upkeepLeadPlanned: Start of the upkeep hover of blueprint track; a sentence about the upkeep rates follows it in code (game/format.ts upkeepText).
trackInspector.upkeepTip: Hover on the Upkeep figure in a track view. text: a sentence about upkeep rates starting with trackInspector.upkeepLead or upkeepLeadPlanned.
trackPrice.cost: Second line of the hover on a track level button (Viaduct, Tunnel...). mult: the price multiple, e.g. "1.5x"; price: written with its unit in the shown currency, e.g. "$112.5M", "¥16.9B"; unit: "km" or "mi".
trackTagRows.level: Accessible name of the elevation icon in a track tag.
trackTagRows.speedLimit: Accessible name of the speed icon in a track tag.
trackTagRows.terrain: Accessible name of the mountain icon in a track tag.
trackTagRows.water: Accessible name of the waves icon in a track tag.
trackTagRows.roads: Accessible name of the road icon in a track tag.
trackTagRows.fastest: Row in a track tag in the Speed view: the fastest a vehicle goes there. vehicle: train, bus or boat; speed: a coloured chip, "160 km/h".
trackTagRows.terrainAdds: Chip in the track tool's tag: the roughest ground crossed and the cost multiplier it adds. terrain: "Hills"; mult: "0.3".
trackTagRows.waterAdds: Chip in the track tool's tag: the cost multiplier water adds. mult: 0.5.
trackTagRows.roadsAdd: Chip in the track tool's tag: roads crossed at ground level and what they add. verbose: true during the tutorial (longer wording); count: 2; cost: money, "$1.2M".
trackTagRows.cannotPlace: Red row at the top of the track tool's tag when the segment is refused with no reason given.
trackTagRows.noFlyover: Row in the track tool's tag when a junction the new track makes stays flat: with the auto ramp switch on it would be built as a flyover, but there is no room.
trackTagRows.lengthCost: First row of the track tool's tag. length: "1.2 km"; mult: a coloured chip with the cost multiplier, "1.40x"; cost: money, "$12M".
trainInspector.along: Row label in a train view: how far along its run the train is, as a share of the run.
trainInspector.barTip: Hover on the load bar of a train view. aboard: riders now, "320"; crush: the most the train holds, "480".
trainInspector.calculating: Value of the Riders on board row in a train view while the riders are being worked out.
trainInspector.estimate: Small note after the period name on the On board heading of a train view when the figures are a first estimate. It starts with a comma.
trainInspector.estimateTip: Hover on the estimate note of a train view.
trainInspector.finished: Muted line in a train view when the vehicle has ended its run. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
trainInspector.fullAt: Row label in a train view: the most riders the train holds.
trainInspector.nextStop: Row label in a train view: the station the train is heading for.
trainInspector.onBoard: Heading of the riders section in a train view.
trainInspector.riders: Bold row label in a train view: riders aboard now. Also the label while the figure is not yet known.
trainInspector.state: Word beside the load bar of a train view, how full the train is. state: empty, seats (seats free), standing, crowded or full.
trainInspector.terminus: Value of the Next stop row in a train view when the train is on its last stretch.
trainInspector.title: Title of a train view. name: the line's name, "Line 4"; vehicle: train, bus or boat.
trainInspector.towards: Line under the title of a train view: the last station on the train's run. name: the station's name.
trainInspector.typical: Row label in a train view: riders on a typical vehicle of the line this hour. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
trainInspector.unavailable: Value of the Riders on board row in a train view when the riders could not be worked out.
trainStops.aStation: Stands in for a station with no name in the Next stops list of a train view.
trainStops.arrives: Hover on the minutes beside a stop in a train view's Next stops. time: "3 min 20 s".
trainStops.gettingOff: Small right-aligned caption on the Next stops heading of a train view: the figures are riders getting off.
trainStops.lastTip: Hover on the last stop in a train view's Next stops. name: the station's name.
trainStops.offTip: Hover on the figure of a Next stops row in a train view. count: riders getting off, "12"; n: the same count as a number for the plural; name: the station's name.
trainStops.stopTip: Hover on a stop in a train view's Next stops. off: riders getting off, "12"; riders: riders on board arriving, "48"; name: the station's name; on: riders getting on, "20".
trainStops.title: Heading of the list of the next stops in a train view.
trainStops.underMin: Time to a stop in a train view's Next stops when it is under a minute away.
trip.startingDrive: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the effort of beginning a drive to the station. Lowercase, in a list of terms.
trip.drive: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the drive to the station.
trip.dropOff: A cost term in the trip breakdown: being dropped at the station.
trip.parkingStation: A cost term in the trip breakdown.
trip.parkingHome: A cost term in the trip breakdown.
trip.car: A cost term in the trip breakdown: what owning a car costs on the trip.
trip.walk: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the walk to or from the station.
trip.wait: A cost term in the trip breakdown: waiting for a train.
trip.waitRoom: A cost term in the trip breakdown: waiting for a train that is not full.
trip.ride: A cost term in the trip breakdown: time on the train.
trip.crowding: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the extra cost of a crowded train.
trip.walkBetween: A cost term in the trip breakdown: walking from one station to another to change.
trip.changes: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the number of times the rider changes trains.
trip.change: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the effort of changing trains once.
trip.fare: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the ticket price.
trip.transferFare: A cost term in the trip breakdown: the extra fare for changing.
tripGraph.all: Row label in the hover of the trip length graph: the sum over all modes.
tripGraph.between: Title of the hover on a band of the trip length graph. from, to: the band's ends in kilometres, "10" and "20".
tripGraph.driving: Mode name in the hover of the trip length graph: trips by car.
tripGraph.kmSuffix: The unit after the longest tick label of the trip length graph axis. It starts with a space.
tripGraph.noRoute: Mode name in the hover of the trip length graph: trips with no way to make them.
tripGraph.over: Title of the hover on the longest band of the trip length graph. km: "1,000".
tripGraph.plane: Mode name in the hover of the trip length graph: trips by plane.
tripGraph.title: Heading above the trip length graph in a city view.
tripGraph.toOther: Row label in the hover of the trip length graph: trips between this city and other places.
tripGraph.train: Mode name in the hover of the trip length graph: trips by transit.
tripGraph.under: Title of the hover on the shortest band of the trip length graph. km: "1".
tripGraph.walking: Mode name in the hover of the trip length graph: trips on foot.
tripInspector.about: Hover of the trip panel's title. crowd: ' after 3 crowding rounds' or ', before crowding'. station: ' A station picked as an end stands for the homes or places right around it.' or empty.
tripInspector.accessTo: First row of a route in a trip panel. ride: true when the traveller drives or takes a bus to the first station. station: the first station's name (clickable).
tripInspector.afterRounds: Part of the title hover. amount: 3. rounds: number, for the plural. A round is one pass of the demand model that moves riders off full trains.
tripInspector.againstMain: Row label in an opened route: how many minutes of effective time it is above or below the main route.
tripInspector.asking: Shown in the trip panel while the demand model works out the trip.
tripInspector.avgTip: Hover line of an averaged trip. n: 12.
tripInspector.back: Button in the trip panel that goes back to the bubble the trip was opened from.
tripInspector.beforeCrowding: Part of the title hover when the demand model has not yet made a crowding pass.
tripInspector.bubbleAccess: Second line of the hover on the first walk of a route. min: 6 min.
tripInspector.busiestRoutes: Heading of the list of the routes most train riders take when a trip is averaged over several pairs of areas.
tripInspector.busiestTip: Hover of a route row in the list of busiest routes. names: Red Line then Blue Line. share: 12.3%. counted: a clause such as ', 12% of the 312k counted here' or empty.
tripInspector.byWalking: Heading of the walking section of a trip panel.
tripInspector.carCostTip: Hover of the car cost row of a route that starts with a drive to the station. cost: $1.20.
tripInspector.carOwnership: Row label in the car section of a trip panel: the dollar cost of owning a car on this trip.
tripInspector.choiceOfRoutes: Second line of the train's effective time hover, explaining the 'choice of routes' term in the equation.
tripInspector.clickClose: Last line of an opened route row's hover.
tripInspector.clickOpen: Last line of a closed route row's hover.
tripInspector.countTip: First line of the hover on the trip count line. amount: 312,400. trips: trips or errands trips. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
tripInspector.crowding: Row label in a route: the extra minutes felt from riding in crowded trains.
tripInspector.crowdingTip: Hover of the Crowding row of a route. min: 4.5 min.
tripInspector.diffTerm: A line of that hover: a part of the effective time and how it differs from the main route's. term: Walk (capitalised). delta: +3 min or −2 min.
tripInspector.diffTip: First line of the hover on how a route compares with the main route. own: 25 min. main: 22 min.
tripInspector.driveOnlyFar: Second line of the hover on why the train is not offered. km: 5.
tripInspector.driveTip: Hover of the Drive row. road: 14.2 km. line: 12.5 km. speed: 62 km/h.
tripInspector.everyUser: Note under the transit section of a trip panel when the main route carries all the transit riders.
tripInspector.failed: Shown in the trip panel when the demand model failed on the trip.
tripInspector.fullWaitTip: Hover of the row on waiting for a train with room. min: 4.5 min.
tripInspector.groupNote: Last line of a mode hover. train, none, drive, walk: shares such as 12%. apart: true when the two places are on land parts no road joins.
tripInspector.liftedNote: Note above the route in a trip panel when the train is not offered from the exact points but trips from nearby use it.
tripInspector.liftedTip: Hover of the note explaining why transit is not offered from the exact points. slower: true when walking is quicker than any transit trip. walk: 12 min. start, end: 8 min. max: 20 min.
tripInspector.noRail: Note in a trip panel, under the transit heading, saying why transit is not offered. why: a reason code.
tripInspector.noRailTip: Hover of the note on why transit is not offered. how: none, foot or footOrCar (how people get to the first station). start: 25 min. end: 12 min. max: 20 min.
tripInspector.ofPeople: Phrase ending 'of' in the trip mode hovers when no trips are counted. period: morning peak.
tripInspector.ofTrips: Phrase ending 'of' in the trip mode hovers ('Train: 45% of ...'). trips: '312k trips' or 'errands trips'. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
tripInspector.outside: Shown in the trip panel when an end is outside the area the city's demand model covers.
tripInspector.outsideBusiest: Hover of the last row of the busiest routes list.
tripInspector.ownershipTip: Hover of the Car ownership row. unit: km or mile.
tripInspector.periodTip: Hover of a row in the transit share by period list. period: Morning peak. words: work. train, none, drive, walk: shares such as 12%. apart: true when no road joins the two places.
tripInspector.purposePeriod: Caption at the right of the train heading. purpose: Work. period: morning peak.
tripInspector.railOfferedFor: End of the averaged trip's effective time hover. n: 8.
tripInspector.repTip: Hover of the caption at the right of the train heading. avg: true for an averaged trip. words: the purpose in lower case, work. n: 12. period: morning peak. all: true when all purposes are shown. picked: true when the player picked the period.
tripInspector.rideAccessTip: Hover of the first row of a route that starts with a ride to the station. distance: 1.2 km. min: 4.5 min.
tripInspector.routeTip: Hover of a route row in the list of other routes. names: Red Line then Blue Line. from, to: station names. share: 12.3%. counted: a clause such as ', 12% of the 312k counted here' or empty. time: 25 min.
tripInspector.same: Value of the 'Against the main route' row when the two routes have the same effective time.
tripInspector.shareUsers: Note under the transit section of a trip panel. share: 78%.
tripInspector.standsDrive: Last line of the hover on the Drive share of a trip panel.
tripInspector.standsNone: Last line of the hover on the No route share of a trip panel.
tripInspector.standsWalk: Last line of the hover on the Walk share of a trip panel.
tripInspector.stationEnd: Last sentence of the title hover when a trip end is a station.
tripInspector.stationParkingTip: Second line of the car cost row's hover. cost: $0.50.
tripInspector.straightLine: Hover of the trip count line when no trips are counted. distance: 12.5 km.
tripInspector.title: Title of the trip panel.
tripInspector.tripsDay: Summary line of the trip panel. trips: '312k trips'. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
tripInspector.underOne: Summary line of the trip panel when fewer than one trip is counted. trips: '1 trip'. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
tripInspector.waitForRoom: Row label in a route: minutes waiting because full trains pass by.
tripInspector.walkClause: End of the Walk share's first line of hover. min: 25 min.
tripInspector.walkFrom: Last row of a route in a trip panel. station: the last station's name (clickable).
tripInspector.walkFurther: Note in a trip panel, under the transit heading, when walking the whole way takes less time than any transit trip.
tripInspector.walkFurtherTip: Hover of the note saying walking is quicker than transit. known: true when the quickest transit time is known. train: 25 min. walk: 12 min.
tripInspector.walkTip: Hover of a walking row in a route of a trip panel. distance: 350 m. min: 4.5 min. kmh: 5.
tripInspector.walksTooLong: Note in a trip panel saying why transit is not offered when the walks to and from stations are too long. why: short (trip too short to drive), none (no station within a drive), found (no transit trip found), byCar (stations too far even by car). far: true when stations exist but are too far to walk to.
tripText.aStation: Stands in for a station's name in a route row when the name is unknown. Lower case, inside a sentence.
tripText.apart: Summary line of a trip panel: how far apart the two places are. distance: 12.5 km.
tripText.apartAfter: Summary line of a trip panel: the trips, then how far apart the two places are. head: '312k trips on weekdays'. distance: 12.5 km.
tripText.baseFare: Hover of the fare row of a trip. fare: $2.90. xfer: true when changing trains costs a fee. xferFare: $0.50 (empty when xfer is false).
tripText.byCar: Heading of the car section of a trip panel.
tripText.byTrain: Heading of the transit section of a trip panel.
tripText.car: Row label in the trip panels: what the car costs in dollars.
tripText.countedHere: Added inside a route hover. part: 12%. riders: 312k.
tripText.drive: Row label in the trip panels: minutes driving.
tripText.effectiveTime: Row label in the trip panels: the minutes of a trip with waits, walks, crowding and the fare weighed as the model weighs them.
tripText.equation: Effective time hover of a trip: the sum of its parts. terms: 'Walk 8 × 1.5 + wait 3 + ride 6' (already worded). total: 21 min.
tripText.fare: Row label in the trip panels: the fare in dollars.
tripText.labelValue: A label and its figure in a hover line. label: Work. value: 1,234.
tripText.modeCar: A mode name in the inter-city trip panel: the share of trips by car.
tripText.modeDrive: A mode name in the trip panels: a row label and bar segment for the share of trips by car.
tripText.modeNone: A mode name in the trip panels: the share of trips with no way between two land parts.
tripText.modeOf: Hover of a mode in the trip panels. mode: Train. share: 45%. of: a phrase such as 'the 312k trips on weekdays between the two places'.
tripText.modePlane: A mode name in the inter-city trip panel: the share of trips by plane.
tripText.modeShare: Spoken label of the share bar, one entry per mode. mode: Train. share: 45%.
tripText.modeTrain: A mode name in the trip panels: a row label and bar segment for the share of trips by transit.
tripText.modeWalk: A mode name in the trip panels: a row label and bar segment for the share of trips on foot.
tripText.modeWalking: A mode name in the inter-city trip panel: the share of everyday trips on foot.
tripText.modelLine: Second line of a mode hover: the demand model's own share before rounding to whole trips. share: 12.3%.
tripText.noRoad: Shown in a trip view where the two ends are land parts no road joins, so the car and walk figures do not exist.
tripText.noRoute: Shown in a trip panel when no route joins the two places.
tripText.otherRoutes: Heading of the list of other routes train riders take in a trip panel.
tripText.parking: Row label in the trip panels: minutes finding a space and paying for it.
tripText.rideTip: Hover of one ride in a route of a trip panel. wait: 3.5 min. bus: true for a bus line, boat for a ferry, false for a train. full: true when part of the wait is for a vehicle with room. fullMin: 1.2 min. ride: 12.0 min. stops: number of stops.
tripText.rideTipLate: Added to the end of a ride's hover when trips start with a long gap between vehicles. bus: true for a bus line, boat for a ferry, false for a train; min: 2.5 min.
tripText.smallerRoutes: Last row of a route list in a trip panel: the many routes too small to list, as one share.
tripText.termAirportDrives: A word in the effective time equation of a plane trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes driving to and from the airports.
tripText.termAtAirports: A word in the effective time equation of a plane trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes at the airports (check-in, security, boarding).
tripText.termCar: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. What the car costs for the drive to the station, followed by a dollar amount.
tripText.termChange: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. The minutes one change between trains costs.
tripText.termChanges: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Followed by how many times the rider changes train, as in 'changes 2 × 4'.
tripText.termChoiceOfRoutes: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. The minutes saved by having several ways to go; usually negative.
tripText.termCrossingFare: A word in the effective time equation of a car trip (a hover), lower case. The fare of a ferry or tunnel crossing, followed by a dollar amount.
tripText.termCrossingTime: A word in the effective time equation of a car trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes waiting for and riding a ferry or tunnel crossing.
tripText.termCrowding: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes added by riding in full trains.
tripText.termDrive: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case, as in 'walk 8 × 1.5 + wait 3 + ride 6'. It starts with a capital when it comes first. Time driving.
tripText.termDropOff: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case, as in 'walk 8 × 1.5 + wait 3 + ride 6'. Minutes lost being dropped off at a station.
tripText.termFare: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Followed by a dollar amount, as in 'fare $2.90 × 3'.
tripText.termFlight: A word in the effective time equation of a plane trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes in the air.
tripText.termOwnership: A word in the effective time equation of a car trip (a hover), lower case. What owning a car costs on this trip, followed by a dollar amount.
tripText.termParking: A word in the effective time equation of a car trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes finding a space.
tripText.termParkingAtHome: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes finding a space and parking at the start of the trip.
tripText.termParkingAtStation: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes finding a space and parking at the station.
tripText.termRide: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes on board.
tripText.termRunning: A word in the effective time equation of a car trip (a hover), lower case. Fuel and tolls, followed by a dollar amount.
tripText.termStartingTheDrive: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case, as in 'walk 8 × 1.5 + wait 3 + ride 6'. It starts with a capital when it comes first. Minutes spent getting the car going.
tripText.termTransferFare: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Followed by a dollar amount.
tripText.termUntilFlight: A word in the effective time equation of a plane trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes between when the traveller wanted to leave and the flight.
tripText.termWait: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes waiting for trains.
tripText.termWaitingForRoom: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes waiting for a train that is not full.
tripText.termWalk: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes walking, followed by the minutes.
tripText.termWalkBetween: A word in the effective time equation of a trip (a hover), lower case. Minutes walking from one station to another to change.
tripText.time: Row label in the trip panels: the real minutes of a route (not the effective time).
tripText.trainTrips: Right-hand caption of a route list in a trip panel; the figures are shares of transit trips.
tripText.tripsAmount: A number of trips in a sentence, such as '312k trips' or '1 errands trip'. kind: 'all' or 'purpose'. amount: 312k. words: the purpose in lower case, 'errands'. count: the trips as a whole number, for the plural.
tripText.tripsWords: The word for trips in a sentence, with the purpose in front when one is picked. kind: 'all' or 'purpose'. words: the purpose in lower case, such as 'errands' or 'work'.
tripView.noRoutePeriod: Tag over the straight line drawn between two points of a trip when transit runs between them at other times of day.
tripView.noRoute: Tag over the straight line drawn between two points of a trip when no transit route joins them.
tripView.straight: Second row of the tag over a trip's straight line. distance: "4.2 km".
tripView.endsWhere: Hover tag over the end marker of a trip, when its station is not known.
tripView.endsAt: Hover tag over the end marker of a trip. name: a station, "Canal St".
tripView.startsWhere: Hover tag over the start marker of a trip, when its station is not known.
tripView.startsAt: Hover tag over the start marker of a trip. name: a station, "Canal St".
tripView.aStation: Stands for a station with no name in a trip's route tags.
tripView.theLine: Stands for a line with no name in tripView.board, tripView.leave and tripView.stopsHere.
tripView.aLine: Stands for a line with no name at the start of tripView.ride.
tripView.share: Second row of the hover tag over a trip route on the map. share: a whole number, "60".
tripView.to: Hover tag title over the dashed access leg of a trip between two areas. name: the station, "Canal St".
tripView.accessArea: Hover tag second row over the access leg of a trip between two areas. time: "12 min".
tripView.access: Hover tag title over the access leg of a trip from a home. drive: true when the access is by car; distance: "1.2 km"; name: the boarding station; time: "12 min".
tripView.straightHomes: Hover tag second row over a drive access leg that starts from several homes.
tripView.straightHome: Hover tag second row over a walk access leg that starts from one home.
tripView.from: Hover tag title over the dashed leaving leg of a trip between two areas. name: the station, "Canal St".
tripView.egressArea: Hover tag second row over the leaving leg of a trip between two areas. time: "12 min".
tripView.egress: Hover tag title over the walk from the last station to the destination. distance: "400 m"; name: the station; time: "6 min".
tripView.straightPlace: Hover tag second row over the walk from the last station to the destination.
tripView.board: Hover tag row over a station where the trip boards. line: the line's name, "Line 4".
tripView.leave: Hover tag row over a station where the trip leaves a line. line: "Line 4".
tripView.stopsHere: Hover tag row over a station the trip passes through. line: "Line 4".
tripView.walk: Hover tag title over a walking leg between two stations. from, to: station names; time: "5 min".
tripView.ride: Hover tag title over a ride leg of a trip. line: "Line 4"; from, to: station names.
tripView.rideDetail: Hover tag second row over a ride leg. stops: 6; time: "14 min"; bus: true for a bus line, false for a train; wait: "4 min"; crowded: true when crowding adds noticeable time; perceived: "17 min".
troubleList.broken: Hover on a row of the trouble list: a line whose track was removed.
troubleList.crowding: A row of the Issues list (map's lower right): a line whose vehicles leave full or leave riders behind. name: the line's name, e.g. "Red".
troubleList.capacity: First line of the hover on a row of the trouble list: a spot that is nearly full or over capacity. name: the kind of spot, e.g. "Junction" or "Platform"; pct: e.g. 95.
troubleList.full: Hover on a row of the Issues list: a line whose vehicles often leave full. full: e.g. "12"; trains: e.g. "30"; vehicle: train, bus or boat. h is hours.
troubleList.held: Hover on a row of the trouble list: trains are held back at the line's ends. vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
troubleList.hide: Hover on the Issues list button while the list is open.
troubleList.label: Screen reader name of the button at the map's lower right that opens the Issues list.
troubleList.leftBehind: Hover on a row of the Issues list: two lines. left: riders left behind, e.g. "1.2k"; wanted: riders who wanted a vehicle, e.g. "4k"; full: vehicles that left full, e.g. "12"; trains: vehicles that ran, e.g. "30"; vehicle: train, bus or boat (a bus waits at a stop, a boat at a port). h is hours.
troubleList.noStations: Hover on a row of the trouble list (map's lower right): a line that has no stations.
troubleList.fixBroken: What to try, starting "Try: ", in the hover on a row of the Issues list: a line whose track was removed.
troubleList.fixCrowded: What to try, starting "Try: ", in the hover on a row of the Issues list: a line whose vehicles leave full or leave riders behind. vehicle: train, bus or boat.
troubleList.reverses: Hover on a row of the trouble list: a line whose trains reverse partway at this station. name: the line's name, e.g. "Red". One line of text per line that reverses.
troubleList.show: Hover on the Issues list button while the list is closed.
troubleList.spot: A row of the trouble list: a full or nearly full spot and where it is. name: the kind of spot, e.g. "Platform"; prep: at or near; place: a station name.
troubleList.waits: Hover on a row of the trouble list. time: a short duration, e.g. "1m30s"; level: the demand level now, high, medium or low (other if not known). vehicle: train or tram (a tram's track and stops have their own words).
updates.v01Line: One line in the small update row on the start menu, in a friendly, casual, lowercase voice. v0.1 is the version number. The trailing ... means there is more in the changelog.
updates.v01Currency: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). The Currency setting can show money in other currencies.
updates.v01Spanish: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). The game can now be played in Spanish.
updates.v01Curves: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). The smallest curve radius for track is now 50 metres.
updates.v01DeleteKeys: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). The Delete and Backspace keys on the keyboard now delete the selected thing.
updates.v01StationsApart: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). The Stations list can show each station of a complex (an interchange) in its own row.
updates.v01Rename: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). Clicking three times quickly on a name in the Lines or Stations list lets the player rename it.
updates.v01DeleteBig: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). Before deleting a saved game with many stations, the player has to type its number of stations.
updates.v01Cars: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). Station length is now shown in train cars, not metres.
updates.v01MainMenu: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). A new button in the Saved games panel saves the game and goes to the start menu.
updates.v01MapDetail: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). The game no longer lowers the Map detail setting by itself.
updates.v01Phones: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). On phones, the game now uses less memory so the tutorial should crash less; to save memory, trips between cities are not simulated on phones.
updates.v01Fixes: A line of the changelog (casual, lowercase, short). Closing line of the list: bugs were fixed.
updates.v011Line: The start menu's one line about update v0.1.1. Casual, lowercase.
updates.v011Feedback: Changelog item: the feedback form now lists the player's earlier feedback and the developer's replies. Anita is the developer.
updates.v011Buses: Changelog item: bus routes follow the streets between stops better.
updates.v011Currencies: Changelog item: more display currencies, and the default is the one for the player's region.
updates.v011Discord: Changelog item: a link to the game's Discord server was added to Settings.
updates.v011Memory: Changelog item: fewer out-of-memory crashes in 32-bit browsers; after running out of memory the player can continue without intercity trips.
updates.v011Fixes: Changelog item: bug fixes in general.
