updates.v02Line: The start menu's one line about update v0.2. Casual, lowercase, at most 80 characters in English. The trailing ... means there is more in the changelog.
updates.v02Trams: Changelog item, the headline of the update: trams were added. Tram track can be drawn by hand or snapped to streets; trams have their own stops, cars and lines.
updates.v02TramCrossing: Changelog item: where a tram line crosses a railway line on the flat, trams wait for trains to pass first.
updates.v02Loops: Changelog item: a line can turn back round a loop of track at its end. In the line panel the loop is drawn beside the list of stops.
updates.v02BusLoops: Changelog item: bus and ferry lines can be loops (closed circuits), running one way round or both ways.
updates.v02Colors: Changelog item: trains, trams, buses and boats now share one color scale for speed on the map.
updates.v02Limit: Changelog item: a line can be given its own speed limit.
updates.v02BusFare: Changelog item: a bus fare multiple was added to the Money tab, like the one for ferries.
updates.v02Places: Changelog item: six countries were added to the playable map. Keep the country names in lowercase if the language's voice is lowercase here.
updates.v02Hidden: Changelog item: new achievements that stay hidden until earned. Do not say which.
updates.v02ColorBlind: Changelog item: a color blind choice for the colors of the demand bubbles.
updates.v02Fixes: Changelog item: toasts (the small pop-up notices) stay on screen longer, and bug fixes in general.
updates.v02Languages: Changelog item: six languages were added to the game (Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, German, French, Korean). Keep the language names in lowercase if the language's voice is lowercase here.
updates.v02BusManual: Changelog item: a bus line's stops can be placed by the player one by one instead of at an automatic spacing.
updates.v02Purpose: Changelog item: the demand bubbles on the map can be colored by the purpose of the trips (work, school, shopping and so on).
updates.v02StopOrder: Changelog item: the stops of a train line can be dragged into any order the player wants.
updates.v02Terrain: Changelog item: the terrain map (hills, used for track prices) now covers the whole world, and zones that were wrongly flat are fixed.
updates.v02Crowding: Changelog item: buses and boats now get crowding the way trains do: they fill up and riders mind it.
updates.v03Line: The start menu's one line about update v0.3. Casual, lowercase, at most 80 characters in English. The trailing ... means there is more in the changelog. A flyover is a junction where one track passes over the other on a bridge.
updates.v03Flyovers: Changelog item: a new junction is built as a flyover (one direction's track bridges over the main line, so trains don't cross at the same level) whenever there is room for one, which lets more trains through.
updates.v03Share: Changelog item: community. Players can share their network and browse other players' shared networks.
updates.v03Boards: Changelog item: there are now leaderboards per country.
updates.v03Single: Changelog item: single track (one track used by trains in both directions) can be built. It can branch off one side of a double track. It can be one way (used at junctions) or two way (for low-traffic local lines whose stations still have double track or passing points). Casual lowercase, the exclamation mark is the author's.
updates.v03Roads: Changelog item: buses and trams can use more kinds of road (service roads, pedestrian streets and so on), and rail track can snap to roads.
updates.v03Quad: Changelog item: high-speed track and tram track can be built as quad (two double tracks side by side), as normal rail already could.
updates.v03Complexes: Changelog item: the view of a station complex (several stations treated as one) now lists its stations, where it used to list its lines.
updates.v03Loops: Changelog item: placing stops on bus routes, ferry routes and rail is smoother and clicks work the same way everywhere, and bus stops placed by hand now work on loops.
updates.v03Rebuild: Changelog item: track already built can be rebuilt at another height (bridge, ground, tunnel) or as another type (rail, high-speed, tram).
updates.v03Curves: Changelog item: a lower target speed (the speed track curves are designed for) can be set, and tighter track curves are allowed.
updates.v03Ferries: Changelog item: a ferry route can have much longer legs between ports.
updates.v03Catalan: Changelog item: the game is now available in Catalan. Use your language's usual name for Catalan, lowercase as in the English.
updates.v03NerfTerminals: Changelog item for a change that makes play harder: a rail station with a terminal can turn at most 30 trains per hour. {figure} is updates.v03NerfTerminalsFigure, shown in red.
updates.v03NerfTerminalsFigure: The new limit in updates.v03NerfTerminals, shown in red inside that sentence: 30 trains per hour.
updates.v03NerfTrams: Changelog item for a change that makes play harder: tram track now carries at most 40 trams per hour. {figure} is updates.v03NerfTramsFigure, shown in red.
updates.v03NerfTramsFigure: The new limit in updates.v03NerfTrams, shown in red inside that sentence: 40 trams per hour.
updates.v03NerfJunctions: Changelog item for a change that makes play harder: at a flat junction (tracks crossing at the same level), each crossing train blocks it for 120 seconds, where it was 90 seconds before. Building a flyover avoids this. {figure} is updates.v03NerfJunctionsFigure, shown in red.
updates.v03NerfJunctionsFigure: The new time in updates.v03NerfJunctions, shown in red inside that sentence: 120 seconds.
updates.v03Fixes: Changelog item: bug fixes in general.
updates.v031Line: The start menu's one line about update v0.3.1. Casual, lowercase, at most 80 characters in English. The trailing ... means there is more in the changelog. Longer trips (between cities) choose high-speed lines again; Community can be searched.
updates.v031Hsr: Changelog item: a bug fix. Longer trips between cities avoided the player's high-speed lines whenever the high-speed fare (a multiple of the normal fare, set in the Money tab) was above 1x; now they take them again.
updates.v031Saves: Changelog item: a bug fix. Some saved games never finished loading; they stayed on the "Calculating demand" loading step for ever (use the same words as loadBar.demand). They load now.
updates.v031Search: Changelog item: Community has a search box that finds shared networks by their title or by the name of the player who shared them.
updates.v031Played: Changelog item: each saved game shows how long the player has played it, and the account panel shows the account's total time played.
updates.v031Button: Changelog item: the start menu has a button that opens Community.
updates.v031Hidden: Changelog item: when a moderator hides a player's display name (others see "player" instead), the player's account panel tells them, and they can choose a new name.
updates.v021Line: The start menu's one line about update v0.2.1. Casual, lowercase, at most 80 characters in English. The trailing ... means there is more in the changelog.
updates.v021Hsr: Changelog item: a station longer than 4 cars can be built on high-speed track again (a bug had stopped it).
updates.v021ExactStops: Changelog item: a line's stops can be edited as one numbered list in order, covering both directions, so a stop can be skipped in one direction only or added.
updates.v021Terminals: Changelog item: at the end of a line, a train now stops with its whole length inside the platform.
updates.v021VehicleNames: Changelog item: wherever the game names a vehicle, trams are called trams and buses are called buses (before, some texts said train or vehicle).
updates.v021Transit: Changelog item: the demand view and the trip panels call the whole system transit, covering all the player's lines, whatever vehicle they use.
updates.v021TramCrossing: Changelog item: a new mark on the map where a tram line crosses railway track.
updates.v021Memory: Changelog item: a save file that may be too big for the browser's memory is no longer refused; the game can still try to load it.
updates.v021Fixes: Changelog item: bug fixes in general.

world.busStopNear: Default name of a bus stop. name: the nearest station's name, "Canal St".
world.busStop: Default name of a bus stop with no station near it.
zoneLoading.loading: Hover on a city's loading bar. name: the city, "Boston"; share: a whole number, "40".

community.mostLiked: Browse tab: networks by likes, most first, in the chosen place

community.likes: Hover on the number beside a heart
community.shared: Message after the network was published
community.stopped: Message after the network was taken down
community.sending: Progress: the drawing is being uploaded
community.hidden: Share dialog: other players reported this network, so it is hidden from the lists
community.empty: Empty list in the chosen city
community.anon: Stands in for a player's name when it was blanked by the name filter
community.back: Button: from one network back to the list
community.errSend: Error: the server refused the upload as malformed
community.errTooSmall: Error when sharing a tiny network
community.errNeedName: Error: the account has no display name
community.errBadName: Error: the name failed the filter
community.sandboxNote: Note at the bottom of the Biggest list: games played in sandbox mode have no points and are left out
community.errBadTitle: Error: the title of a shared network failed the filter
community.shareTitle: Field in the Share dialog: the title shown on the shared network; starts as the game's name
community.errNewShare: Error under the Share button: the account has played under 60 minutes. known: "yes" when the server said how long, else "no" and the sentence about it is left out. time: that length, e.g. "25 min".
community.errNewLike: Error after pressing like: the account has played under 60 minutes. known: "yes" when the server said how long, else "no" and the sentence about it is left out. time: that length, e.g. "25 min".
community.errBanned: Error: the account is banned from Community
community.errPreview: Error: shown when Community is in preview and this account is not a tester
community.errTooMany: Error: the limit of 20 shares per account
community.errDaily: Error: the daily limit, which counts replacing a share too
community.errFull: Error: the server's storage for shares is full
community.errDown: Error: the server cannot read its store
community.errOwn: Why the player cannot like or report this network
community.errGone: Error: it was removed or hidden while the player looked at it
community.errNoGame: Error: the game is not stored yet, so it cannot be shared
community.errLoad: Over a card or the viewer when its drawing cannot be read
community.letCopy: Tick box in the Share dialog, on by default: the save goes up too, so anyone can open their own copy of this network as a game
community.openCopy: Button on an opened shared network: opens that player's game to look at and play; it is kept only if the viewer saves it
community.copyLink: Button, and its hover as an icon: copies a web link that opens the game on this shared network
community.linkCopied: Shown on the Copy link button for a moment after the link was copied
community.errCopyVersion: Error after Open a copy: the shared game was saved by a game version this one cannot open (older or newer)
community.errCopyBad: Error after Open a copy: the shared file is damaged or not a game
community.search: Placeholder and label of the search box at the top right of Community: searches shared networks by their title and the sharer's display name
community.noMatch: Shown in Community in place of the cards when nothing shared in the chosen place matches the search
vehicle.noun: A line's vehicle as a singular noun, lower case: train, tram, bus or boat. Used to spot a line name that starts with its own mode's word ("Bus 53") so a title can say "53 bus"; never shown. Give the word a player would put at the start of a line name.
trackInspector.oneWay: Checkbox label in the track inspector of a single-track piece: trains then run through it one way only.
trackInspector.oneWayAutoTip: Hover on the one way switch in the track inspector, when the track runs one way only because of the double track it joins, with nothing set by the player.
trackInspector.autoWay: Button in the track inspector, shown when the player has set a way that differs from the one the track would take by itself: drops the setting.
trackInspector.reverse: Button in the track inspector, shown while the track runs one way: turns the way trains run round.
trackHover.oneWay: A row in the hover tag over track that runs one way.
oneWay.question: Question in the confirmation that appears when making a piece of track one way (or reversing it) sends lines another way. reverse: true when the track already runs one way and is being turned round.
oneWay.yes: Button that confirms the question above. reverse: true when the track is being turned round.
oneWay.no: Button that closes the one-way confirmation and changes nothing.
oneWay.reroutes: A row under the one-way question, one per line whose route changes. line: the line's name, "Line 4".
issues.oneWayNoWay: Notice when track cannot be made one way because a line has no other route between its stations. line: the line's name, "Line 4".
